jobs.jobDescription:
At NetBox Labs, our mission is to make it easier to build and manage complex networks. As a product company, we do that by developing innovative software for network professionals delivered on-premises and in the cloud.

We are seeking a Staff Product Manager to own our Network Observability features and products, reporting to the Director of Product. You will take products from definition through GA and beyond, partnering closely with Engineering, Customer Success, and GTM to build a product operators rely on to understand how their network is behaving.

You like going deep on the protocols, the data, and the edge cases that only show up in production. You can prototype, hold your own with engineering, and act as the subject matter expert. You also know how to turn that depth into clear value for customers and the business.

What You'll Do

  • Own NetBox Labs Observability features and products, turning product strategy into a scoped, sequenced roadmap and driving it from definition through GA and iteration across Cloud and Enterprise deployments.

  • Be a subject matter expert in network observability and how telemetry is collected, modelled, and used by operators to detect, troubleshoot, and resolve real problems in production networks.

  • Translate deep technical capability into business value for customers, sales, customer success, and leadership, and equip GTM teams with the positioning, demos, and technical enablement to sell it.

  • Prototype to answer product questions fast and validate ideas with engineering and customers.

  • Engage directly with customers and prospects in discovery, technical pre-sales conversations, and design partner programs.

  • Partner across our Discovery and Assurance teams to ensure Observability, Discovery, and Assurance fit together as coherent platform offerings.

  • Define and own Observability success metrics and use them to drive roadmap decisions.

What We're Looking For

  • 7-10+ years of product management leadership in B2B software, including 3+ years on technically complex products such as networking & infrastructure, observability, security, or developer platforms.

  • Product experience in network observability, monitoring, or telemetry.

  • Fluent across observability technologies. SNMP, streaming telemetry (gNMI), flow data (NetFlow, sFlow, IPFIX), OpenTelemetry and clear on the strengths and limits of each.

  • A builder. Comfortable in a codebase, able to script against APIs, stand up a prototype, read a pull request, and hold your own in a room full of engineers.

  • Able to translate deep technical detail into business value, in writing and in the room, for audiences from engineers to executives

  • Strong track record of owning products across the full lifecycle, and the autonomy to run a product line without being managed into it

  • Strong cross-functional influence, with the ability to drive alignment across engineering, CS, and GTM.

  • Comfortable operating in ambiguity and building structure where none exists

Bonus Qualifications

  • Experience with open source products and communities.

  • Familiarity with network automation or source-of-truth tooling.

  • Experience shipping products delivered both on-prem and as SaaS.

  • Exposure to device discovery or inventory ingestion pipelines.

About NetBox Labs:

NetBox Labs helps companies build and manage complex networks. We help customers accelerate network automation by delivering open, composable products and supporting the network automation community.

NetBox Labs is the commercial steward of open source NetBox, the world’s most popular network source of truth, and Orb, the next-generation open source network observability platform. Our products include NetBox Enterprise, a fully supported self-managed NetBox with advanced features, and NetBox Cloud, a secure, scalable, and reliable SaaS edition of NetBox.

NetBox powers thousands of companies, and NetBox Labs is backed by investment from Notable Capital (formerly GGV), Grafana Labs CEO Raj Dutt, Flybridge, IBM, Salesforce Ventures, and Mango Capital.

Our culture and values:

  • We own and solve problems with high attention to detail.

  • Our open source contributors, users, customers & team are all part of our community. When our community wins, we win.

  • We prioritize simplicity and think twice before adding complexity

  • Clear communication helps keep our team aligned and collaborating smoothly.

NetBox Labs is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We believe diverse teams build better software, and we welcome applicants of every race, color, religion, gender identity, sexual orientation, national origin, age, disability, and veteran status. If you need accommodation at any point in the process, just let us know.

jobs.jobDescription:
About AlphaSense:

AlphaSense is the AI platform redefining market intelligence and workflow orchestration, trusted by thousands of leading organizations to drive faster, more confident decisions in business and finance. The platform combines domain-specific AI with a vast content universe of over 500 million premium business documents — including equity research, earnings calls, expert interviews, filings, news, and internal proprietary content. Purpose-built for speed, accuracy, and enterprise-grade security, AlphaSense helps teams extract critical insights, uncover market-moving trends, and automate complex workflows with high-quality outputs. With AI solutions like Generative Search, Generative Grid, and Deep Research, AlphaSense delivers the clarity and depth professionals need to navigate complexity and obtain accurate, real-time information quickly. For more information, visit www.alpha-sense.com. Come join us.

About the Role:

We're seeking a Customer Operations Manager, to own the build, quality, and ongoing maintenance of our Gainsight content— including playbooks, health rules, and human handoff alerting logic. This role sits at the intersection of customer marketing and RevOps, translating lifecycle strategy into scalable, reliably-functioning CSP content. You'll be the Customer Marketing content builder in Gainsight, ensuring every playbook is built to specification, monitoring and reporting on their success to lifecycle managers and CS counterparts.

Who You Are:

  • 5+ years of hands-on experience building and maintaining playbooks, rules, and workflows in Gainsight CSP (required)
  • Demonstrated experience designing alerting or handoff logic between marketing/lifecycle systems and human teams (CS, Sales, RevOps)
  • Strong systems-thinking mindset with a track record of building for scale — able to anticipate where logic will break as volume, segments, or use cases multiply
  • Experience partnering closely with RevOps or CS Ops on shared data models, CRM integrations, and cross-system dependencies
  • Rigorous approach to QA and documentation; comfortable establishing process and standards where none exist
  • Familiarity with customer health scoring, lifecycle segmentation, or adoption frameworks strongly preferred
  • Analytical mindset with the ability to troubleshoot logic issues independently and communicate root cause clearly to non-technical stakeholders
  • Excellent cross-functional communication and project management skills; able to manage multiple concurrent build requests and competing priorities
  • B2B SaaS experience preferred; customer marketing, customer success, or RevOps background all relevant

What You’ll Do:

  • Own end-to-end build of Gainsight CSP playbooks — from requirements gathering with lifecycle marketing, CS, and RevOps stakeholders through configuration, testing, and launch
  • Design and maintain human handoff alerting logic in partnership with RevOps, ensuring the right signals route to the right owners at the right time with minimal false positives or missed triggers
  • Establish and enforce build quality standards (naming conventions, documentation, QA/testing protocols, version control) so playbooks scale cleanly as new use cases and teams are added
  • Monitor and report on live playbooks and alerts on an ongoing basis, proactively identifying and resolving breakage, logic drift, or data issues before they impact customers
  • Partner with Lifecycle lead and RevOps on data architecture and system dependencies (CRM, health score inputs, product usage data) that feed CSP logic, flagging upstream issues that affect playbook accuracy
  • Build and maintain internal documentation of playbook logic, ownership, and change history to support auditability and smooth handoffs as the team scales
  • Continuously evaluate the playbook portfolio for redundancy, performance, and opportunities for consolidation or optimization as lifecycle and adoption strategy evolves
  • Serve as Customer Marketing Gainsight subject matter expert, advising lifecycle marketing and CS stakeholders on capabilities and constraints when building new initiatives

For base compensation, we set standard ranges for all roles based on function and level benchmarked against similar stage growth companies and internal comparables. In order to be compliant with local legislation, as well as to provide greater transparency to candidates, we share salary ranges on all job postings regardless of desired hiring location. Final offer amounts are determined by multiple factors including candidate experience/expertise and may vary from the amounts listed below.

You may also be offered a performance-based bonus, equity, and a generous benefits program.

Base Compensation Range

$99,200—$124,000 USD

AlphaSense is an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to a work environment that supports, inspires, and respects all individuals. All employees share in the responsibility for fulfilling AlphaSense’s commitment to equal employment opportunity. AlphaSense does not discriminate against any employee or applicant on the basis of race, color, sex (including pregnancy), national origin, age, religion, marital status, sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, military or veteran status, disability, or any other non-merit factor. This policy applies to every aspect of employment at AlphaSense, including recruitment, hiring, training, advancement, and termination.

In addition, it is the policy of AlphaSense to provide reasonable accommodation to qualified employees who have protected disabilities to the extent required by applicable laws, regulations, and ordinances where a particular employee works.

Recruiting Scams and Fraud

We at AlphaSense have been made aware of fraudulent job postings and individuals impersonating AlphaSense recruiters. These scams may involve fake job offers, requests for sensitive personal information, or demands for payment. Please note:

  • AlphaSense never asks candidates to pay for job applications, equipment, or training.
  • All official communications will come from an @alpha-sense.com email address.
  • If you’re unsure about a job posting or recruiter, verify it on our Careers page.

If you believe you’ve been targeted by a scam or have any doubts regarding the authenticity of any job listing purportedly from or on behalf of AlphaSense please contact us. Your security and trust matter to us.

jobs.jobDescription:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the Role

We're looking for an analytically sharp, operationally obsessed Senior Manager of Sales Operations to steward the tools and systems that power our sales teams. In this role, you'll become the resident expert on our sales motion and rep experience — diagnosing friction, surfacing improvement opportunities, and driving the changes that make our teams faster and more effective.

Reporting to the Director of Sales Operations, you'll serve as the primary business steward for Salesforce and our broader sales tech stack. You'll aggregate and prioritize enhancement requests, partner closely with our Product working team to execute them, and validate their impact before scaling. Critically, you won't just make changes — you'll oversee adoption, working with our change management teams to ensure reps are equipped to use new tools and workflows, and tracking whether changes actually land.

This is a high-visibility, cross-functional role for someone who thrives at the intersection of sales strategy, systems execution, and change management — and who can tell a compelling story to leadership about what the data says and what to do about it.

What You'll Do

Sales Motion & Rep Experience

  • Develop a deep understanding of our end-to-end sales motion, workflows, and rep experience across all sales segments — through direct shadowing, structured interviews, and usage data

  • Proactively identify pain points, inefficiencies, and opportunities for improvement in our tools and processes

  • Translate frontline rep feedback and usage patterns into actionable, prioritized enhancement recommendations

  • Serve as the internal voice of the rep when making tooling and process decisions — ensuring changes improve day-to-day experience, not just system architecture

CRM & Tech Stack Strategy

  • Serve as the primary business steward for Salesforce, owning the backlog of changes, enhancements, and new feature requests — including data quality, workflow automation, and reporting standards

  • Aggregate, triage, and prioritize incoming requests from sales leadership, reps, and cross-functional partners; evaluate trade-offs and maintain a clear, well-reasoned improvement roadmap

  • Oversee Salesforce data integrity and process consistency to ensure reporting is credible and adoption is measurable

  • Evaluate, recommend, and support implementation of adjacent tools in the stack (e.g., Clay, LeanData, ZoomInfo, etc.)

  • Assess opportunities to embed AI and automation into sales workflows — helping reps spend less time on manual tasks and more time on productive outreach

Testing, Validation & Adoption

  • Design and support testing protocols to validate the impact of changes before broader rollout

  • Define success metrics — including post-launch adoption rates, usage trends, and rep productivity impact — and monitor them consistently

  • Drive adoption of new tools and workflows through documentation, training, and structured change management; don't declare a launch complete until adoption is real

  • Synthesize learnings to inform future prioritization and build a continuous improvement loop

Reporting & Executive Communication

  • Build and maintain reporting and dashboards that give Sales leadership visibility into tooling adoption, backlog health, and shipped improvements

  • Translate complex operational data into clear, executive-ready analyses and recommendations

  • Establish and run a regular operating cadence with Sales leadership on work in progress, priorities, and outcomes

What We're Looking For

  • 6+ years of experience in Sales Operations, Revenue Operations, or a related field

  • Hands-on Salesforce experience required — reporting, dashboards, workflow/process design, and data quality management; Admin certification a strong plus

  • Proven ability to manage a complex backlog and prioritize across competing stakeholder needs in a fast-moving environment

  • Experience working cross-functionally with technical or product teams to deliver systems improvements

  • Demonstrated ability to drive tool adoption through documentation, training, and change management — not just implementation

  • Strong data analytics capability: able to analyze usage and adoption data, identify trends, and translate findings into clear recommendations

  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills — able to translate business needs into technical briefs, and data insights into executive narratives

  • High-agency operator: you follow through, operate independently in ambiguity, and have a bias toward action

Nice to Have

  • Experience with sales engagement or conversation intelligence tools (Outreach, Gong, Clari, ZoomInfo)

  • Familiarity with SQL, Tableau, Looker, or other BI tools for usage and adoption analysis

  • Experience evaluating or operationalizing AI/automation use cases in a sales environment

  • Prior experience in a high-growth marketplace or B2B SaaS environment

Compensation & Benefits

  • The base salary band for this position ranges from $120,000 - $190,000, commensurate with experience and performance. Compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location.

  • This position will be eligible for a competitive year-end performance bonus & equity package.

  • Full medical, dental, vision package to fit your needs.

  • Flexible vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it.

  • Pet discount plans & retirement plan with company match (401K).

  • The rare opportunity to work with sharp, motivated teammates solving some of the most unique challenges and changing the world.

We value diversity

We know that the best ideas come from teams where diverse points of view uncover new solutions to hard problems. We welcome and value individuals who bring diverse life experiences, educational backgrounds, cultures, and work experiences.

Our hiring process may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

#LI-Remote

jobs.jobDescription:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the team

This Principal Technical Product Manager will own the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the AI Platform: the shared, governed entry point every model and agent workload at Angi runs through. As generative AI moves from experiment to production across the company, this team manages the common platform with routing, cost attribution, quality evaluation, and guardrails built in rather than rebuilt by every team.

The ideal candidate is a technical product manager who treats infrastructure as a product and has a strong thesis on how AI is reshaping the way software and models get built and served. You will own the platform that our product engineering, data science and their associated agents depend on: a model-agnostic AI Gateway, eval-gated prompt management, self-hosted and fine-tuned model serving, and the trust-and-autonomy ladder that governs how much independence each agent earns. Your measure of success is not just adoption and scale, but are we meaningfully improving our products and enabling our internal teams.

What you'll do

Product Management

  • AI Gateway & Cost Governance: Own the vision for a governed, model-agnostic gateway that all model and agent traffic routes through, with per-team and per-use-case cost attribution, flexible model routing, rate limiting, provider failover, and automatic spending caps and stop switches. Make model-swap and cost decisions changeable once at the gateway, not per service.

  • Evaluation & Quality Enforcement: Define the roadmap for the eval engine and the pass/fail gate that runs on it, eval-gated prompt management with versioning and rollback, and per-agent accuracy scoring — so quality regressions are caught before they reach users rather than surfacing downstream in business metrics.

  • Trust & Autonomy Ladder: Define and champion the trust-and-autonomy ladder — the thresholds, progression criteria, evidence, approvals, and rollback logic that govern when an agent earns more independence — so agentic adoption scales with accountability instead of governance gaps.

  • LLM & ML Serving Infrastructure: Own the production path self-hosted LLM /open-weight model serving and traditional ML with the goal to consolidate both ML and LLM workloads under one standardized observable platform.

  • Cost & ROI Telemetry: Define and instrument the metrics that track the platform health as well as business impact to the platform.

Execution And Leadership

  • Cross-Functional Partnership: Establish deep partnerships with product engineering, architecture and data science to drive adoption and make sure the platform reflects how teams actually build and serve models.

  • Technical Roadmap Management: Manage a complex platform backlog spanning parallel tracks and under real capacity constraints. Make and communicate authoritative sequencing and trade-off decisions with concise and clear communications.

  • Stakeholder Communication: Act as the primary interface between technical platform teams and business stakeholders, translating infrastructure investment into clear business outcomes

Who you are

Minimum Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience in Product Management, with at least 4 years focused on infrastructure, platforms, ML/AI systems, or other technical products serving internal engineering or data-science customers.

  • Proven track record scaling technical platforms from inception through maturity for demanding internal customers.

  • Technical fluency across the modern AI/ML stack — model serving and inference, API gateways/proxies, evaluation and testing frameworks, and cloud/Kubernetes infrastructure — sufficient to “swim with the fishes” with engineers and data scientists on architecture trade-offs.

  • Demonstrated ability to use telemetry and cost data (model performance, eval results, adoption analytics, spend data) to diagnose bottlenecks and drive product strategy.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Hands-on familiarity with LLM gateways/proxies (e.g., LiteLLM), evaluation and observability tooling (e.g., Langfuse), and model serving frameworks (e.g., KServe, SageMaker, Bedrock, Ray).

  • Experience with prompt management and versioning, LLM fine-tuning, or self-hosted/open-weight model serving in production.

  • Familiarity with agent governance concepts — guardrails, PII controls, prompt-injection protection, and autonomy/trust frameworks — and with the tension between agent velocity and cost control.

  • Experience operating a platform across competing tracks and stakeholders, sequencing revenue-critical stabilization work alongside a new strategic build-out.

  • Exceptional leadership skills with a history of influencing cross-functional teams without direct authority.

Compensation & Benefits

  • The salary band for this position ranges from $190,000 – $280,000 commensurate with experience and performance. Compensation may vary based on factors such as geographic location.

  • This position will be eligible for a competitive year end performance bonus & equity package.

  • Full medical, dental, vision package to fit your needs

  • Flexible vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it

  • Pet discount plans & retirement plan with company match (401K)

  • The rare opportunity to work with sharp, motivated teammates solving some of the most unique challenges and changing the world

We value diversity. We know that the best ideas come from teams where diverse points of view uncover new solutions to hard problems. We welcome and value individuals who bring diverse life experiences, educational backgrounds, cultures, and work experiences.

Our hiring process may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Keyfactor

Our mission is to securely connect the world: humans, machines, and AI. Keyfactor is the leader in trust infrastructure for AI and machines, helping the world's largest enterprises and government agencies take control of the cryptographic identities that safeguard every digital interaction. Behind the platform is a global team of people who care deeply about the work and each other. We move fast, think big, and show up for one another every day. If you're looking for work that matters and a team that brings out your best, we hope you'll trust your future with Keyfactor!

Title: Senior Technical Product Manager

Location: United States; Remote

Experience: Senior-Level

Job Function: Product Management

Employment Type: Full-time

Industry: Computer and Network Security

About the position

The Principal Product Manager for Command Certificate Lifecycle Management is responsible for defining and executing the vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Command Certificate Lifecycle Management product line. This role requires deep expertise in cryptographic security, machine identity management, and SaaS/on-prem hybrid solutions. The Principal Product Manager will drive Command Certificate Lifecycle Management’s evolution as the central certificate lifecycle management platform, ensuring it delivers innovative, scalable, and compliant solutions that address the needs of enterprise customers and strategic partners.

Applicants must be legally authorized to work in the United States.

Job Responsibilities

  • Product Vision & Strategy: Establish and communicate a compelling vision for Command Certificate Lifecycle Management, aligning with company strategic objectives and the evolving landscape of certificate lifecycle management, machine identity governance, and compliance (e.g., FedRAMP, PQC readiness).
  • Roadmap Ownership: Develop and maintain Command Certificate Lifecycle Management’s product roadmap, prioritizing initiatives such as certificate discovery, lifecycle automation, policy enforcement, deployment flexibility, advanced analytics, and integrations across the Keyfactor platform.
  • Lifecycle Management: Oversee the Command Certificate Lifecycle Management product lifecycle from ideation through launch and continuous improvement, ensuring timely, high-quality releases for both SaaS and on-prem deployments. Lead the transition from POC to production, addressing friction points and supporting enablement motions.
  • Market & Customer Insights: Conduct deep market research and engage with customers, partners, and industry stakeholders to identify emerging trends (e.g., PQC, SAST, CI/CD integration), competitive dynamics, and evolving customer needs.
  • Cross-Functional Leadership: Collaborate with engineering, design, documentation, support, and go-to-market teams to deliver cohesive, customer-centric solutions. Champion the use of dedicated Confluence spaces and Zendesk for Command Certificate Lifecycle Management documentation and support resources.
  • Requirements & Execution: Translate strategic goals into detailed product requirements, user stories, and acceptance criteria. Guide development teams to deliver features such as cryptographic asset discovery, policy enforcement, and advanced analytics.
  • Performance & Optimization: Monitor Command Certificate Lifecycle Management’s performance using data analytics and customer feedback. Drive iterative improvements, focusing on security, scalability, and user experience.
  • Stakeholder Engagement: Serve as the primary point of contact for Command Certificate Lifecycle Management, providing regular updates to executive leadership, field teams, and strategic customers.
  • Mentorship & Team Development: Mentor product managers and cross-functional contributors, fostering a culture of innovation, technical excellence, and continuous learning.

Required Qualifications and Skills:

  • Bachelor’s degree in Computer Science, Engineering, or related field.
  • Proven experience in product management for security, SaaS, or enterprise software.
  • Deep understanding of cryptographic technologies, machine identity management, and agile methodologies.
  • Exceptional communication and leadership skills, with a track record of cross-functional collaboration.
  • Proficiency with product management tools (e.g., JIRA, Confluence) and data analytics platforms.

Preferred Qualifications and Skills:

  • Master’s degree (MS, MBA, or related).
  • Certified Product Manager (CPM) or equivalent.
  • Experience with FedRAMP, PQC, SAST, or CI/CD pipeline integrations.
  • Familiarity with UX/UI best practices and technical documentation strategies.
  • Demonstrated ability to drive SaaS and on-prem product launches and migrations.

Travel Requirements.

Up to 10% travel time required.

Compensation

Salary will be commensurate with experience. 

Culture, Career Opportunities and Benefits

We build teams that continually strive to get better than the day before. You will be challenged daily and given opportunities to grow personally and professionally. We balance autonomy and structure to create an entrepreneurial environment to spur creativity and new ideas. 

Here are just some of the initiatives that make our culture special:  

  • Second Fridays (a company-wide day off on the second Friday of every month minus November and December due to the Holiday schedule). Please note that this benefit is subject to change.
  • Comprehensive benefit coverage globally.
  • Paid Parental Leave is available to new parents. Structure varies based on regional/government requirements. In regions where government-paid leave doesn’t exist, like in the U.S., the company offers generous paid parental leave, along with comprehensive adoption and fertility support.
  • Competitive time off globally.
  • Dedicated employee-focused ambassadors via Key Contributors & Culture Committees.
  • DIVERSE Commitment, a call to action for a more inclusive and diverse future in business, society, and technology.
  • The Keyfactor Alliance Program to support DEIB efforts.
  • Wellbeing resources, wellness allowance, mindfulness app free membership, Wellness Wednesdays.
  • Global Volunteer Day, company non-profit matching, and 3 volunteer days off.
  • Monthly Talent development and Cross Functional meetings to support professional development.
  • Regular All Hands meetings – followed by group gatherings.

Our Core Values

Our core values are extremely important to how we run our business and what we look for in every team member:  

Trust is paramount.  

We deliver security software and solutions where trust and openness are of the highest importance for our customers. We are honest and a trusted partner in every aspect of business.  

Customers are core.  

We strategize, operate, and execute through a customer-centric view. We prioritize the security interests of our customers, and we act as if their data were our own.  

Innovation never stops, it only accelerates.  

The speed of change is accelerating. We are committed, through investment and focus, to stay ahead of the innovation curve.  

We deliver with agility.   

We thrive in high-paced and continually changing environments. We navigate through newly added variables, adjust accordingly, while driving towards our strategic goals.  

United by respect.   

Respect for all is what unites us. We promote diversity, inclusivity, equity, and acting with empathy and openness, both in our business and in our communities.  

Teams make “it” happen.  

Vision and goals are not individually achievable – they require teamwork. We pride ourselves in operating as a cohesive team, creating promoters and partners, and winning as one.  

Keyfactor is a proud equal opportunity employer including but not limited to veterans and individuals with disabilities. 

REASONABLE ACCOMMODATION: Applicants with disabilities may contact a member of Keyfactor’s People team via people@keyfactor.com and/or telephone at 1.216.785.2990 to request and arrange for accommodations at any time.

jobs.jobDescription:
Gatik, the leader in autonomous middle-mile logistics, is revolutionizing the B2B supply chain with its autonomous transportation-as-a-service (ATaaS) solution and prioritizing safe, consistent deliveries while streamlining freight movement by reducing congestion. The company focuses on short-haul, B2B logistics for Fortune 500 retailers and in 2021 launched the world’s first fully driverless commercial transportation service with Walmart. Gatik's Class 3-7 autonomous trucks are commercially deployed across major markets, including Texas, Arkansas, and Ontario, Canada, driving innovation in freight transportation.

The company's proprietary Level 4 autonomous technology, Gatik Carrier™, is custom-built to transport freight safely and efficiently between pick-up and drop-off locations on the middle mile. With robust capabilities in both highway and urban environments, Gatik Carrier™ serves as an all-encompassing solution that integrates advanced software and hardware powering the fleet, facilitating effortless integration into customers' logistics operations.

About the Role

Gatik is looking for a technical, high-performing Sr. Field Service Team Manager to build, empower, and lead a team of Field Service Technicians in maintaining high vehicle availability and operational safety. In this role, you will oversee market technical execution, manage autonomous system upfits and end-of-line improvement initiatives, and validate standard work instructions for vehicle retrofits. Reporting to the Director, Fleet and Maintenance Strategy, you will partner closely with local fleet managers and Techops teams across Hardware, Software, and Autonomous Vehicle Integration to rapidly resolve complex technical issues. You will be instrumental in maintaining rigorous safety and quality standards while driving fleet reliability across field operations.

This role is remote, but travel is necessary to our sites throughout North America.

What You'll Do

  • Team Leadership & Operational Execution: Recruit, manage, and empower a high-performing team of Field Service Technicians, directing daily operations, performance, skill development, and career growth while fostering a culture of accountability and safety.
  • Engineering Liaison & Support Architecture: Establish a field liaison program and tiered escalation framework to bridge communication between frontline technicians and central TechOps, driving rapid root-cause analysis and actionable feedback to engineering.
  • Fleet Maintenance & Optimization: Partner with engineering to diagnose underperforming fleet assets and implement targeted maintenance strategies to maximize uptime, lower MTTR, and resolve recurring issues.
  • Autonomous Upfits & System Validation: Oversee physical upfits and End of Line (EOL) verification for compute, sensor, and hardware suites to ensure vehicles are fully operational before deployment.
  • Campaign Execution & Standard Work Documentation: Execute field vehicle campaigns and retrofits, establish clear standard work instructions, and train new maintenance vendors on operational standards.
  • Quality, Safety & Regulatory Compliance: Enforce safety protocols, PPE usage, and workspace cleanliness while ensuring full compliance with DOT and FMCSA regulatory standards.

What We're Looking For

  • Experience: 5+ years of hands-on experience in technical field service, commercial fleet maintenance, or automotive/hardware technical operations, with at least 2+ years in direct people management.
  • Team Leadership: Proven track record of hiring, mentoring, and managing technical teams of technicians or diagnostic mechanics.
  • Technical Escalations & Cross-Functional Work: Demonstrated ability to manage complex technical escalations and collaborate effectively with hardware and software engineering teams.
  • Upfit & Campaign Experience: Hands-on experience with vehicle upfits, sensor/hardware integration, end-of-line verification, and technical campaign/retrofit execution.
  • Technical Documentation: Ability to author clear standard operating procedures (SOPs), work instructions, and step-by-step technical documentation.
  • Diagnostic Expertise: Deep familiarity with vehicle diagnostics, electrical systems, CAN bus/telematics, and troubleshooting tools.

More about Gatik

Founded in 2017 by experts in autonomous vehicle technology, Gatik has rapidly expanded its presence to Mountain View, Dallas-Fort Worth, Arkansas, and Toronto. As the first and only company to achieve fully driverless middle-mile commercial deliveries, Gatik holds a unique and defensible position in the AV industry, with a clear trajectory toward sustainable growth and profitability.

We have delivered complete, proprietary AV technology - an integration of software and hardware - to enable earlier successes for our clients in constrained Level 4 autonomy. By choosing the middle mile – with defined point-to-point delivery, we have simplified some of the more complex AV challenges, enabling us to achieve full autonomy ahead of competitors. Given extensive knowledge of Gatik’s well-defined, fixed route ODDs and hybrid architecture, we are able to hyper-optimize our models with exponentially less data, establish gate-keeping mechanisms to maintain explainability, and ensure continued safety of the system for unmanned operations.

Visit us at Gatik for more company information and Careers at Gatik for more open roles.

Notable News

  • Forbes: Forget robotaxis. Upstart Gatik sees middle-mile deliveries as the path to profitable AVs
  • Tech Brew: Gatik AI exec unpacks the regulations that could shape the AV industry
  • Business Wire: Gatik Paves the Way for Safe Driverless Operations (‘Freight-Only’) at Scale with Industry-First Third-Party Safety Assessment Framework
  • Auto Futures: Autonomous Trucking Group Gatik Secures Investment From NIPPON EXPRESS HOLDINGS
  • Automotive News: Gatik foresees hundreds of self-driving trucks on road soon, and that's just the beginning
  • Forbes: Isuzu And Gatik Go All In To Scale Up Driverless Freight Services
  • Bloomberg: Autonomous Vehicle Startup Takes Off by Picking Off Easier Routes
  • Reuters: Driverless vehicles on limited routes bump along despite US robotaxi scrutiny

Taking Care of Our Team

At Gatik, we connect people of extraordinary talent and experience to an opportunity to create a more resilient supply chain and contribute to our environment’s sustainability. We are diverse in our backgrounds and perspectives yet united by a bold vision and shared commitment to our values. Our culture emphasizes the importance of collaboration, respect and agility.

We at Gatik strive to create a diverse and inclusive environment where everyone feels they have opportunities to succeed and grow because we know that together we can do great things. We are committed to an inclusive and diverse team. We do not discriminate based on race, color, ethnicity, ancestry, national origin, religion, sex, gender, gender identity, gender expression, sexual orientation, age, disability, veteran status, genetic information, marital status or any legally protected status.

jobs.jobDescription:
Our Mission:

6sense's mission is to multiply what matters: growth, retention, and efficiency. We envision a future where companies, teams and people reach their full potential.

Our People:

People are the heart and soul of 6sense. We serve with passion and purpose. We live by our Being 6sense values of Win as One Team, Stay Curious, Do The Right Thing, Own the Outcome, and Create Belonging. Every 6sensor plays a part in deﬁning the future of our industry-leading technology. 6sense is a place where difference-makers roll up their sleeves, take risks, act with integrity, and measure success by the value we create for our customers. We want 6sense to be the best chapter of your career.

Director, Enterprise Applications

Position Profile

Function: Business Technology — Enterprise Applications

Reporting line: Chief Security and Business Technology Officer

Role Purpose

Lead the strategy, delivery and continuous improvement of 6sense’s enterprise applications, turning business priorities into secure, scalable platforms and measurable outcomes. This is a business transformation leadership role—not simply an application administration or project delivery role.

The Director will partner with Go-to-Market, Customer Success, Support, Finance, Legal and Partner Operations to simplify processes, strengthen data quality and controls, and improve how work gets done. AI fluency and applied AI delivery are core requirements: the role must identify where AI creates value, where conventional automation is better, and where human judgment must remain accountable.

Responsibilities & Accountabilities

1. Enterprise Strategy & Business Partnership

  • Own a business-aligned application roadmap and investment portfolio, balancing growth, operational efficiency, risk, user experience and technical debt.
  • Partner with functional leaders to define business problems, accountable process owners, funding, expected benefits and adoption commitments before delivery begins.
  • Run transparent prioritization and portfolio reviews; challenge low-value requests and communicate trade-offs, dependencies and decisions clearly.

2. AI-Enabled Business Transformation

  • Build a prioritized portfolio of AI and automation opportunities across business workflows, starting with process redesign and data readiness rather than tool selection.
  • Lead build-versus-buy-versus-configure decisions with Enterprise AI Engineering, application owners, Security, Legal and Finance.
  • Set standards for discovery, prototypes, evaluation, user acceptance testing, rollout and value realization. Require evidence before moving pilots into production.
  • Champion practical AI adoption through training, workflow changes and feedback loops; distinguish estimated benefits from validated outcomes.
  • Ensure AI-enabled workflows have defined permissions, human approval points, monitoring, escalation and safe fallback paths.

3. Application Architecture, Delivery & Reliability

  • Lead business solutions partners, delivery leaders, engineers and administrators through clear ownership, shared standards and sustainable delivery practices.
  • Guide architecture for Salesforce and connected GTM and Finance systems, prioritizing maintainability, reusable integrations and trusted data flows.
  • Establish disciplined release management, testing, documentation, incident response and recovery practices for business-critical applications.
  • Reduce redundant tools, fragile integrations, legacy customizations and unsupported components; manage lifecycle and vendor dependencies.

4. Governance, Security & Financial Stewardship

  • Partner with Security, Privacy and Legal to embed access controls, segregation of duties, auditability, data protection and risk reviews into delivery and operations.
  • Align application AI use cases with 6sense’s AI Management System and applicable approval processes; document risks, controls and ownership before deployment.
  • Own application budgets, license utilization, vendor performance and total cost of ownership; consider AI usage costs as well as subscription and integration costs.

5. Leadership & Operating Model

  • Develop an accountable, learning-oriented team with strong business consulting, application engineering and applied AI capabilities.
  • Build capacity plans and effective partnerships across distributed teams and service providers.
  • Establish a product-oriented operating model that owns outcomes after launch, not just project completion.
  • Provide executive-ready reporting on portfolio health, delivered value, reliability, spend, adoption and risk.
  • Create quarterly OKRs.

Required Skills & Experience

AI Competency — Essential, Not Optional

  • Applied delivery: Demonstrated experience taking an AI-enabled business workflow from discovery through production, adoption and measured results—not only personal use of AI tools.
  • Solution judgment: Explain the trade-offs among deterministic automation, embedded SaaS AI, retrieval-augmented generation and agentic workflows; know when AI should not be used.
  • Technical fluency: Understand large language model limitations, grounding, context design, APIs, integration platforms and permission-aware tool access. Be able to review prototypes and challenge architecture with engineering partners; model research expertise is not required.
  • Evaluation and economics: Define representative test cases, quality thresholds, failure modes, human review requirements and production monitoring. Compare business value with implementation, usage, maintenance and oversight costs.
  • Responsible AI: Recognize risks including inaccurate outputs, sensitive-data exposure, prompt injection, excessive permissions and overreliance. Translate risk findings into controls and deployment decisions with the appropriate specialists.
  • Adoption leadership: Teach teams how to use approved AI capabilities responsibly, redesign workflows around them and validate sustained benefits.

Enterprise Applications & Leadership

  • Substantial progressive experience leading enterprise applications or business systems, including people leadership, portfolio ownership and cross-functional transformation.
  • Strong Salesforce ecosystem knowledge and experience connecting revenue and finance processes across enterprise systems.
  • Proven ability to translate ambiguous business needs into roadmaps, investment decisions and reliable delivery.
  • Working knowledge of integration architecture, data governance, secure application lifecycle practices, change management and operational resilience.
  • Commercial discipline in budgeting, vendor negotiations, licensing and value realization.
  • Clear executive communication, strong stakeholder management and the ability to build trust while challenging assumptions.
  • Relevant degree or equivalent practical experience.

Preferred Experience

  • Leadership in a SaaS or similarly fast-changing business environment.
  • Experience with quote-to-cash, customer lifecycle and financial operations transformation.
  • Exposure to Workato, Microsoft 365 Copilot, Claude Enterprise or comparable enterprise AI and automation capabilities; tool familiarity alone does not establish AI proficiency.
  • Relevant application, architecture, change management or AI governance certifications.

Success Measures

Set baselines and agree targets with business owners after assessing the portfolio. The following are proposed measures, not existing commitments.

Outcome

Evidence of Success

Business value
Validated reduction in manual effort, process cycle time or rework; benefits confirmed by the business owner and separated from estimates.

AI quality and adoption
Useful production adoption, evaluation results, exception rates and sustained workflow improvements—not pilot counts alone.

Platform health
Service reliability, incident recovery, release quality and reductions in technical debt and integration failures.

Governance and data
Documented ownership, completed risk reviews, effective controls, audit readiness and improvements in critical data quality.

Financial discipline
Transparent portfolio spend, improved license utilization and realized value relative to total operating cost.

Delivery and capability
Predictable delivery, stakeholder confidence, clear accountability and stronger application and AI skills across the team.

Initial Priorities

  • First 30 days: Assess business priorities, application ownership, team capabilities, architecture, spend and critical risks; establish baseline measures.
  • Days 31–60: Agree portfolio priorities, clarify decision rights with IT and Enterprise AI Engineering, and select a small set of high-value AI or automation opportunities.
  • Days 61–90: Establish delivery and governance routines; advance a selected use case through evaluation and readiness review, with adoption and measurement plans.

Base Salary Range: $211,085.25 - $272,591.70. The base salary range represents the anticipated low and high end of the base salary range for this position. Actual salaries may vary and may be above or below the range based on various factors, including but not limited to work location and experience. The base salary is one component of 6sense’s total compensation package for this position. Other compensation may include a bonus program or commission plan, and stock options if approved by 6sense’s board. In addition, 6sense provides a variety of benefits, including generous health insurance coverage, life, and disability insurance, a 401K employer matching program, paid holidays, self-care days, and paid time off (PTO). #Li-remote

Notice of Collection and Use of Personal Information for California Residents: California Recruitment Privacy Notice and Policy

Our Benefits:

Full-time employees can take advantage of health coverage, paid parental leave, generous paid time-off and holidays, quarterly self-care days off, and stock options. We’ll make sure you have the equipment and support you need to work and connect with your teams, at home or in one of our oﬃces.

We have a growth mindset culture that is represented in all that we do, from onboarding through to numerous learning and development initiatives including access to our LinkedIn Learning platform. Employee well-being is also top of mind for us. We host quarterly wellness education sessions to encourage self care and personal growth. From wellness days to ERG-hosted events, we celebrate and energize all 6sense employees and their backgrounds.

Equal Opportunity Employer:

6sense is an Equal Employment Opportunity and Affirmative Action Employers. Qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender perception or identity, national origin, age, marital status, protected veteran status, or disability status. If you require reasonable accommodation in completing this application, interviewing, completing any pre-employment testing, or otherwise participating in the employee selection process, please direct your inquiries to jobs@6sense.com.

We are aware of recruiting impersonation attempts that are not affiliated with 6sense in any way. All email communications from 6sense will originate from the @6sense.com domain. We will not initially contact you via text message and will never request payments. If you are uncertain whether you have been contacted by an official 6sense employee, reach out to jobs@6sense.com

jobs.jobDescription:
RevenueCat gives app businesses the infrastructure and tools to build, run, and improve their monetization. Since graduating from YC's S18 batch, we've grown into the default monetization platform for mobile.

We're in 50%+ of newly shipped subscription apps, we process $16B+ in annual purchase volume, and we help everyone from a solo developer to the OpenAI mobile team understand and grow their revenue.

We're a remote-first team of 150+ people across 25+ countries, guided by values we actually practice: Customer Obsession, Always Be Shipping, Own It, and Balance.

This isn't the right fit for everyone. The systems you’ll build here manage billions of dollars and touch hundreds of millions of end users, and we don’t take that lightly. You'll be expected to work hard and hold a high bar for what you ship, alongside some of the sharpest, most driven people you've worked with. If that sounds energizing rather than exhausting, keep reading.

About the Role

We're looking for a Senior Product Manager to join the team working on analytics features in RevenueCat.

RevenueCat is the monetization engine for 40% of new subscription apps shipped — and the number of apps shipped is growing exponentially. We are uniquely positioned not only to give individual developer impactful information into the performance of their own apps, but also deliver truly unique data and insight given our position in the market; we know what good looks like, and we can not only put numbers in context, but give specific recommendations on metrics to target, experiments to run and anomalies to investigate.

Our analytics features help app developers make better decisions that improve the monetization of their apps. As product manager on this team, you are responsible for working with your team to set the vision and roadmap, delivering on it, launching new functionality, and increasing the impact of the team.

This role requires:

  • being technical to understand how our analytics system works and its constraint

  • being analytical to be able to define how to show data as well as debugging issues and edge cases

  • being customer obsessed to understand what information app developers need for their decisions and how we can provide this information to them

  • having an understanding of the app ecosystem, how the economics of app businesses work, and what success means for app developers

You will oversee all of the Analytics features at RevenueCat — our charts, benchmarking, dashboard, and predictive LTV. You'll partner directly with leadership, collaborate across engineering and data teams, and act as the primary driver for how our customers understand and grow their revenue.

About You

Skills & Experience

  • You have 5+ years of product management or adjacent experience, with meaningful time shipping complex products.

  • You’re analytical. You can’t do your job without data platform access. You are proficient in SQL (or similar tools) — whatever tool you need to know, you’ll learn. You love diving deep into data yourself. You’re experienced in developing robust and scalable metrics.

  • You are technical. Coding is not a core requirement for this role, being able to prototype with code is (using your preferred AI stack). You can deeply understand how RevenueCat works — what is simple and what is complex within our domain. Maybe you haven’t built and shipped a mobile app yourself (yet) but you have enough knowledge to work closely and independently with highly technical folks. You can discuss APIs, data models, and risk logic with engineering partners and enjoy diving into system details

  • You’re an excellent communicator. You can express complex ideas clearly and succinctly — written and verbal, synchronous and asynchronous, across timezones and mediums. You can get your point across.

Values and Abilities

  • You act like an owner. You roll up your sleeves, dive into the logs, and get something done yourself.

  • You thrive in ambiguity. You are comfortable making low-information, high-stakes decisions. You can quickly get to confidence, move on, and iterate.

  • You're a systems thinker. You can step back from a specific customer request and see the broader system. You build things that scale.

  • You're deep on the details. You care about what users experience, not just what the data says.

  • You know when it's good enough. You are obsessed with getting things right, but you know when you're at diminishing returns. You have a bias toward shipping. You love building — and are energized by discovery, experimentation, and rapid iteration.

  • You’re passionate about great data visualization. Chart sins grind your gears. Your visualizations deliver meaningful insights. You care what is says — and what it looks like — and you know those things are dependent on each other.

What You'll Do

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for RevenueCat's Analytics products.

  • Be obsessed with your customers. You will triage and investigate complex data and analytics problems deeply, instead of fully delegating to engineering. Dig deep to understand what developers really want — distill signal from noise and good ideas from bad ones.

  • Recommend, develop and maintain new benchmarks and metrics that deliver value to our developers, and help them make more money. Be the go-to person when a number looks off.

  • Set the vision. Create a plan that is cohesive, intentional, and impactful. Break that down into meaningful chunks on a reasonable timeline.

  • Get it done. Collaborate closely with engineering, data science, and GTM teams to bring robust analytics and experimentation tools to market. This job can not be done alone, and will require deep understanding of the individual products and the infrastructure that hooks them together.

The salary for this role is $230,000 USD. You can view our full Compensation Philosophy here for additional details.

In the first month, you'll:

  • Get to know the product, customers, and team

  • Contribute to shipping a meaningful feature to thousands of developers

  • Be ramped up on ongoing projects in your teams

Within the first 3 months, you'll:

  • Have formed a strong working relationship with your engineering manager and design counterpart

  • Have taken ownership of the roadmap and prioritization for your team (jointly with the engineering manager)

  • Work with your engineering manager and leadership to define quarterly objectives for your teams

  • Have shipped the first bigger feature end to end

  • Work with your team to discover opportunities and solutions to deliver value to our customers

  • Play an integral role in your team’s discovery and delivery processes

  • Understand the fundamentals of our tech stack and its complexities, and drive the evaluation feasibility/value tradeoffs in collaboration with your teams

Within the first 6 months, you'll:

  • Have helped your team grow and become a high-performing, engaged team in line with our company values

  • Effectively collaborate with internal stakeholders of all levels

  • Be an expert of your areas of the product and the related customer needs, and instill customer empathy in your teams

  • Independently drive all product-related decisions in your area

  • Have contributed meaningfully to our knowledge of our customers and their needs, our industry, and important trends

  • Develop a longer term vision for your area of the product in line with the product strategy

  • Work with your teams to improve processes and interfaces with other teams

Within the first 12 months, you'll:

  • Be ready to kill something you have shipped if we learned it didn't deliver the value we hoped

  • Explore completely new opportunities for how RevenueCat may provide greater value to our customers

  • Make meaningful contributions to our overall product strategy

  • Have delivered a material, business-impacting new benefit to our customers in your product area

What we offer:

  • Competitive equity in a fast-growing, Series C startup backed by top-tier investors, including Y Combinator

  • 10-year window to exercise vested equity options

  • A fully remote environment designed around autonomy and flexibility

  • 4-5 weeks of flexible time off annually

  • Paid desk at a co-working space

  • Workspace budget and continuous learning stipend

Interviewing at RevenueCat

Our interview process is rigorous on purpose. We want to be sure that everyone we bring on is genuinely excited about this work, aligned with how we operate, and ready to meet our high bar for performance. Curious what that actually looks like? Read more in our blog post on how we hire at RevenueCat, including tips to help you succeed.

More on how we work:

  • How we think about hiring and team design: Building a Winning Team

  • The values that guide how we work: Our Values

  • How we work as a remote team: How We Work Remotely at RevenueCat

  • What to expect from our interview process: Interview Expectations

  • What to expect from comp and employment: Employment FAQ

jobs.jobDescription:
About Supabase

Supabase is the Postgres development platform, built by developers for developers. We provide a complete backend solution including Database, Auth, Storage, Edge Functions, Realtime, and Vector Search. All services are deeply integrated and designed for growth.

About the Role

We're looking for Engineering Managers to lead engineering teams across Supabase. Teams range from developer-facing surfaces, core backend services, Platform, EngOps, and Databases.

This is a single pipeline for engineering management. As we get to know your background, we'll match you to the team where your experience and interests overlap most strongly. The Engineering Manager is a people, delivery, and technical role. Although we don’t expect managers to contribute to code directly, we do expect you to participate in design discussions and to be involved in setting the bar for engineering quality and best practices.

This is a new role at Supabase. We've historically optimised for technical excellence on every axis, including leadership. As our engineering org grows, people leadership has become just as critical, and the Engineering Manager role exists to reflect that. You'll be shaping what this role looks like from day one.

What You'll Be Responsible For

Team & People

  • Build a healthy, high-trust team culture in a remote-first, globally distributed environment.

  • Run 1:1s, performance management, career development, and onboarding for your direct reports.

  • Handle people admin (leave, time off, etc.) for your team.

Hiring

  • Own the hiring plan for your team and act as Hiring Manager. First round of interviewer for all roles on the team.

  • Partner with Talent Acquisition to source, interview, and close strong candidates.

  • Contribute to headcount planning, org design, and the evolution of engineering leadership at Supabase.

Delivery & Roadmap

  • Own the team's roadmap and project management (Linear), driving accountability and clear milestones.

  • Manage workflow intake and Slack triage. These are the team’s primary inboxes for cross-team requests. You decide what gets routed where, prioritized, or pushed back on.

  • Own the team's weekly updates and keep stakeholders aligned without creating overhead.

  • Organize effort against support tickets and maintain the team's SLO.

  • Surface risks, dependencies, and tradeoffs early and clearly to leadership.

Incident Commander

  • Train as an Incident Commander. Drive coordination, resolution, and post-incident follow-up.

  • Lead blameless post-incident reviews

You Might Be a Good Fit If You

  • Have 5+ years of engineering background, with enough depth to be credible with engineers building complex systems.

  • Have 3+ years managing remote engineering teams.

  • Have managed engineering teams at a cloud, SaaS, or developer tools company. Experience with developer tools or databases is a strong preference, but we'll consider any sufficiently technical background where you can demonstrate the ability to ramp on a new domain.

  • Have managed remote, globally distributed teams that work asynchronously across disparate time zones.

  • Are technical enough to be credible with strong engineers, but genuinely passionate about people management. This is the work you want to do, not a track you're settling for.

  • Build psychological safety and a feedback culture: you give feedback often and in the moment, ask for it back, and create space for the team to do the same.

  • Operate as a multiplier. Focused on helping individuals achieve more than they could alone, not on being the best technical voice in the room.

  • Coach rather than direct. Remove blockers, connect people to context and resources, and trust your engineers to own how the work gets done.

  • Have a real track record of performance management and can speak to specific examples of difficult conversations and how you navigated them.

  • Are comfortable with ambiguity and capable of building structure where there isn't much.

  • Communicate clearly and write well. You're default async, default written, set context proactively, and surface risks early.

  • Are collaborative, low-ego, and adaptable. You thrive working with high-autonomy, senior ICs who have strong technical opinions and don't need to be the smartest person in the room.

What We Offer

  • Fully Remote

    We hire globally. We believe you can do your best work from anywhere. There are no Supabase offices, but we provide a WeWork membership or co-working allowance you can use anywhere in the world.

  • ESOP

    Every team member receives ESOP (equity ownership) in the company. We want everyone to share in the upside of what we’re building together.

  • Tech Allowance

    Use this budget to set up your ideal work environment—laptop, monitor, headphones, or whatever helps you do your best work.

  • Health Benefits

    Supabase covers 100% of health insurance for employees and 80% for dependents, wherever you are. Your wellbeing and your family’s health are important to us.

  • Annual Off-Sites

    Once a year, the entire company gathers in a new city for a week of connection, collaboration, and fun. It’s a highlight of our year.

  • Flexible Work

    We operate asynchronously and trust you to manage your own time. You know what needs to be done and when.

  • Professional Development

    Every team member receives an annual education allowance to spend on learning—courses, books, conferences, or anything that supports your growth.

About the Team

Supabase was born-remote and open-source-first. We believe our globally distributed team is our secret weapon in building tools developers love.

  • ~400 team members

  • 60+ countries

  • 20+ languages spoken

  • Over $1B raised (including our $500M Series F)

  • 540,000+ community members

We move fast, build in public, and use what we ship. If it’s in your project, we probably use it in ours too. We believe deeply in the open-source ecosystem and strive to support—not replace—existing tools and communities.

jobs.jobDescription:
At Instructure, we believe in the power of people to grow and succeed throughout their lives. Our goal is to amplify that power by creating intuitive products that simplify learning and personal development, facilitate meaningful relationships, and inspire people to go further in their education and careers.
We do this by giving smart, creative, passionate people opportunities to create awesome. And that's where you come in:

At Instructure, our Strategy & Business Operations (BizOps) team partners directly with executive leadership to drive growth, efficiency, and execution across the enterprise. Our mission is to connect strategy to execution — ensuring everyone knows where we’re going, why we’re going there, and how far we’ve come. We accelerate Instructure’s most important strategic and operational priorities, from defining growth opportunities and optimizing performance to building the systems, governance, and data infrastructure that scale our business.

The Role

As Principal, Business Operations, you will lead high-impact initiatives that cut across functions, shaping how the company sets priorities, allocates resources, and measures progress. You’ll oversee strategic planning, execution governance (OKRs, QBRs, operating rhythm), and the enterprise initiative portfolio. You’ll also mentor and lead BizOps talent, ensuring the function matures from reactive problem-solving to predictive, insight-driven operations.

What You’ll Do

  • Lead Enterprise Strategy & Planning: Own the annual strategy and planning cycle — from long-range vision to yearly investment allocation.

  • Drive Strategic Execution: Govern the company’s OKR and business review process to ensure accountability and measurable progress toward strategy.

  • Oversee Strategic Initiative Portfolio: Manage cross-functional initiatives that advance Instructure’s strategic priorities; align resources and resolve execution bottlenecks.

  • Operationalize Visibility: Build and continuously evolve the enterprise “Strategy Scorecard” and shared dashboards to quantify progress and impact.

  • Build Organizational Maturity: Establish consistent systems, processes, and decision-rights frameworks to move the company from reactive to managed to strategic.

  • Coach & Influence: Serve as a trusted advisor to senior leadership; lead, mentor, and scale the BizOps team; drive cultural adoption of data-informed, strategy-driven execution.

What you will need to know/have:

  • 5+ years of experience in management consulting, corporate strategy, or business operations at a high-growth SaaS company.

  • Proven success leading large-scale cross-functional programs with executive visibility.

  • Analytical and structured problem solver who can convert insight into action.

  • Highly skilled communicator able to influence at the executive level.

  • Track record of building operational systems and governance models at scale.

  • Comfortable balancing enterprise strategic thinking with hands-on execution.

Get in on all the awesome at Instructure!

We offer competitive, meaningful benefits in every country where we operate. While they vary by location, here's a general idea of what you can expect:

  • Competitive compensation, plus all full-time employees participate in our ownership program - because everyone should have a stake in our success.

  • Flexible work culture. Our remote, hybrid and in-office collaboration spaces vary by role, team and location.

  • Generous time off, including local holidays and our annual “Dim the Lights” period in late December, when teams are encouraged to step back and recharge based on departmental needs.

  • Comprehensive wellness programs and mental health support

  • Learning and development resources, including professional development tools and tuition reimbursement, to support your growth

  • The technology and tools you need to do your best work

  • Motivosity employee recognition program

  • A culture rooted in inclusivity, support, and meaningful connection

We believe in hiring great people and treating them right. The more diverse we are, the better our ideas and outcomes.

Instructure is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We comply with applicable employment and anti-discrimination laws in every country where we operate.

All employees must pass a background check as part of the hiring process. To help protect our teams and systems, we’ve implemented identity verification measures. Candidates may be asked to verify their legal name, current physical location, and provide a valid contact number and residential address, in accordance with local data privacy laws.

Any attempt to misrepresent personal or professional information will result in disqualification.

jobs.jobDescription:
Collibra is the Enterprise AI Control Plane. Built over eighteen years of meta-data and ontology engineering, Collibra governs context and control across any data storage system, AI model, and AI agent. Collibra delivers clarity and context to AI leaders who need data certainty at the speed of AI. A 5x Forrester Wave Leader and 2x Gartner Magic Quadrant Leader, Collibra serves more than 700 customers, including 78 of the Fortune 500, and governs more than 2 billion assets.

Collibra Public Sector LLC is the purpose-built subsidiary that serves US federal government agencies and the Defense Industrial Base. Collibra Public Sector is a FOCI-mitigated entity with a DCSA facility clearance. Collibra Public Sector personnel service clients in some of the most demanding mission organizations. Collibra Public Sector products, people and partners are uniquely positioned to deliver software and services solutions to the US federal market.

Join Collibra Public Sector

Benefits at Collibra

jobs.jobDescription:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About the Success Operations Team

Success Operations shapes how Thumbtack’s Success organization runs. We design the strategies, programs, and processes that help pros and customers realize value quickly and predictably. Our team partners across Sales, Success, Service, Partnerships, Product, Data Science, and Finance to create clarity, alignment, and an operating rhythm that keeps the marketplace healthy.

We focus on building reliable processes, defining clear success metrics, generating insights that guide decisions, and driving the cross functional execution needed to improve marketplace outcomes. Our work ensures the Success organization operates consistently, scales effectively, and delivers meaningful impact for both sides of the marketplace.

About the role

We are looking for a Sr. Manager of Success Operations to own the strategy, tooling, and process that support our frontline teams across Manual Ops, Partnership Experiments, and the broader Experiments function that serves all of Success, plus the supply health model and levers that keep pro supply ready as more partners come online. You’ll lead a team of senior operations analysts and report to the Director of Success Operations. This role is about bringing structure to chaos: you're comfortable working in a highly entrepreneurial, highly ambiguous, highly versatile environment and building new processes from the ground up, rather than optimizing an already steady-state program. You'll decide where AI genuinely reduces manual load and where a human needs to stay in the loop. You will also shape team capabilities, leadership effectiveness, and talent decisions required to scale this work across Success.

What you’ll do

  • Set the strategy, tooling, and outcome goals for the operations behind our biggest growth areas: launching and scaling new partner motions, keeping the supply of qualified pros ready, running the hands-on fulfillment that ensures jobs get matched and completed, and driving the test-and-learn engine that improves programs across Success.

  • Serve as the single Commercial Ops liaison to Partnerships, translating new partner commitments and growth spikes into staffed, tooled, supply-ready frontline execution.

  • Lead execution across Success, Partnerships, Product, Data Science, and Finance, resolving dependencies and adapting priorities as partner volume and supply needs change.

  • Oversee the supply health model, dashboard, and levers, directing where to acquire, reactivate, or adjust pricing and job-fit while giving leaders a clear view of coverage, gaps, and required actions.

  • Own headcount and capacity forecasting, business reviews, and executive narratives that translate fulfillment and supply signals into staffing plans and actionable directives.

  • Set the test-and-learn strategy for fulfillment approaches, go-to-market motions, AI-enabled workflows, and automation, determining when to pilot manually and when to invest in scalable solutions.

  • Lead and evolve a high-performing team of senior individual contributors, and/or operations analysts through strategic hiring, coaching, performance management, role clarity, and team-composition decisions.

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • 7+ years in Customer Success Operations, Marketplace Operations, Revenue Operations, Business Operations, or similar roles, including experience managing senior individual contributors.

  • A background that blends strategic thinking with hands-on operations (for example strategy and operations, management consulting, or a GM or founder role), with a track record of breaking down ambiguous, high-complexity problems and turning them into clear, executable plans.

  • Experience in a two-sided marketplace, gig economy platform, or fast-moving consumer/SMB ecosystem, ideally one that was supply-constrained or required balancing supply and demand.

  • Track record of standing up a new operational motion under time pressure, shipping an imperfect version fast and iterating rather than waiting for a fully built system.

  • Quantitative fluency: comfortable enough with coverage ratios, propensity or probability-based models, or similar frameworks to direct someone building one and sanity-check their output yourself.

  • Hands-on experience shipping an AI-enabled workflow or automation in an operations context, including the judgment to know when automation isn't the right call.

  • Strong executive presence and a track record of changing senior stakeholders' minds with data rather than title or authority.

Expected salary ranges

  • For candidates living in San Francisco / Bay Area, San Jose, New York City, or Seattle metros, the expected salary range for the role is currently $190,400 - $246,400.

  • For candidates living in Austin, TX or Washington DC metros or in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, or Washington states, the expected salary range for the role is currently $171,700 - $222,200

  • For candidates living in all other US locations, the expected salary range for this role is currently $161,500 - $209,000

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.
