jobs.jobDescription:
About Kaseya

Kaseya is the leading provider of AI-powered IT management and cybersecurity software, serving Managed Service Providers (MSPs) and internal IT organizations worldwide. Our comprehensive platform helps organizations efficiently manage, secure, and automate their IT environments, driving operational efficiency and long-term business success.

Backed by Insight Partners, a leading global software investor, Kaseya has experienced sustained double-digit growth and continues to expand its global footprint. Today, Kaseya supports customers in more than 20 countries and manages over 15 million endpoints worldwide.

Founded in 2000, Kaseya was built by builders - and we're still building. We look for people who create rather than wait, who see a hard problem and lean in, and who treat challenges as raw material. At Kaseya, everyone plays a role in shaping the future of IT: whether you're in engineering, product, sales, marketing, customer support, or operations, your work helps protect, defend, and optimize IT environments across the globe.

We're building teams that grow, perform, and make an impact. If you're driven by the itch to make things better - a product, a process, a career - you'll fit right in.

At Kaseya, we don't just raise the bar. We build it.

Position Summary

Kaseya is seeking a strategic, detail-oriented Product Manager to join our Business Information Systems (BIS) team. This individual will drive the vision, roadmap, and execution of enterprise capabilities supporting our Product Business Systems (PBS), with a focus on product configuration, pricing, fulfillment, software provisioning, entitlements, usage, and overage management.

This role will support Kaseya’s current operating environment while helping shape the future-state architecture and processes needed to support continued growth and transformation. PBS capabilities span multiple platforms, including Salesforce, NetSuite, integrations, and Kaseya products such as Kaseya One. As Kaseya evolves its enterprise systems landscape, this individual will help guide the transition toward a scalable architecture anchored by Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Oracle ERP, and related applications.

The ideal candidate brings a strong understanding of the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle within an enterprise SaaS environment, including product and pricing configuration, bundle management, software license provisioning, entitlement management, and usage-based billing. This person must be comfortable navigating complex integrations, balancing competing priorities, and partnering across business and technical teams to simplify legacy processes, strengthen controls, and deliver scalable solutions.

Key Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy and Roadmap: Define and manage the product roadmap for Product and Pricing, Fulfillment, and Provisioning capabilities, ensuring alignment with corporate strategy, revenue operations priorities, finance transformation goals, customer experience improvements, and future-state migration objectives.
  • Product and Pricing Management: Lead capabilities related to product configuration, catalog management, SKU creation, product hierarchies, master data governance, pricing models, discount management, renewal pricing, promotions, and bundle configuration.
  • Fulfillment and Provisioning: Drive requirements and solutions for automated, manual, and hybrid provisioning models, fulfillment routing, tenant and instance creation, customer-to-tenant mapping, license provisioning, and entitlement lifecycle management.
  • Lead-to-Cash Lifecycle: Lead requirements definition and solution alignment across the Lead-to-Cash lifecycle, including product and pricing setup, order fulfillment, provisioning, usage capture, overage management, billing, revenue recognition, and reporting.
  • Product Ownership and Agile Delivery: Own and manage the product backlog, develop clear user stories and acceptance criteria, and lead backlog refinement, sprint planning, discovery sessions, solution reviews, demonstrations, and other Agile ceremonies.
  • Systems and Integration Management: Serve as a subject matter expert across current and future-state platforms, including Salesforce, Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced, NetSuite, Oracle ERP, MuleSoft, Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC), Kaseya One, and related applications. Partner with technical teams to ensure reliable integrations and consistent data flows.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner with Finance, Billing Operations, Revenue Operations, Sales Operations, Customer Operations, Product, Engineering, Enterprise Architecture, Security, and IT to gather requirements, prioritize initiatives, resolve issues, and deliver scalable business outcomes.
  • Business Process Optimization: Identify opportunities to simplify workflows, reduce manual intervention, clarify ownership, improve operational handoffs, strengthen governance, and increase automation across PBS capabilities.
  • Transformation and Migration Readiness: Balance support for legacy systems with future-state transformation priorities, ensuring legacy enhancements deliver measurable value, reduce operational risk, or improve migration readiness.
  • Governance, Risk, and Compliance: Ensure solutions align with enterprise policies, internal controls, data privacy, and security requirements. Maintain clear documentation of requirements, business rules, integration dependencies, decisions, testing coverage, and operational readiness.
  • Continuous Improvement: Monitor system performance, user adoption, data quality, defect trends, billing accuracy, provisioning effectiveness, and operational outcomes to identify opportunities for improvement and scalability.
  • Delivery and Stakeholder Alignment: Partner with Engineering Leads, QA, Scrum Masters, Business Process Leads, and Release/PMO teams to manage dependencies, remove blockers, coordinate testing, and deliver capabilities aligned with business objectives and release milestones.

Required Qualifications

  • 7+ years of experience in product management, product ownership, business systems analysis, CRM systems, revenue operations systems, or enterprise solution delivery.
  • Proven experience with Lead-to-Cash, Quote-to-Cash, or subscription lifecycle processes within an enterprise SaaS environment.
  • Strong working knowledge of Salesforce CPQ, Salesforce Revenue Cloud, Revenue Cloud Advanced, or comparable enterprise product configuration and pricing platforms.
  • Experience with product catalog management, SKU management, pricing configuration, discounting, bundle management, or product master data governance.
  • Hands-on experience with software license provisioning, entitlement management, or fulfillment workflows, including integrations using platforms such as MuleSoft or Boomi.
  • Experience with usage-based pricing models, including usage capture, rating, overage management, and associated billing or revenue processes.
  • Understanding of integrated system flows across sales, order management, billing, accounts receivable, collections, revenue recognition, and reporting.
  • Demonstrated success managing cross-functional Agile delivery teams and driving complex enterprise initiatives from requirements through implementation.
  • Strong understanding of business process mapping, technical integrations, data dependencies, user stories, acceptance criteria, and system controls.
  • Excellent communication, stakeholder management, and problem-solving skills, with the ability to influence decisions and drive alignment across business and technical teams.
  • Ability to operate effectively in a fast-paced, evolving environment while balancing business-as-usual support, competing priorities, and future-state transformation initiatives.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience with Salesforce Revenue Cloud Advanced (RCA), Salesforce Commerce Cloud, Oracle ERP, NetSuite, MuleSoft, or Oracle Integration Cloud (OIC).
  • Experience supporting enterprise SaaS subscription models, managed service providers (MSPs), usage-based billing, and customer lifecycle processes.
  • Familiarity with Kaseya One or comparable software provisioning, entitlement, and license management platforms.
  • Experience with revenue operations, billing operations, finance transformation, or enterprise business systems within a complex, integrated technology environment.
  • Experience supporting enterprise architecture modernization, legacy platform transitions, data governance initiatives, and large-scale systems migration.
  • Knowledge of revenue recognition and billing metadata requirements associated with product, pricing, usage, and subscription management.

Additional information
Kaseya provides equal employment opportunity to all employees and applicants without regard to race, religion, age, ancestry, gender, sex, sexual orientation, national origin, citizenship status, physical or mental disability, veteran status, marital status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Cloudinary is the Image and Video API platform trusted by millions of developers and over 10,000 companies worldwide. Our powerful tools fuel websites to be faster, richer in user engagement, and breakthrough creativity. With a growing suite of products that support everything from developer efficiency to brand storytelling, Cloudinary is becoming the visual layer of the web.

Cloudinary has a globally distributed team across North America, EMEA, and Asia-Pacific, united by a shared commitment to building smart, scalable technology and a culture rooted in humility, curiosity, and collaboration. At Cloudinary, we celebrate Life & Work. We believe in healthy growth, working with purpose, and creating meaningful value. If you’re looking for a place where your voice matters and your work truly makes an impact, this may be the opportunity for you.

Cloudinary is looking for a Director, New Business Operations to make our New Business organization more predictable, focused, and effective as we scale. You will own the operating system behind our New Business motions - the processes, data, cadence, and tools that help leaders and sellers turn pipeline into ARR.

Reporting to the VP, Revenue Operations & Enablement, you will be the operating partner to New Business leadership, Account Executives, and Sales Engineers. You will work cross-functionally with Marketing, Pricing, Finance, IT, Legal, Data, Enablement, and Channels & Alliances to improve how the business runs.

This role is ideal for a hands-on operator who combines sales-operations expertise, analytical judgment, cross-functional execution, and a high bar for clarity and adoption. You will build the systems and rhythms that make it easier to inspect performance, resolve blockers, and improve field execution without owning the sale itself.

Responsibilities:

• Own and evolve the operating model and cadence for all New Business motions, including standards, agendas, decision rights, and priorities.

• Lead forecast readiness and opportunity inspection, giving leaders an accurate, timely view of performance, risk, upside, stage progression, qualification, next steps, close dates, and opportunity health.

• Improve pipeline hygiene, opportunity completeness, and Salesforce data quality; combine Account Executive, Sales Engineer, and system signals to surface deal risk, blockers, and forecast changes early.

• Build and curate reporting that drives decisions, consolidating redundant dashboards into clear, useful views for New Business leaders and the field.

• Lead cross-functional initiatives involving CRM, CPQ, RFPs, pricing, and other GTM systems and processes from problem definition through delivery and adoption.

• Translate field needs into clear requirements, acceptance criteria, and success measures; coordinate owners, make tradeoffs visible, remove blockers, and escalate decisions with context.

• Partner with Marketing, Enablement, and Channels & Alliances to align handoffs and shared workflows, and convert field feedback into a prioritized improvement backlog.

• Create durable playbooks and inspection mechanisms; measure adoption, data quality, forecast accuracy, and process performance, and use the evidence to improve the operating model.

About You:

• Bachelor's degree or equivalent practical experience, plus 10+ years of progressive experience in Business Operations, Sales Strategy, or related roles in B2B SaaS or technology companies.

• Experience owning or materially shaping the operating model for New Business or enterprise sales motions.

• Strong experience with forecasting, pipeline management, opportunity inspection, and revenue-process discipline.

• Salesforce experience and familiarity with GTM systems such as CPQ and RFP tools, are highly desired.

• A proven ability to lead complex, cross-functional initiatives from requirements through delivery, adoption, and measurable outcomes.

• Strong analytical and data-storytelling skills, with the judgment to distinguish useful decision support from reporting noise.

• Exceptional stakeholder-management, written, and verbal communication skills, with the ability to create alignment and accountability without direct authority.

• Comfort moving between executive-level framing and detailed execution, with a high bar for clarity, urgency, organization, and follow-through.

Nice to Have:

• Experience supporting global, technical, or developer-focused sales organizations.

• Experience simplifying and increasing efficiencies of GTM processes.

• Familiarity with Cloudinary's market, including APIs, cloud technologies, digital asset management, or media workflows.

Awesome technology

Top-talent peers

100% sponsored medical, dental, and vision plans for employees & family

HSA company contribution

Matching 401k program

Robust vacation & wellness policy

Annual development stipend

Catered lunches or a food stipend

About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is hiring a Chief of Staff to report to the CEO and partner with the Executive Leadership Team (ELT) as the company continues to scale. This is a senior, individual contributor role for a strategic operator and trusted advisor who thrives at the intersection of strategy, execution, communication, and data.

As Chief of Staff, you’ll help translate company strategy into action, shape executive-level planning and decision-making, and ensure leadership discussions are grounded in clear insights and high-quality materials. You’ll operate with significant autonomy, exercise wide latitude in how work gets done, and act as a thought partner to senior leaders across the organization.

This role is ideal for someone with deep experience navigating complex, cross-functional environments and a strong executive presence who is excited to have broad influence without people management responsibilities.

Responsibilities:

Strategic Leadership & Cross-Functional Execution

  • Partner with the CEO to drive company-wide strategic initiatives from conception through execution. Help align the Executive Leadership Team and broader organization around priorities, tradeoffs, and outcomes. Proactively identify risks, dependencies, and gaps across critical initiatives and surface insights to leadership. Act as connective tissue across executives and teams to ensure strategy translates into coordinated action.

Operating Cadence & Company Planning

  • Shape and support LaunchDarkly’s operating rhythm, including owning OKRs and leadership planning processes.
  • Design and evolve planning frameworks that enable effective executive decision-making.
  • Support annual and long-range planning cycles, synthesizing inputs and highlighting strategic implications.

Executive & Company Communications

  • Lead the preparation and refinement of executive-level materials, including Board meeting materials and ELT presentations. Ensure executive content is clear, concise, decision-oriented, and aligned with company strategy.

Data, Insights & Analysis

  • Partner on executive dashboards and reporting, ensuring metrics are accurate, consistent, and actionable.
  • Analyze and understand data to inform strategic decisions and evaluate proposed initiatives.
  • Translate analysis into clear recommendations for senior leadership audiences.

Executive Meetings & Offsites

  • Design agendas and content for executive meetings and off-sites with a focus on alignment and outcomes.
  • Capture key decisions, clarify next steps, and support follow-through across the organization.

Qualifications:

  • Typically requires a minimum of 15 years of related experience, preferably in senior-level roles involving strategy, operations, consulting, finance, product operations, or executive advisory work.
  • Demonstrated success partnering closely with executive leaders and influencing at the highest levels of an organization.
  • Exceptional written and verbal communication skills, with the ability to distill complexity into clear, compelling narratives.
  • Strong analytical capabilities and comfort working with SaaS metrics and executive-level data.
  • Ability to manage multiple, high-impact workstreams with sound judgment and prioritization.
  • High degree of discretion, integrity, and emotional intelligence.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level 6:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $240,600 - $330,700**
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $216,500 - $297,600**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $204,500 - 281,100**
  • All Zones Inclusive of 10% Bonus Target

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

At LaunchDarkly, we believe in the power of teams. We're building a team that is humble, open, collaborative, respectful and kind. THE COMPANY:

Juul Labs's mission is to transition the world’s billion adult smokers away from combustible cigarettes, eliminate their use, and combat underage usage of our products. We have the opportunity to address one of the world’s most intractable challenges through a commitment to exceptional quality, research, design, and innovation. Backed by leading technology investors, we are committed to the same excellence when it comes to hiring great talent.

We are a diverse team that is united by this common purpose and we are hiring the world’s best engineers, scientists, designers, product managers, operations experts, and customer service and business professionals. If the opportunity to build your career is compelling, read on for more details.

The Senior Manager, Commercial Capabilities is a hands-on leader responsible for managing and optimizing the tools and platforms that support the US Commercial organization. Reporting to the Sr. Director, Commercial Planning & PMO, this role is focused on CRM administration and roadmap ownership for Commercial technology improvements. The Senior Manager will work closely with Commercial leadership, IT, and external vendors to maintain and enhance our Commercial technologies.

The ideal candidate brings either solid software engineering experience applied to Commercial systems, or strong process operations skills with hands-on experience in enterprise technology platforms — paired in both cases with cross-functional collaboration skills and the ability to lead a small team.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES:

Commercial Systems Operations & Planning

  • Support and contribute to the Commercial Systems roadmap, encompassing CRM (Salesforce) and other technology systems and tools
  • Partner with Commercial Strategy, Revenue Management, Sales Leadership, and other cross-functional teams to translate business needs into practical technology solutions
  • Assist in build vs. buy evaluations for new tool investments, summarizing trade-offs for leadership review
  • Ensure platforms are well-documented, integrated, and maintained for long-term sustainability

Salesforce Platform Management

  • Manage ongoing development, configuration, and optimization of the Salesforce platform to support field sales effectiveness and optimization of Commercial effectiveness
  • Lead requirements gathering, solution design, user story development, and UAT for Salesforce workstreams
  • Own release management, platform documentation, and end-user training to ensure adoption and data integrity
  • Partner with the JLI IT team to ensure sound integrations between Salesforce and adjacent platforms including ERP, data warehouses, and third-party analytics tools

Tool Development & Delivery Oversight

  • Support the design and delivery of custom-built internal tools where Commercial needs exceed off-the-shelf capabilities
  • Define technical requirements and coordinate with development teams or vendors to execute software builds
  • Help establish engineering standards, QA processes, and release cadences for internally developed tools
  • Ensure custom solutions integrate with the broader commercial systems ecosystem

AI Roadmap for Commercial

  • Develop and maintain the AI roadmap for the Commercial function, identifying high-value use cases such as account prioritization, lead and opportunity scoring, rep coaching, territory planning, content generation, and field reporting.
  • Partner with IT, Data, and external vendors to evaluate AI solutions; lead pilots and define the criteria for scale.
  • Champion responsible adoption — building field confidence, managing change, measuring impact, and iterating based on user feedback.

Cross-Functional Stakeholder Collaboration

  • Partner with Commercial teams and functional partners to identify systems needs and maintain alignment on priorities
  • Translate technical concepts into clear business language for management audiences; translate business requirements into technical specifications for development teams
  • Collaborate with PMO and Commercial Planning functions to align systems delivery with commercial initiatives

Team & Vendor Coordination

  • Lead and develop a small team of Salesforce administrators and systems analysts
  • Coordinate with external development vendors, system integrators, and technology partners
  • Track platform budgets, project milestones, and delivery progress across active workstreams
  • Perform related duties as assigned, within your scope of practice

PERSONAL AND PROFESSIONAL QUALIFICATIONS:

We are open to candidates from two primary backgrounds — what matters most is the combination of systems thinking, collaborative leadership, and a track record of delivery.

Process Architecture / Operations Track

  • 8+ years of experience in sales operations, revenue operations, commercial strategy, or management consulting with a strong technology component
  • Strong process design skills — ability to map and operationalize commercial workflows across organizations
  • Proven ability to define requirements for and oversee delivery of systems projects
  • Experience coordinating with technical development teams or vendors against a defined roadmap
  • Solid fluency with enterprise platforms (CRM, ERP, BI/analytics) and ability to support technology evaluation decisions

Technical / Engineering Track

  • 8+ years of experience in software engineering, commercial systems development, or enterprise technology
  • Demonstrated experience building or supporting full-stack or enterprise applications in a commercial context
  • Familiarity with Salesforce and the ability to contribute to platform-level design decisions
  • Exposure to ERP systems (SAP, Oracle, NetSuite) and cross-platform integrations
  • Working knowledge of API design, data modeling, and systems integration patterns

Required for All Candidates

  • Senior Manager-level stakeholder management, including regular engagement with Director/VP-level commercial leaders
  • Salesforce certification strongly preferred
  • Demonstrated ability to manage concurrent technology projects on time and within budget
  • Strong verbal, written, and presentation skills with attention to detail
  • Comfort navigating ambiguity and building structure in a fast-moving commercial environment

EDUCATION:

  • Bachelor's degree required; Computer Science, Engineering, Information Systems, or Business preferred
  • MBA or advanced degree a plus, not required

JUUL LABS PERKS & BENEFITS:

  • A place to grow your career. We’ll help you set big goals - and exceed them
  • People. Work with talented, committed and supportive teammates
  • Equity and performance bonuses. Every employee is a stakeholder in our success
  • Cell phone subsidy, commuter benefits and discounts on JUUL products
  • Excellent medical, dental and vision, disability, and life insurance, plus family support, wellness, legal, and employee assistance program benefits
  • 401(k) plan with company matching
  • Plus biannual discretionary performance bonuses

jobs.jobDescription:
Are you ready to unlock intelligence?

If you don’t think you meet all of the criteria below but are still interested in the job, please apply. Nobody checks every box - we’re looking for candidates that are particularly strong in a few areas, and have some interest and capabilities in others.

The Mission:

Kong is building the future of AI connectivity, empowering developers to connect, secure, and scale their applications with speed and intelligence. We are hiring a Product Manager, Billing to lead the product and systems work behind how Konnect makes money: entitlements, metering, checkout, invoicing, provisioning, and the enterprise and marketplace motions that surround them.

In this role you are the product owner of Konnect's commercial operating layer: the systems that translate what Sales sells and what customers use into what ends up on an invoice. That means plan and entitlement design, the usage metering pipeline, self-serve checkout and subscription lifecycle, customer organization and billing admin experiences, enterprise billing workflows (CPQ sync, custom contracts), and cloud marketplace billing. You will work hand-in-hand with Product Growth, Pricing & Packaging, Finance, GTM, Sales, and Engineering.

This role reports to the Sr Director, Product (Platform) and sits at the intersection of two multi-year transformations: Kong's move from a single-product API gateway company into a multi-product enterprise, and Monetization's company-wide overhaul of pricing and packaging. The Billing, Provisioning, and Fulfillment program has historically been manual and relationship-driven. Your job is to turn it into a product, so Sales can sell more, Finance can bill more accurately, and customers get an experience that matches the quality of what they are paying for.

What You’ll Do:

  • Platform Vision: Set a multi-year direction for how Konnect prices, meters, entitles, and invoices. Decide what becomes shared platform capability versus what stays feature-specific, and sequence delivery so near-term work lands without creating long-term drag.

  • Unified Entitlements: Build the entitlements model that determines what every customer can access within Konnect. Make entitlements a first-class concept that is consistently defined in contracts, enforced in-product, honored by provisioning, and reflected in billing.

  • Pricing & Packaging Delivery: Act as the product and systems counterpart to Monetization. Translate pricing and packaging decisions into production reality: configuring plans, reshaping metering, updating contracts, coordinating customer migrations, and making sure a rollout doesn't disrupt existing revenue.

  • Metering & Usage Visibility: Run the event pipeline, aggregation layer, and reporting experiences that show customers what they consumed and what they are being charged. Hold a financial-grade bar on accuracy, auditability, and reconcilability.

  • Checkout & Subscription Lifecycle: Own how customers self-serve onto a plan, change plans, renew, lapse, and recover. That covers plan discovery, checkout, the underlying payments integration, subscription state, retries and dunning, and the admin surfaces where customers manage their own billing.

  • Enterprise & Marketplace Motions: Connect Kong's enterprise sales and channel motions to the billing stack: CPQ-to-entitlement sync, bespoke contract handling, invoice-based billing, and marketplace billing across AWS, GCP, and Azure as we expand our presence there.

  • Fulfillment Automation: Replace today's manual, high-touch provisioning and fulfillment processes with productized, automated workflows. This includes migrating off our current metering and billing system onto a target stack that supports the new pricing and packaging framework.

  • Outcomes & Measurement: Define the health metrics for the domain, including net revenue retention, billing-driven churn, invoice dispute rate, collections aging, and billing support ticket load. Use them to set priorities and hold the team accountable for results.

What You’ll Bring:

  • Have at least 6 years of product management experience in SaaS, with 2 or more spent directly in a billing, monetization, or pricing domain.

  • Can reason about the moving parts of a billing stack well enough to co-design the architecture with your engineering partner.

  • Have carried a pricing or packaging change from proposal through to production, including financial modeling, plan configuration, grandfathering logic, migrations, sales enablement, and customer communication.

  • Have built or scaled consumption-based monetization and understand the tradeoffs between simplicity, accuracy, and customer trust when metering drives the invoice.

  • Pull your own numbers when you need them (SQL, Snowflake, Hex, or equivalent) and use data to set priorities rather than to decorate decisions already made.

  • Have worked directly with Stripe or a metered billing platform (Metronome, Orb, OpenMeter), not through an engineer.

  • Hold billing surfaces (plan pages, checkouts, invoices, usage dashboards) to the same design standard as the rest of the product.

  • Have worked in or adjacent to API, infrastructure, or developer-platform products, and are comfortable with the technical context that comes with that territory.

  • Independently define and execute the long-term vision to bring billing, fulfillment, and provisioning to best-in-class for the company's success.

Bonus Points:

  • Experience leading an end-to-end pricing transformation or building a billing system from scratch.

  • Shipped cloud marketplace integrations (AWS, GCP, Azure) or Salesforce CPQ-to-billing integrations.

  • Proficiency using LLMs and coding agents as part of your day-to-day product management workflow.

#LI-AW1

About Kong:

Kong Inc., the AI Connectivity Company, is building the connectivity layer of AI. Trusted by the Fortune 500® and AI-native startups alike, Kong’s unified API and AI platform enables organizations to secure, manage, accelerate, govern, and monetize the flow of intelligence across APIs and AI traffic — on any model, any cloud. For more information, visit www.konghq.com.

jobs.jobDescription:
Reddit is a community of communities. It’s built on shared interests, passion, and trust, and is home to the most open and authentic conversations on the internet. Every day, Reddit users submit, vote, and comment on the topics they care most about. With 100,000+ active communities and approximately 130 million daily active unique visitors, Reddit is one of the internet’s largest sources of information. For more information, visit www.redditinc.com.

About the Role

Reddit is looking for a Group Product Manager to lead the product management of our Finance SaaS portfolio, our systems that run treasury, planning, procure-to-pay, record-to-report, quote-to-cash, payroll, and equity. This is a player-coach role: you'll coach and manage a small team of SaaS product managers who each own a domain of Finance's application stack, while personally owning your own set of applications as a player. This role serves as the orchestration layer for Finance and AI Transformation, requiring you to advise senior executives, influence strategic direction, and navigate complex matrixed environments to translate high-level strategy into measurable business outcomes.

You set the product vision and roadmap across the Finance SaaS landscape, decide what gets built and bought, drive adoption, and own the vendor relationships that underpin the stack. You partner closely with the Enterprise Architecture & Engineering team. They own how systems are built and integrated; you own what we build, why, and when.

You will be at the forefront of our AI-first finance strategy, championing the next generation of intelligent automation to redefine efficiency and scalability across our global operations. If you're energized by translating complex finance processes into clean, well-run systems, thrive at the seam between business and technology, and want to both lead a team and stay close to the product yourself, this role is for you.

What You'll Do

Product Strategy & Portfolio Ownership

  • Own the end-to-end product vision and multi-quarter roadmap for Reddit's Finance SaaS portfolio across P2P, R2R, QTC, payroll & equity, and treasury/investments/EPM.
  • As the lead for Finance & AI Transformation, you are the catalyst for shifting Reddit’s finance teams from manual processes to AI-enabled workflows. This includes championing a “finance engineer” mindset, proactively identifying AI use cases for close automation and anomaly detection, and fostering a culture where data-driven innovation is embedded in our operating model.
  • Translate Finance's priorities (e.g., close acceleration, scalability, public-company rigor, M&A) into a sequenced, defensible roadmap.
  • Lead build-vs-buy and vendor selection decisions; serve as the product voice in Finance technology investments alongside the Enterprise Architect.
  • Define and enforce a consistent product operating model across the team: intake, prioritization, release management, change management, and adoption measurement.
  • Identify opportunities to improve Finance processes through AI-enabled workflows, reconciliations, anomaly detection, approval copilots, and close automation.
  • Drive roadmap prioritization using measurable outcomes such as close cycle reduction, automation rates, SOX compliance effectiveness, and Finance productivity improvements.
  • Establish a single, transparent demand pipeline so Finance stakeholders can see what's planned, in flight, and shipped.
  • Assess the end-to-end finance processes to identify manual workflows, process gaps, control weaknesses, data quality issues, and opportunities to improve and enable AI-powered solutions..
  • Create a cross-functional decision framework for Finance capabilities, including clear ownership, intake, prioritization, readiness criteria, and business sign-off.
  • Identify, design, and launch new features and system capabilities that enhance user efficiency while driving incremental value for the business.
  • Partner with finance leadership to enable AI use across teams, fundamentally shifting the organization toward a "finance engineer" mindset where finance teams are empowered to build, automate, and innovate within our systems.
  • Drive end-to-end finance transformation initiatives across Quote-to-Cash (QTC), Procure-to-Pay (P2P), Record-to-Report (R2R), and Hire-to-Retire (H2R), ensuring alignment between process improvements and long-term scalability.

Strategic Orchestration & Influence

  • Advise senior Finance and Tech leadership on roadmap trade-offs, balancing speed, risk, and long-term impact.
  • Navigate organizational dynamics to secure alignment across Finance, Tech, and Business partners.
  • Promote harmony between internal teams and external integration partners by resolving bottlenecks and managing cross-functional dependencies.
  • Lead a rigorous diligence program to evaluate and optimize system performance, workflows, and adoption metrics to strengthen operational quality.

Team Leadership

  • Directly manage a team of SaaS product managers, each owning a Finance domain (P2P & R2R, QTC, Payroll & Equity).
  • Set clear direction and priorities for each domain, and create space for deep, high-quality product work.
  • Develop your team's craft through roadmap review, stakeholder coaching, and regular 1:1s focused on growth.
  • Serve as an escalation point and thought partner when your PMs hit ambiguity, contention over priorities, or cross-functional friction.
  • Build the bench: define the team's coverage model, identify gaps, and grow the function as Finance scales.

Hands-On Product Ownership:

  • Maintain direct ownership over a specific set of applications, leading their product roadmaps and managing key stakeholder relationships.
  • This isn't a purely managerial role: you'll run intake, prioritize enhancements, manage releases, and partner directly with Finance and the Eng team to deliver in your own portfolio.
  • Stay close enough to the work to credibly coach your team and make sharp product tradeoffs.

Vendor and Demand Management

  • Own Finance SaaS vendor relationships at the portfolio level: renewals, SLAs, roadmap influence, escalations, and spend rationalization.
  • Bring a demand-management mindset to intake; help Finance stakeholders articulate needs, size effort, and sequence work effectively rather than absorbing every request.
  • Partner with Procurement and Finance leadership on tooling spend, contract timing, and consolidation opportunities.
  • Maintain a clear view of total cost of ownership and license utilization across the stack.

Stakeholder Partnership

  • Act as the primary product liaison for Finance leadership, translating business requirements into roadmap decisions and communicating tradeoffs clearly.
  • Partner with FP&A, Technical Accounting, Revenue, Treasury, Payroll, and Finance Operations to understand pain points and proactively surface system improvements.
  • Work hand-in-glove with the Enterprise Architect and Engineering team to land integrations, data quality, and technical delivery against the product roadmap.
  • Support M&A activity (e.g., systems due diligence, gap analysis, integration sequencing, and adoption planning for acquired entities).

What We're Looking For

  • 8+ years in product management, business/finance systems, or finance transformation, including 2+ years directly managing people.
  • Demonstrated ownership of Finance SaaS platforms across multiple domains (ERP, EPM/CPM, procure-to-pay, order-to-cash, treasury, or payroll).
  • Track record of building and running a product/intake operating model: roadmaps, prioritization frameworks, release and change management.
  • Strong vendor management chops: selection, renewals, SLAs, and influencing vendor roadmaps
  • Prior people management experience, with a track record of developing PM or systems-analyst talent.
  • Strong ability to operate across abstraction levels: comfortable in an executive roadmap discussion and in the configuration details of a specific platform.
  • Excellent communication skills: you can frame a portfolio strategy for a CFO and a sprint priority for an engineer in the same afternoon.
  • Strong knowledge of financial controls, audit readiness, SOX requirements, data quality, and compliance impacts.
  • Experience defining close transformation roadmaps, reconciliation strategies, reporting readiness plans, and UAT strategies.
  • Proven success scaling products and owning business outcomes in high-growth, complex environments.

Bonus Points

  • Experience at a high-growth public technology company
  • Familiarity with Reddit's existing Finance tech stack (NetSuite, Workato, Adaptive, Zip, Coupa, Ramp, Workday, Salesforce or comparable) or similar environments
  • Familiarity with advertising platforms and transformation initiatives spanning quote-to-cash or procure-to-pay workflows
  • Experience supporting M&A workstreams (diligence, integration, cutover)
  • Exposure to SOX compliance considerations in finance systems
  • Background partnering with Corporate Engineering or shared-services models

Why This Role, Why Reddit

Reddit's Finance organization is scaling rapidly through organic growth, internal investments, and increasing public-company rigor. This role offers a unique opportunity to shape how Finance technology evolves at a consequential moment: owning the product direction for a portfolio that touches every corner of the company, leading a team, and keeping your own hands on the work.

You'll have the autonomy to set direction, the team support to execute, and the organizational access to make product decisions that stick.

Pay Transparency:

This job posting may span more than one career level.

In addition to base salary, this job is eligible to receive equity in the form of restricted stock units, and depending on the position offered, it may also be eligible to receive a commission. Additionally, Reddit offers a wide range of benefits to U.S.-based employees, including medical, dental, and vision insurance, 401(k) program with employer match, generous time off for vacation, and parental leave. To learn more, please visit https://www.redditinc.com/careers/.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who We Are

Cobalt was founded on the belief of a fundamental human aspiration: the desire to live better and safer. It all started in 2013, when our founders realized that pentesting can be better. Today our diverse, fully remote team is committed to helping organizations of all sizes with seamless, effective and collaborative Offensive Security Testing that empower organizations to OPERATE FEARLESSLY and INNOVATE SECURELY.

Our customers can start a pentest in as little as 24 hours and integrate with advanced development cycles thanks to the powerful combination of our SaaS platform coupled with an exclusive community of testers known as the Cobalt Core. Accepting just 5% of applicants, the Cobalt Core boasts over 500 closely vetted and highly skilled testers who jointly conduct thousands of tests each year and are at the forefront of identifying and helping remediate risk across a dynamically changing attack surface.

Cobalt is an Equal Opportunity Employer and we strive to build a diverse and inclusive workforce at our company. At Cobalt we aspire to engage with diverse individuals, communities, and organizations in order to continue to nurture our unique rich diverse culture. Join our team, and be your true self to do your best work.

Description

Cobalt is hiring a Director of Product Management, Platform to own the product surfaces that connect our pentesting offerings to the rest of a customer's security and business stack, and that make those offerings easy to evaluate, configure, and scale. This is a newly created role on the Product leadership team, reporting to the VP of Product Management, with direct accountability for platform architecture decisions, the partner and integration ecosystem, pricing and packaging mechanics, access and permissions models, and the operational backbone (tooling, metrics, content) that the rest of Product relies on.

You will lead a team spanning Customer Experience, Product Operations, and Platform/Integrations PMs, and you will be the primary product partner to Engineering, Sales, Customer Success, and Security/Compliance stakeholders on anything that touches how customers connect to, configure, and pay for Cobalt. This is a high-visibility, build-and-scale role: you'll inherit a working integrations program (including a recently shipped Wiz integration) and a clear mandate to mature it into a defensible platform and ecosystem strategy.

What You'll Own

  • Platform & Integrations Strategy: Define and execute the roadmap for Cobalt's integration ecosystem (e.g., SFDC, Slack/MS Teams, ticketing and automation tools), including build-vs-partner decisions and a prioritization framework tied to revenue and retention impact.
  • Ecosystem & Partnerships: Own the product side of technology partnerships — API/webhook strategy, partner onboarding requirements, and joint roadmap alignment with strategic integration partners.
  • Pricing & Packaging: Partner with Finance, Sales, and the VP of Product to design and evolve pricing and packaging across the tiered portfolio, including credits, contracts, and tier-based feature and integration entitlements.
  • Roles, Permissions & Access (RBAC): Own the roadmap for role-based access control, authentication, and customer administration capabilities that meet enterprise security and compliance expectations.
  • Customer Experience Alignment: Absorb and elevate the Customer Focus charter — customer journey, scoping and calculator experience, findings/reports, asset and engagement management, and customer-facing catalogue — ensuring platform decisions are grounded in real customer workflows.
  • Product Operations Leadership: Oversee the operating rhythm of the Product org — roadmap cadence, QBRs, Product Hour, in-platform content (Pendo), technical publications, usage/experience metrics, and tooling/vendor contract management.
  • Team Leadership: Manage and develop a team of PMs and product operations professionals; set goals, coach for growth, and represent the team's roadmap to the VP of Product and cross-functional leadership.
  • Cross-Functional Execution: Partner closely with Engineering leads and Design to translate platform strategy into epics, acceptance criteria, and shippable releases, and with Customer Success/Sales to ensure GTM readiness for platform and integration launches.

What Success Looks Like in the First Year

  • A published platform and integration roadmap, prioritized against a clear framework, with at least one new strategic integration shipped.
  • A documented pricing/packaging model for tier-based feature and integration entitlements, adopted by Sales and Finance.
  • An RBAC and permissions framework that closes known enterprise/compliance gaps and is referenceable in security reviews.
  • A unified Product Operations cadence (roadmaps, QBR, Product Hour, usage metrics) running reliably across the org.
  • A team of PMs operating with clear ownership, a healthy backlog discipline, and strong cross-functional trust with Engineering, Design, and GTM.

You Must Have

  • 8+ years in product management, including 3+ years in a people-leadership role (Director, Group PM, or equivalent), ideally within B2B SaaS or cybersecurity.
  • Demonstrated experience owning platform, integrations, or ecosystem products — defining build-vs-partner tradeoffs and shipping API/webhook-based integrations at scale.
  • Direct experience with pricing and packaging design for a multi-tier or multi-product SaaS portfolio.
  • Working knowledge of access control, authentication, and enterprise security/compliance requirements (RBAC, SSO, SAML/OIDC) as they apply to product design.
  • A track record of leading product operations or platform functions that support an entire product organization (metrics, tooling, roadmap cadence), not just a single product line.
  • Strong cross-functional leadership skills — proven ability to align Engineering, Design, Sales, and Customer Success around a shared roadmap.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication; comfortable presenting strategy and tradeoffs to executive leadership.
  • Bonus: experience in cybersecurity, vulnerability management, or pentesting/offensive security domains; familiarity with Salesforce, Jira/Confluence, and Pendo.

Why You Should Join Us

  • Grow in a passionate, rapidly expanding industry operating at the forefront of the Pentesting industry
  • Work directly with experienced senior leaders with ongoing mentorship opportunities
  • Earn competitive compensation and an attractive equity plan
  • Save for the future with a 401(k) program (US) or pension (EU)
  • Benefit from medical, dental, vision and life insurance (US) or statutory healthcare (EU)
  • Leverage stipends for:
    • Wellness
    • Work-from-home equipment & wifi
    • Learning & development
  • Make the most of our flexible, generous paid time off and paid parental leave

Pay Range Disclosure (For US openings only)

Cobalt is committed to fair and equitable compensation practices. The salary range for this role is ($183,000 - $230,000) + equity + benefits. A candidate’s salary is determined by various factors including, but not limited to, relevant work experience, skills, and certifications. The salary range may differ in other states and may be impacted by proximity to major metropolitan cities.

Cobalt (the "Company") is an equal opportunity employer, and we want the best available persons for every job. The Company makes employment decisions only based on merit. It is the Company's policy to prohibit discrimination in any employment opportunity (including but not limited to recruitment, employment, promotion, salary increases, benefits, termination and all other terms and conditions of employment) based on race, color, sex, sexual orientation, gender, gender identity, gender expression, genetic information, pregnancy, religious creed, national origin, ancestry, age, physical/mental disability, medical condition, marital/domestic partner status, military and veteran status, height, weight or any other such characteristic protected by federal, state or local law. The Company is committed to complying with all applicable laws and providing equal employment opportunities. This commitment applies to all persons involved in the operations of the Company regardless of where the employee is located and prohibits unlawful discrimination by any employee of the Company.

jobs.jobDescription:
At Signifyd, we help merchants confidently grow their businesses by building trusted relationships with their customers. Our advanced technology, combined with a team genuinely invested in our clients’ success, creates frictionless shopping experiences, approving more good orders, protecting revenue, and keeping customers happy.

Trusted by thousands of leading merchants across more than 100 countries, we securely process billions of transactions each year. Our people are the heart of everything we do, driving our mission forward with commitment, empathy, and creativity. Join us on our mission to empower confident, fraud-free commerce by helping online retailers provide superior customer experiences and eliminate fraud. Learn about our company values here!

About the role

We are looking for a Senior Product Manager to own our authorization optimization product area, where payments and fraud decisioning meet. You will own authorization rate improvement for legitimate transactions. Set the strategy, prioritize the highest-value opportunities, and drive delivery across existing capability teams.

This is a hands-on, technical product role. You will translate strategy into precise requirements, define the data and API interfaces that connect us with merchants, payment service providers and issuers, and be the product voice in architecture discussions. You will work daily with engineering and data science, and alongside go-to-market teams who bring the product to merchants.

What you'll do

  • Own the authorization optimization roadmap end to end: set priorities, sequence delivery, make tradeoffs, and communicate the plan and its rationale to leadership, engineering and go-to-market teams.
  • Determine where Signifyd should build, orchestrate, partner or influence issuers directly, informed by issuer behavior, merchant needs and regional payment dynamics.
  • Write detailed technical specifications, user stories and acceptance criteria, and manage the backlog with engineering.
  • Define and evolve the APIs, data models and integration points through which authorization and decline data flows between merchants, PSPs, issuers and our platform.
  • Identify, evaluate and develop new partnerships (such as PSPs, gateways, acquirers, issuers and data or technology providers) that expand our coverage and deliver measurable value to merchants.
  • Build issuer/BIN intelligence covering authorization performance, decline patterns and treatment effectiveness. Maintain a quantified opportunity map to prioritize recoverable revenue.
  • Drive issuer-specific decisioning across step-ups, 3DS, decline recovery and intelligent retries; inform routing where merchants have multiple PSP or acquirer options.
  • Work with data science to define requirements for risk-aware decisioning, balancing approval gains against fraud and chargeback exposure.
  • Own measurable authorization uplift and recovered merchant revenue. Demonstrate treatment impact through merchant proofs of value and issuer/BIN-level reporting.
  • Partner with sales, solutions and customer success to bring merchant feedback into the roadmap and support adoption.
  • Stay current on card network rules, regulation and industry practice, and use that knowledge to sharpen requirements.

What you'll bring (required)

  • 5+ years in a product management role, including ownership of a roadmap and end-to-end delivery.
  • Hands-on payments product experience spanning issuer authorization behavior, with a deep understanding of decline recovery and retries, 3DS, PSD2/SCA frameworks (including the upcoming transition to PSD3/PSR), and demonstrated improvements in authorization performance.
  • Experience writing detailed technical specs and defining APIs or data interfaces in partnership with engineering (backend or high-volume transaction systems a plus).
  • Strong analytical skills, with comfort working from transaction-level data and defining success metrics.
  • Experience working closely with data science or analytics teams and translating insights into product requirements.
  • Proven ability to influence cross-functional stakeholders without direct authority.
  • Clear written and verbal communication with technical and non-technical audiences.

Preferred

  • Experience at a payment processor, PSP, acquirer, card network, issuer or fraud/risk vendor.
  • Exposure to fraud, risk or digital identity products, including the false-decline versus fraud-loss tradeoff.
  • Experience defining requirements for ML-driven decisioning.
  • Familiarity with 3DS/EMVCo, tokenization, ISO 8583 and PSD2/SCA.
  • B2B SaaS or enterprise e-commerce merchant experience.

#LI-Remote

Benefits in our US offices:

  • Discretionary Time Off Policy (Unlimited!)
  • 401K Match
  • Stock Options
  • Annual Performance Bonus or Commissions
  • Paid Parental Leave (12 weeks)
  • On-Demand Therapy for all employees & their dependents
  • Dedicated learning budget through Learnerbly
  • Health Insurance
  • Dental Insurance
  • Vision Insurance
  • Flexible Spending Account (FSA)
  • Short Term and Long Term Disability Insurance
  • Life Insurance
  • Company Social Events
  • Signifyd Swag

Compensation:

In the United States, each work location is assigned a specific pay zone, which determines the salary range for a given position. The starting base salary for the selected candidate will be based on a variety of factors, including job-related skills, experience, qualifications, geographic location, and current market conditions.

Base Salary Ranges by Pay Zone:

  • Tier 1 (NYC/SF Bay Area/Seattle): $165,000 – $205,000 annually
  • Tier 2 (DC Metro/Austin/Chicago/Denver/Boston/Los Angeles/San Diego): $155,000 – $195,000 annually
  • Tier 3 (US - All Other): $145,000 – $185,000 annually

Equity: This role is eligible for a stock option grant of 7,000 stock options, based on the position level and internal compensation guidelines.

Bonus: This role is eligible for an annual performance bonus of up to 10% of base salary.

We want to provide an inclusive interview experience for all, including people with disabilities. We are happy to provide reasonable accommodations to candidates in need of individualized support during the hiring process.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Zuora

At Zuora, we help businesses grow smarter and adapt faster. Our platform powers modern business models — from subscriptions and usage-based pricing to AI-driven and outcome-based offerings — helping companies launch new products, automate complex billing, and unlock predictable, recurring revenue.

We’ve led the Subscription Economy for more than a decade. Now we’re evolving again by building the definitive platform for quote to cash and helping companies monetize their products and services with an adaptable, AI-ready foundation.

The Opportunity and The Team

We are looking for a Principal Product Manager, Payments to lead the next chapter of Zuora’s global payments platform and coverage strategy. In this senior individual-contributor role, you will be responsible for defining and driving the long-term roadmap for global payment acceptance, platform capabilities, and payment coverage, ensuring that our customers can seamlessly process payments anywhere in the world.

You will operate at the intersection of product, engineering, architecture, and partnerships, shaping how Zuora integrates with payment processors, acquirers, and orchestration partners globally. You have previously built and launched payments platforms and global payment features at scale with a prior company, and you bring 10+ years of hands-on payments domain experience building and scaling integrations across regions.

You will partner closely with product and engineering leaders, be the face to the customers, mentor other ZEOs in the payments area, and serve as a key thought partner to Zuora’s leadership on payments strategy. If you are passionate about building scalable, resilient payment platforms that power the Subscription Economy globally, this is the perfect time to join our team.

Our Tech Stack: Java, Spring, Rest API, Microservices, Kafka, Spark, NodeJS, AWS, Kubernetes, Terraform, AngularJS

What you’ll do

  • Lead the Global Payments Platform & Coverage Strategy
    Define, own, and execute the multi-year product strategy and roadmap for Zuora’s payments platform, including global acceptance, payment coverage, and core platform capabilities that serve all payment processors integrated with Zuora.
  • Drive Complex Processor & Orchestration Integrations
    Lead the end-to-end lifecycle of complex integrations with payment processors, acquirers, and orchestration partners—from ideation, technical scoping, and design through launch, rollout, and ongoing optimization.
  • Scale Global Payment Features and Functionality
    Design and launch global payment features (e.g., new payment methods, wallets, local schemes, risk and compliance capabilities, routing/orchestration patterns) that improve authorization rates, coverage, and resilience across regions.
  • Optimize Payment Performance at Scale
    Analyze payment success rates and processing data across geographies and processors to identify opportunities to improve authorization rates, reduce transaction failures, and enhance redundancy and resiliency of our payment flows.
  • Set Standards for Integration & Platform Quality
    Establish best practices, patterns, and reusable building blocks for payment integrations (APIs, configuration models, error handling, reconciliation, observability), ensuring new integrations and features are scalable, secure, and maintainable.
  • Collaborate Cross-Functionally and Across Time Zones
    Work closely with engineering, architecture, design, data, and partner management teams—often across US, Beijing, and India time zones—to deliver robust payment solutions that meet the complex needs of global enterprise customers.
  • Serve as the Payments Domain Expert
    Act as the internal subject matter expert on payment gateways, acquirers, schemes, alternative payment methods, and payment orchestration. Provide guidance to internal teams and customers on global payment best practices and regulatory considerations.
  • Be the Focal Point for Customers and Partners
    Serve as a primary point of contact for strategic customers and payment partners for coverage, platform, and integration topics in the US time zone, while aligning closely with engineering and stakeholder teams in Beijing and India.

Your experience

  • Deep Payments Domain Expertise (10+ Years)
    10+ years of experience in the payments industry with a deep understanding of the global payments ecosystem, including gateways, processors, acquirers, schemes, wallets, and alternative payment methods.
  • Proven Platform & Global Feature Ownership
    Demonstrated experience building and launching payments platforms and global payment features at a previous company (e.g., PSP, payment gateway, payment orchestration provider, large-scale merchant/platform). You have owned platform capabilities and coverage expansions end-to-end, not just single integrations.
  • Global Payments Integration Experience
    Extensive experience designing, delivering, and scaling payment integrations globally, including working with multiple acquirers/PSPs, local payment methods, and regulatory requirements across regions (e.g., EU, UK, APAC, LATAM, North America).
  • Integration Management & Technical Fluency
    Demonstrated success managing complex technical integrations with payment processors and acquirers, including reading and working from API specifications, mapping request/response fields, handling retries, idempotency, 3DS/SCA, tokenization, and reconciliation workflows.
  • Senior-Level Product Management
    Strong product management track record at a senior/principal level: owning multi-quarter roadmaps, making tradeoffs across platform, coverage, and customer commitments, and delivering features that drive measurable business impact for global customers.
  • Technical Aptitude and Architecture Mindset
    Ability to understand the technical nuances of payment platforms and integrations, collaborate effectively with architects and senior engineers, and translate complex requirements into clear specifications and system behaviors.
  • AI & Data-Driven Product Experience
    Experience using AI/ML to build value-added products that connect payments with revenue or accounts receivable (e.g., automated reconciliation, collections intelligence, cash application, forecasting, or churn analytics), bridging data silos to drive measurable business outcomes.
  • Global Mindset
    Experience building products and platforms for a global market, with a good grasp of regional payment preferences, regulations, and operating constraints (e.g., PSD2, SCA, data residency, localization).
  • Stakeholder and Partner Leadership
    Experience owning relationships with payment processors or strategic partners, and working directly with enterprise customers to prioritize coverage, manage escalations, and align roadmaps.

Nice to Have

  • Experience working with recurring billing, subscription management platforms, or usage-based business models.
  • Familiarity with global payment regulations such as PSD2, SCA, and PCI-DSS.
  • Technical background or previous experience as a solution architect or engineer in the payments space.
  • Experience with payment orchestration platforms or building multi-processor routing strategies.

Pay and Benefits

Zuora offers a comprehensive total rewards package designed to support ZEOs’ wellbeing, growth, and flexibility. While specific offerings may vary by country, we typically provide:

  • Competitive compensation, variable bonus and performance-based reward opportunities, and retirement programs
  • Medical, dental, and vision insurance
  • Generous, flexible time off, plus paid holidays, wellness days, and a company-wide year-end break
  • Paid parental leave (including fully paid leave for eligible ZEOs, subject to local policy)
  • Learning & development stipend to support ongoing growth
  • Opportunities to volunteer and give back, including charitable donation matching where available
  • Mental wellbeing resources and support

#ZEOLife at Zuora

ZEOs (our employees) are empowered to take ownership, challenge the status quo, and make a real impact. We:

  • Collaborate deeply across teams and regions
  • Learn constantly and iterate often
  • Build an inclusive, high-performance culture where people feel inspired, connected, and valued

Our Commitment to an Inclusive Workplace

Think, be and do you.
At Zuora, different perspectives, experiences, and contributions matter — everyone counts.

Zuora is proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to creating an inclusive environment for all. We do not discriminate on the basis of, and consider individuals seeking employment with Zuora without regard to, race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics.

We encourage candidates from all backgrounds to apply. Applicants in need of special assistance or accommodation during the interview process or in accessing our website may contact us by sending an email to assistance@zuora.com (or local equivalent, where applicable).

The base pay details represent the annualized salary range for the posted position. While we share a comprehensive range, a candidate’s final base salary will fall within these guidelines and will be determined based on multiple factors including but not limited to: qualifications of the candidate, job related knowledge, prior related experience, specific and unique skills, the location of the role, internal equity and internal budget. Base pay is only one element of Zuora’s Total Rewards Package. Additional elements may also include bonus/variable compensation, equity and comprehensive benefits, more details found here.

Base Pay Details

$185,400—$278,100 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
At ClickUp, we're building the future of work: the first truly converged AI workspace unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI. We are an AI-native company. Every team member is expected to leverage AI daily, and we evaluate AI fluency as part of our hiring process. Join us and help redefine what's possible.

ABOUT CLICKUP

At ClickUp, we're not just building software. We're architecting the future of work! In a world overwhelmed by work sprawl, we saw a better way. That's why we created the first truly converged AI workspace, unifying tasks, docs, chat, calendar, and enterprise search, all supercharged by context-driven AI, empowering millions of teams to break free from silos, reclaim their time, and unlock new levels of productivity. At ClickUp, you'll have the opportunity to learn, use, and pioneer AI in ways that shape not only our product, but the future of work itself. Join us and be part of a bold, innovative team that's redefining what's possible!

ABOUT THE ROLE

We are hiring the next generation of product managers. AI has collapsed the work that used to sit between an idea and a working version of it, and for the first time, PMs can be true builders. The PMs who win in this era do not manage the work. They build the product, every day, with their own hands.

A Principal Product Manager shapes high level strategy and product direction at the company level. You make the calls on the hardest product questions we face. Where the converged workspace is going, what AI for work actually looks like in three years, which bets matter. You build to show your thinking, not just describe it, and the argument is stronger when you have already put the idea on screen. You pull together data, customer escalations, support trends, and usage patterns and bring clarity on where we are winning and where to push next. The ways you find to move faster become how PMs across the company work. The stronger your craft, the more your strategy lands.

KEY RESPONSIBILITIES

  • Shape ClickUp's product direction at the company level. Own the hardest, most consequential product questions we face and drive them to resolution.

  • Define where the converged workspace is going and what AI for work looks like over a multi-year horizon. Hold that picture and make it legible to everyone else.

  • Build to prove the point. Prototype the future you are arguing for so the strategy is concrete, not theoretical.

  • Synthesize data, customer escalations, usage trends, and market signals into a coherent picture of where we are winning and where we need to move.

  • Set the standard for how PMs across the function work. The patterns you invent for compressing your loop become how the whole PM team operates.

  • Advise and inform executive leadership on product strategy, major bets, and where the company should and should not invest.

  • Represent ClickUp externally on product vision when relevant, including with key customers, analysts, and the broader product community.

  • Identify the gaps in our product thinking and build the frameworks that close them.

QUALIFICATIONS

  • 8-10+ years in product management, with a clear record of operating at company-shaping scope in a high-growth B2B SaaS environment.

  • Deep experience owning the most ambiguous and consequential product decisions, the ones with no obvious answer and real stakes.

  • Exceptional ability to synthesize competing inputs, customer signals, business constraints, and technical realities into a clear direction.

  • Demonstrated ability to build and evangelize a product vision that earns trust across engineering, design, and executive leadership.

  • History of raising the craft of the PMs around you, not just delivering your own output.

  • Fluent in data. You define the metrics that matter at the company level and you know when the data is incomplete or misleading.

  • Deep command of AI tooling. You are not experimenting with it, you are building with it and setting the example for the function.

  • Outstanding written and verbal communicator. You can make a hard argument simply and land it with any audience.

AI PROFICIENCY

  • Generate artifacts that accelerate alignment. Leverage AI to draft PRDs, map user flows, validate product launch readiness, synthesize research and customer feedback, produce competitive analyses, and write release notes.

  • Prototype and iterate with AI coding tools. Build functional prototypes independently of design and engineering using tools like Cursor or Claude Code.

  • QA your own work. Use browser automation tools to test flows, verify edge cases, and confirm what shipped matches what was specced.

  • Stay current and apply it. Familiarity with tools like Claude Code, Cursor, Figma AI, and MCP integrations is expected. Actively experiment and fold new capabilities into your workflow.

Equal Opportunity Employer

ClickUp is an Equal Opportunity Employer, and qualified applicants will receive consideration for employment without regard to race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, or national origin.

Privacy Notice

ClickUp collects and processes personal data in accordance with applicable data protection laws. You can find further details by viewing our Global Candidate Privacy Notice.

If you are a Philippine Job Applicant, please also see our Philippine Data Privacy Notice for further details.

Visa Sponsorship

Please note we are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment visa for roles outside of engineering and product at this time. Sponsorship for engineering and product roles is not guaranteed, but is instead based on the business needs for that specific role at that time. Please reach out to the recruiter with any questions.

Fraud Alert

ClickUp Talent Acquisition will only initiate contact via an @clickup.com email or through our official careers portal on clickup.com. We will never request fees, payments, or sensitive personal information. Please disregard any offers received outside these channels and report them to support@clickup.com.

AI Processing Notice

ClickUp may use artificial intelligence and machine learning technologies to help review and screen candidates' employment applications against role-related criteria. These tools support, but do not replace, human decision‑making. If you have questions or need an accommodation in the recruitment process, please contact us at AskPeople@ClickUp.com.
