jobs.jobDescription:
About Us:

YipitData is the leading market research and analytics firm for the disruptive economy and most recently raised $475M from The Carlyle Group at a valuation of over $1B. Every day, our proprietary technology analyzes billions of alternative data points to uncover actionable insights across sectors like software, AI, cloud, e-commerce, ridesharing, and payments.

Our data and research teams transform raw data into strategic intelligence, delivering accurate, timely, and deeply contextualized analysis that our customers—ranging from the world’s top investment funds to Fortune 500 companies—depend on to drive high-stakes decisions. From sourcing and licensing novel datasets to rigorous analysis and expert narrative framing, our teams ensure clients get not just data, but clarity and confidence.

We operate globally with offices in the US, APAC, and India. Our award-winning, people-centric culture—recognized by Inc. as a Best Workplace for three consecutive years—emphasizes transparency, ownership, and continuous mastery.

What It’s Like to Work at YipitData:

YipitData isn’t a place for coasting—it’s a launchpad for ambitious, impact-driven professionals.

From day one, you’ll take the lead on meaningful work, accelerate your growth, and gain exposure that shapes careers.

Why Top Talent Chooses YipitData:

  • Ownership That Matters: You’ll lead high-impact projects with real business outcomes
  • Rapid Growth: We compress years of learning into months
  • Merit Over Titles: Trust and responsibility are earned through execution, not tenure
  • Velocity with Purpose: We move fast, support each other, and aim high—always with purpose and intention

If your ambition is matched by your work ethic—and you're hungry for a place where growth, impact, and ownership are the norm—YipitData might be the opportunity you’ve been waiting for.

About This Role

We’re hiring an AI Product Manager to build the next generation of investor-facing products powered by AI.

You’ll sit on the Public Investor team, owning products that help institutional investors turn complex data into faster, higher-conviction decisions. This includes AI-powered workflows across:

  • MCPs (Model Context Platforms)
  • AI agents for research and analysis
  • Investor-facing portal experiences
  • Data feeds and programmatic access

This is not a traditional PM role. You’ll operate at the intersection of AI capabilities, user workflows, and proprietary data, defining how cutting-edge models translate into real investor value.You’ll work directly with investors, researchers, and engineers to design systems that don’t just surface insights, but actively assist, automate, and augment decision-making. We have unmatched data. What we need is world-class user experience to unlock it—so customers can turn our insights into value at scale. That’s where you come in.

Key Responsibilities

  • Own AI product strategy for investor workflows: Define how AI transforms the way public market investors consume, analyze, and act on data.
  • Build AI-native products, not just features: Design end-to-end experiences across agents, copilots, and structured outputs, not just UI layers on top of models.
  • Translate frontier AI into real-world utility: Evaluate and integrate LLMs, retrieval systems, and agent architectures into production-grade products.
  • Work directly with customers: Partner with hedge funds and asset managers to deeply understand workflows, pain points, and trust requirements.
  • Drive rapid experimentation and iteration: Run tight feedback loops across prompts, evals, and product UX to continuously improve performance and usefulness.
  • Collaborate across disciplines: Work closely with engineering, data, research, and design to ship high-quality, high-impact products, while communicating clearly with both technical and non-technical partners. 
  • Define quality, reliability, and trust: Establish evaluation frameworks for AI outputs, ensuring accuracy, consistency, and investor-grade reliability.
  • Shape the future of the platform: Contribute to how MCPs, agents, and APIs evolve into a unified, reliable, and safe AI product ecosystem.

Qualifications & Skills

  • 4-6+ years of product management or similar experience.
  • Experience building AI copilots, agents, or internal AI tools
  • Familiarity with how AI/ML models and AI agents are built and maintained.
  • Strong product instincts with a track record of building 0→1 or ambiguous products
  • Strong user research and customer discovery skills with deep curiosity about AI systems (LLMs, agents, retrieval, evals) 
  • Generalist knowledge of both engineering and design.
  • Able to design and evaluate prompts, contexts, and model behaviors.
  • Analytical thinker, comfortable with data and experimentation.
  • Great communicator and collaborator.
  • High ownership mindset with a bias toward action and learning

Nice to Have

  • Familiarity with financial markets or investor workflows
  • Experience with data platforms, APIs, or developer-facing products
  • Background in analytics, research, or quantitative environments

What We Offer:

Our compensation package includes comprehensive benefits, perks, a competitive salary, and equity: 

  • The annual base salary for this position is anticipated to be $140,000 - $150,000, with a 10% performance bonus, and equity.
  • We care about your personal life, and we mean it. We offer flexible work hours, flexible vacation, a generous 401K match, parental leave, team events, wellness budget, learning reimbursement, and more!
  • Your growth at YipitData is determined by the impact that you are making, not by tenure, unnecessary facetime, or office politics. Everyone at YipitData is empowered to learn, self-improve, and master their skills in an environment focused on ownership, respect, and trust. See more on our high-impact, high-opportunity work environment above!

This role may be performed fully remotely within the United States. Please note that our US headquarters are located in NYC. Income may be subject to New York State tax withholding.

Please note that for this position, we are not able to consider candidates who currently or in the future will require visa sponsorship.

We are committed to equal employment opportunity regardless of race, color, ancestry, religion, sex, national origin, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, gender, gender identity or expression, or veteran status. We are proud to be an equal opportunity employer.

Job Applicant Privacy Notice

jobs.jobDescription:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

As the Manager, Solutions Architects for our Enterprise team in the San Francisco Bay area, you'll lead a distributed group of intermediate and senior Solutions Architects serving enterprise customers in the West sales territory. You'll guide your team to act as trusted advisors to GitLab prospects and customers, helping them validate GitLab's Enterprise Edition as the right technical and business solution and supporting successful adoption of the GitLab platform across the entire software development lifecycle. You'll hire, coach, and retain a high-performing team, set clear expectations, and be accountable for how your team runs complex technical evaluations, articulates business outcomes, and collaborates with Sales, Engineering, Product Management, and Marketing. You'll model the work of a Solutions Architect yourself, from solution design through technical presentations, so your team is equipped to drive meaningful customer change with GitLab.

What you'll do

  • Lead a distributed team of intermediate and senior Solutions Architects supporting Enterprise customers in the West territory.
  • Coach, mentor, and develop team members through regular feedback, career support, and skills development in both technical and consultative areas.
  • Grow and retain a high-performing team by hiring thoughtfully, onboarding effectively, and fostering an inclusive, results-focused culture.
  • Guide by example by engaging in key customer opportunities as a Solutions Architect, from discovery through technical validation and successful adoption of the GitLab platform.
  • Drive the quality and consistency of technical evaluations, demos, and proofs of concept so that GitLab solutions clearly address customer business and technical requirements.
  • Collaborate closely with regional sales managers on territory strategy, account planning, and forecast support to ensure alignment between technical and commercial motions.
  • Partner with Product Management, Engineering, and Marketing to share field insights, influence the roadmap, and improve messaging around GitLab's Enterprise Edition and platform capabilities.
  • Own team execution by defining and tracking key performance indicators, and communicate progress, risks, and priorities clearly to your team, peers, and leadership.

What you'll bring

  • Experience mentoring and developing technical team members, including giving and receiving constructive feedback.
  • Experience managing or leading technical pre-sales or information technology professionals, ideally in an enterprise-focused environment.
  • Ability to collaborate effectively with other managers and cross-functional partners to plan and execute sales and go-to-market strategies.
  • Strong technical presentation and communication skills, with the ability to engage both technical and business stakeholders.
  • Knowledge of the end-to-end software development lifecycle, including modern software development or operations practices.
  • Understanding of continuous integration and continuous deployment concepts and their impact on customer outcomes.
  • Familiarity with cloud computing concepts, related technologies, and common customer adoption patterns.
  • Ability and willingness to travel in line with business needs and the company's travel policy, and openness to learning and using GitLab and related tools, including through transferable experience from adjacent domains.

About the team

The Enterprise Solutions Architect team partners with our largest customers to design and validate technical solutions that drive successful adoption of the GitLab platform. This role leads a group of intermediate and senior Solutions Architects aligned to the West Enterprise sales territory, working closely with Sales, Engineering, Product Management, and Marketing to support complex evaluations and long-term customer outcomes. We operate in a fully remote, asynchronous way across North America, using GitLab and our handbook-first approach to stay aligned on strategy, share technical best practices, and continuously improve how we support the sales cycle. Key opportunities for our team include deepening technical adoption of GitLab Enterprise Edition, connecting customer business goals with architectural recommendations, and serving as strong product advocates in the field.

The base salary range for this role’s listed level is currently for residents of the United States only. This range is intended to reflect the role's base salary rate in locations throughout the US. Grade level and salary ranges are determined through interviews and a review of education, experience, knowledge, skills, abilities of the applicant, equity with other team members, alignment with market data, and geographic location. The base salary range does not include any bonuses, equity, or benefits. jobs.jobDescription:
StackAdapt is the leading technology company that empowers marketers to reach, engage, and convert audiences with precision. With 465 billion automated optimizations per second, the AI-powered StackAdapt Marketing Platform seamlessly connects brand and performance marketing to drive measurable results across the entire customer journey. The most forward-thinking marketers choose StackAdapt to orchestrate high-impact campaigns across programmatic advertising and marketing channels.

The Creatives team is on a mission to build a one-stop-shop for advertisers' creative production and management needs. We're developing a comprehensive in-house product that lets clients create, enhance, preview, store, and manage CTV, video, audio, DOOH, display, and native ads at scale — whether they start from ready-made templates or build from scratch. By delivering a robust, full-featured in-house solution, we reduce our clients' reliance on costly third-party creative providers and empower advertisers to move faster and more efficiently.

The next chapter for the team centers on AI-powered content generation and a multi-channel creative experience, with particular focus on AI first video and CTV solutions. It's a high-impact, fast-moving area with significant room to define the product, the technology, and the creative workflows that will set the standard for how advertisers build at scale.

As a Senior Product Manager on the Creatives team, you'll own a portfolio at the heart of this ambition. This is a 0→1 space that spans multiple teams and disciplines, and you'll set the direction for it: shaping strategy, making the hard calls, and shipping. You'll partner closely with Engineering, Design, Creative Studio, Data Science, and Revenue to translate a bold vision into products advertisers love.

StackAdapt is a remote first company. This role is open to candidates in Canada and the United States. 

What You'll Be Doing

  • Own the strategy, roadmap, and end-to-end delivery for a portfolio spanning the video/CTV creative builder, AI-generated and brand content products, and creative integrations with social and partner platforms.
  • Lead 0→1 initiatives from first principles — research and validate the problem, frame the opportunity, define the path forward, and drive it to launch and adoption.
  • Translate complex, cross-team problems into a clear vision and crisp, actionable requirements that give Engineering, Design, and QE unambiguous direction on how features should behave.
  • Partner with Data Science and Engineering to shape how AI/ML and generative content capabilities are applied across creative formats, making sound technical trade-offs along the way.
  • Define key success metrics, monitor KPIs, and make data-informed decisions about what to build, what to cut, and what to double down on.
  • Work hand-in-hand with Creative Studio to ensure the tooling reflects real creative workflows and produces work that meets a high creative and brand bar.
  • Build new integrations with external platforms, partnering across teams to open up a wider range of creative assets and ad formats within the creative library.
  • Communicate precisely and proactively across the organization, keeping stakeholders aligned and informed at the right level and the right time.
  • Support customer-facing teams by resolving questions about your portfolio and helping triage bugs and regressions as they appear.

What You'll Bring to the Table

  • Proven experience as a Product Manager at a technology company, with a track record of shipping large, complex software products end-to-end (and you can speak to your successes).
  • Demonstrated success leading 0→1 initiatives that span multiple teams — you bring structure and direction to new problem spaces and rally others around a clear plan.
  • Experience building products in AdTech, MarTech, or creative platforms, with a meaningful edge for those who've worked on creative-building or generative AI products.
  • Strong fluency with AI/ML and generative AI concepts — enough to partner deeply with Data Science and Engineering, reason about capabilities and limitations, and make informed product decisions.
  • A technical background (Computer Science, Engineering, or equivalent hands-on experience) that lets you discuss technical trade-offs, integrations, and architecture credibly with engineers.
  • A keen design and creative sense, balanced with technical depth — you pair an eye for what "great" looks like with the ability to partner closely with engineering on how to build it.
  • An excellent cross-functional collaborator who can tailor your approach across Engineering, Design, Creative Studio, Data Science, and Revenue without skipping a beat.
  • Clear, structured writing and communication — you distill complex ideas into words that build consensus and align stakeholders around your vision.
  • Strong prioritization instincts grounded in reason, clarity, and purpose — you focus the team on the most impactful work and the KPIs you're moving.
  • A leadership style rooted in influence rather than formal authority, and the judgment to operate independently in a fast-moving, evolving space.

StackAdapter's Enjoy:

  • Highly competitive salary
  • Retirement/ 401K/ Pension Savings globally
  • Competitive Paid time off packages including birthday's off!
  • Access to a comprehensive mental health care program
  • Health benefits from day one of employment
  • Work from home reimbursements
  • Optional global WeWork membership for those who want a change from their home office and hubs in London and Toronto
  • Robust training and onboarding program
  • Coverage and support of personal development initiatives (conferences, courses, books etc)
  • Access to StackAdapt programmatic courses and certifications to support continuous learning
  • An awesome parental leave program
  • A friendly, welcoming, and supportive culture
  • Our social and team events!

jobs.jobDescription:
Our mission at ŌURA is to empower every person to own their inner potential. Our award-winning products help our global community gain a deeper knowledge of their readiness, activity, and sleep quality by using their Oura Ring and its connected app. We've helped millions of people understand and improve their health by providing daily insights and practical steps to inspire healthy lifestyles.

Empowering the world starts with living our values and empowering our team. As a quickly growing company focused on helping people live healthier and happier lives, we ensure that our team members have what they need to do their best work — both in and out of the office.

We are seeking a Senior Product Manager – Heart Health to join our growing Health Sensing organization. Reporting to the Director of Product Management, Health Risk Detection, this role will focus on advancing Oura’s cardiovascular health experiences, from proactive monitoring to long-term heart health insights.

You’ll join an established, cross-functional team dedicated to Heart Health. You’ll collaborate with Science, Design, Engineering, and Regulatory partners to accelerate our roadmap, deepen member value, and bring science-backed heart health features to life. This is a high-impact opportunity to help shape how millions of people understand and care for their cardiovascular health through wearable technology.

This remote role is open to candidates residing in the Eastern Time Zone and requires periodic travel to Boston, MA.

What You’ll Do

  • Partner closely with Science and Engineering teams to define and deliver next-generation heart health sensing and signal analysis capabilities
  • Translate scientific findings and physiological concepts into intuitive, meaningful product experiences that empower members to better understand their heart health
  • Support discovery and development of new features spanning both wellness and regulated use cases
  • Contribute to the prioritization and delivery of roadmap initiatives, balancing scientific feasibility, user impact, and business opportunity
  • Partner with Design to create user experiences that communicate complex heart health data with simplicity and empathy
  • Collaborate with Regulatory, Legal, and Quality teams on product strategies that align with applicable regulatory frameworks
  • Communicate progress, insights, and tradeoffs effectively to leadership and cross-functional stakeholders
  • Contribute to the broader Health Risk Detection strategy and align heart health workstreams with Oura’s mission to empower proactive health ownership

REQUIREMENTS

We would love to have you on our team if you have:

  • 5+ years of product management experience, ideally in connected health, digital biomarkers, or wearable sensing.
  • Experience delivering products or research-based features in cardiovascular health, fitness, or related physiological domains.
  • Strong understanding of key cardiovascular signals (e.g., HRV, ECG, PPG, blood pressure estimation) and their application in consumer or regulated products.
  • Proven success translating early-stage scientific research into member-facing experiences.
  • Familiarity with the nuances between wellness and medical-grade products; experience with FDA or other regulatory processes is a plus.
  • Excellent collaboration and communication skills with scientists, engineers, designers, and clinicians.
  • A passion for helping people live longer, healthier lives through actionable, science-backed insights.

BENEFITS

At Oura, we care about you and your well-being. Everyone here at Oura has a ring of their own and we are continually looking to improve employee health.

What we offer:

  • Competitive salary and equity packages
  • Health, dental, vision insurance, and mental health resources
  • An Oura Ring of your own plus employee discounts for friends & family
  • 20 days of paid time off plus 13 paid holidays plus 8 days of flexible wellness time off
  • Paid sick leave and parental leave

Tines is the intelligent workflow company that powers some of the world's most important workflows.

Tines has been supporting IT and security teams from a diverse range of customers, including Canva, Reddit, SAP, Coinbase, Mars, Fin (Intercom), and McKesson.

Tines 3B, launched in 2026, is the next generation of Tines – a single, secure environment for every team’s apps, agents and automations.

As an integrator across the entire tech stack, Tines is vendor-agnostic integrating with any API-enabled service. This flexibility enables our customers to achieve their highest-priority goals faster. Tines has security woven into its DNA, and our platform is secure and private by design.

At Tines, we're driven by our values of Simplicity, Speed, and Soundness. We're committed to delivering exceptional customer experiences while fostering a company culture that nurtures individual curiosity, growth, and integrity. We’re excited about what’s next, and we’re looking for others to join us on our journey.

This is a remote role that must be based in EST, preferred close to Boston

As a key member of our Customer Success organization, the Senior Manager, Professional Services Engineering is an empathetic, operationally rigorous and forward-thinking leader and mentor, specializing in resource and capacity planning,

You will lead our growing team of engineers across the US and Ireland. As part of our 3-function Professional Services organization (spanning Engagement Management, Project Management, and PSE), you will serve as the champion, coach, and strategic anchor for a team delivering automation solutions to our largest enterprise customers.

This is a high-impact leadership role built for someone who excels at both people-first leadership and operational systems thinking. You will step into a tightly knit, high-performing team that deeply values trust, advocacy, and hands-on career development. Simultaneously, you will bring long-range predictability to our services engine: solving the operational puzzle of dynamic, day-to-day resourcing while architecting capacity models that accurately forecast bench availability and skill distribution 6+ months into the future.

If you are a proactive problem solver who naturally takes complete ownership of initiatives, anticipates operational friction, and elevates the people around you, this role is for you.

What You Will Be Doing

  • Champion & Coach a High-Performing Team: Lead, mentor, and advocate for 8–10+ Professional Services Engineers across the US and Ireland through meaningful 1:1s, tailored career pathing, performance reviews, and active technical/professional coaching.
  • Build Trust & Psychological Safety: Step in as a supportive, empathetic people leader, establishing deep trust with a team navigating leadership transitions and diverse working styles.
  • Master Dynamic Resourcing ("Puzzle-Piece Scheduling"): Own tactile day-to-day engagement allocations, rebalancing resources, priorities, and schedules in real time as deals accelerate, stall, or evolve.
  • Architect 6+ Month Capacity Forecasting: Design, implement, and maintain predictive capacity models to accurately forecast bench availability, hiring triggers, and skillset distribution at least two quarters ahead.
  • Drive Strategic Cross-Functional Alignment: Partner seamlessly with Project Management leadership and Engagement Managers to ensure rock-solid engagement delivery, while collaborating closely with Sales, Customer Experience (CX), and GTM leadership.
  • Influence Product & Engineering: Serve as a conduit between customer delivery and product development; ensure PSEs test early-stage features, provide actionable feedback, and champion the voice of the customer internally.
  • Proactively Own Initiatives: Identify delivery bottlenecks, operational blind spots, and tooling gaps; formulate viable, data-backed solutions and drive their implementation autonomously from concept to completion.
  • Partner with Services Ecosystems: Participate in and co-lead monthly syncs with external services partners to support enablement and scale delivery bandwidth.
  • Drive Operational & Delivery Excellence: Accountable for core delivery metrics including engagement completion rates, CSAT, target billable utilization (70%+), and services expansion opportunities.

What You Bring With You

  • Experience:
    • 10+ years of experience in a post-sales customer facing role at a technology company
    • 5+ years of of direct people leadership or practice experience, with a track record of coaching and developing high-performing technical teams.
  • Demonstrated People-First Leadership: Proven track record directly managing and retaining professional services, solutions engineering, or technical delivery teams in high-growth SaaS environments, with a clear focus on empathy, coaching, and career development.
  • Multi-Horizon Capacity & Resource Planning Expertise: Hands-on experience not just shuffling in-quarter projects, but building and managing rolling 6+ month capacity and utilization forecasts that anticipate bench availability and hiring demand.
  • High Operational Resourcefulness & Ownership: An entrepreneurial mindset that proactively identifies friction, brings structured solutions rather than open-ended problems, and independently drives strategic initiatives to completion.
  • Cross-Functional Relationship Building: Demonstrated ability to build rock-solid trust with PM leadership, Sales, Customer Success, and Product teams to align delivery capacity with commercial pipeline.
  • Technical Fluency in Automation & Modern Tech Stacks: Ability to speak competently on workflow automation, APIs, system integrations, and modern AI/LLM applications to credibly guide engineers and evaluate delivery approaches.
  • Distributed Team Management: Experience coaching and coordinating a remote or geographically distributed engineering team across multiple time zones (US and EMEA).
  • Metric-Driven Delivery Acumen: Solid understanding of professional services metrics, including billable utilization targets (70%+), on-time project completion, CSAT, and services-assisted expansion.

This role reports to the Director, Professional Services who is based in Omaha, Nebraska.

Target Annual Compensation: $195-210K OTE (80/20 split)

Applicants for this opportunity must be authorized to work for any employer in the U.S. We are unable to sponsor or take over sponsorship of an employment Visa at this time.

#LI-SW1

At Tines, we’re all about trying new things and taking the leap. If you’re second-guessing your application, we hope you’ll trust your gut and take the leap too! Applying for a new job isn’t always easy, especially if you’re thinking of a career pivot – but we’re big believers in learning and growth here at Tines, so you’ve nothing to worry about. jobs.jobDescription:
GitLab is the intelligent orchestration platform for DevSecOps. GitLab enables organizations to increase developer productivity, improve operational efficiency, reduce security and compliance risk, and accelerate digital transformation. More than 50 million registered users and more than 50% of the Fortune 100* trust GitLab to ship better, more secure software faster.

The same principles built into our products are reflected in how our team works: we embrace AI as a core productivity multiplier, with all team members expected to incorporate AI into their daily workflows to drive efficiency, innovation, and impact. GitLab is where careers accelerate, innovation flourishes, and every voice is valued. Our high-performance culture is driven by our values and continuous knowledge exchange, enabling our team members to reach their full potential while collaborating with industry leaders to solve complex problems. Co-create the future with us as we build technology that transforms how the world develops software.

*Fortune 500® is a registered trademark of Fortune Media IP Limited, used under license. Claim based on GitLab data. Fortune 100 refers to the top 20% ranked companies in the 2025 Fortune 500 list, published in June 2025. Fortune and Fortune Media IP Limited are not affiliated with, and do not endorse products or services of GitLab.

An overview of this role

Credit-based and consumption-based offerings are becoming central to how GitLab monetizes. The systems that meter, rate, and bill that consumption sit underneath all of it. You'll own the backend usage billing pipeline and its product direction while supporting the Monetization Platform and Infrastructure team as it modernizes the foundations underneath it.

When another GitLab team launches a credit-consuming capability, you'll help them make it billable across GitLab.com, self-managed, and GitLab Dedicated. This is a technical, systems-oriented product role: success means building a monetization platform other teams can launch on quickly and correctly, rather than shipping customer-facing UI.

What you’ll do

  • Own the product direction for metering, aggregation, and rating in GitLab's usage billing pipeline, including the Zuora and CustomersDot integrations that turn usage into invoiced revenue.
  • Make onboarding a new credit-consuming capability a repeatable process rather than a bespoke project each time.
  • Partner with product teams on what to instrument, how to meter and price usage across GitLab.com, self-managed, and GitLab Dedicated, and what it takes to be billable on launch day. Stay ahead of their roadmaps so billing doesn't delay launches.
  • Prioritize pipeline scalability, performance, and reliability as consumption grows, balancing those investments against new capability enablement.
  • Own billing defect detection and remediation so errors surface before they reach a customer's invoice and billing outcomes remain auditable.
  • Support the Monetization Platform and Infrastructure team by framing problems, explaining the value of platform investments, and prioritizing them against operational risk.
  • Define and track measures of billing accuracy, pipeline reliability, cost to serve per capability, and time to monetize so teams can make informed pricing decisions.

What you’ll bring

  • Experience owning the product direction of consumption- or usage-based billing systems.
  • Experience with Zuora or a comparable billing and revenue platform, and an understanding of how product and finance systems interact.
  • Experience with prepaid, commitment, or credit-drawdown pricing models (balances, reservations, overage, expiration) and the edge cases they create in billing and revenue.
  • Experience launching new products or pricing models while coordinating across engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance and go-to-market teams.
  • Ability to bring together teams you don't manage around work their launches depend on.
  • Experience defining problems for platform or backend teams whose users are often other teams.
  • Clear written communication in an all-remote, asynchronous environment; you'll use issues, epics, and direction pages to lead.
  • Familiarity with developer tooling, financial audit or revenue recognition, or an engineering background can help, but isn't required.
  • You use AI tools as part of how you work: prototyping, analysis, spec writing, and investigation.

About the team

In Monetization, we coordinate across engineering, Finance, Legal, Compliance and go-to-market on new products and pricing models. Our remote, asynchronous work uses written issues, and epics to keep decisions visible.

jobs.jobDescription:
About ElevenLabs

ElevenLabs is an AI research and product company transforming how we interact with technology.

We launched in January 2023 with the first human-like AI voice model. Today, we serve millions of users and thousands of businesses - from fast-growing startups to large enterprises like Deutsche Telekom and Meta. Our investors are some of the world's most prominent, including Andreessen Horowitz, ICONIQ Growth and Sequoia. We've raised $781M in funding and our last valuation was $22B - multiples of 11, always.

We have expanded from voice into three main platforms:

  • ElevenAgents enables businesses to deliver seamless and intelligent customer experiences, with the integrations, testing, monitoring, and reliability necessary to deploy voice and chat agents at scale.

  • ElevenCreative empowers creators and marketers to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

  • ElevenAPI gives developers access to our leading AI audio foundational models.

Everything we do is the result of the creativity and commitment of our team - builders doing the best work of their lives. We are researchers, engineers, and operators. IOI medalists and ex-founders. If you want to work hard and create lasting positive impact, we want to hear from you.

How we work

  • High-velocity: Rapid experimentation, lean autonomous teams, and minimal bureaucracy.

  • Impact not job titles: We don’t have job titles. Instead, it’s about the impact you have. No task is above or beneath you.

  • AI first: We use AI to move faster with higher-quality results. We do this across the whole company—from engineering to growth to operations.

  • Excellence everywhere: Everything we do should match the quality of our AI models.

  • Global team: We prioritize your talent, not your location.

What we offer

  • Innovative culture: You’ll be part of a generational opportunity to define the trajectory of AI, surrounded by a team pushing the boundaries of what’s possible.

  • Growth paths: Joining ElevenLabs means joining a dynamic team with countless opportunities to drive impact - beyond your immediate role and responsibilities.

  • Learning & development: ElevenLabs proactively supports professional development through an annual discretionary stipend.

  • Social travel: We also provide an annual discretionary stipend to meet up with colleagues each year, however you choose.

  • Annual team offsite: Each year, we bring your entire team together in a new location - past offsites have included Croatia, Italy and Cancún

  • Co-working: If you’re not located near one of our main hubs, we offer a monthly co-working stipend.

About the role

We’re hiring a Product Manager to own the core ElevenCreative product experience for creators and marketers who sign up, subscribe, and build on their own. Self-serve users make up the majority of ElevenCreative’s user base, and they use the platform to generate and edit speech, music, image, and video across 70+ languages.

You’ll drive growth and adoption across the self-serve product experience, focusing on how users discover what ElevenCreative can do, how they move from a first generation into agents, video, and multi-step creative workflows, and what keeps them coming back and upgrading. There’s no shortage of things we could build. The job is defining the big bets, scoping them well, and shipping them quickly with the team.

PMs at ElevenLabs work in small, highly collaborative teams with minimal process, alongside engineers who have room to build creatively and lead. The scope is broad by design. Some weeks lean toward product, others toward growth or go-to-market work, and you’ll own whatever it takes to make ElevenCreative the best product for its users.

What you’ll do

  • Drive growth and adoption of the self-serve product, focusing on onboarding, activation, and upgrade moments, and partnering with growth, lifecycle, and pricing teams where they connect

  • Scope and define the big bets for the self-serve product across image, video, music, agents, and editing workflows

  • Find the biggest opportunities in the user journey through product data and user behavior, and turn them into clearly scoped projects

  • Drive adoption of newer experiences like agents and video, helping users expand from a single product into the full platform

  • Work with engineering and design to ship quickly, mocking up early concepts yourself when it speeds things up

  • Partner with growth, lifecycle, and social teams on launches and the moments that bring users into new parts of the product

  • Deep familiarity with the creative space and the creators and marketers who use these tools, with a habit of bringing user insights into every product decision

  • Experience scoping and defining large, ambiguous bets and owning them end to end

  • Design-minded, with a high bar for quality and user experience and the ability to mock up concepts yourself

  • Technical fluency to go deep with engineers on how things are built and the tradeoffs involved

  • Strong analytical skills and comfort in product analytics tools to find opportunities and measure impact

  • A track record of shipping quickly and iterating based on what the data shows

  • Ownership pedigree, meaning you drive your own projects fully rather than handing off after the spec

  • Curiosity about AI and creative tools, and close attention to how the space is moving

jobs.jobDescription:
About Veriff

Veriff is building trust infrastructure for the internet. Our AI-powered identity verification and fraud prevention platform helps businesses across fintech, crypto, gaming, mobility and marketplaces know who their users are, and whether they can be trusted, in 230+ countries and territories. We build our own technology end to end, and every verification we run teaches us something about how fraud really works.

The role

Veriff sees fraud at a scale and breadth that no single platform can see on its own. Our job now is to turn that advantage into products customers can see, measure and act on, and to build the network that makes it compound.

As Lead Product Manager for Fraud on the Veriff Network team, you will make the fraud detection, prevention and accuracy strengths of our product legible to customers. You will own the concrete product experiences that do this, such as a Feedback API that lets customers tell us what happened after a decision, fraud insights inside Station (our customer portal), and automated fraud reporting. You will also lead the customer engagement that turns those experiences into a feedback loop: customers share outcomes and signals, our detection gets sharper, and every platform on the network benefits.

This is one of the first roles on the Veriff Network, and it directly shapes how we package, sell and grow our fraud offering.

What success looks like

In your first 90 days, you will have assessed our fraud product roadmap and packaging and agreed a revised version with product and fraud leadership. You will have identified the top three to five fraud product improvements, with the highest-priority items shaped and in development.

By six months, the first updated fraud product offering is live with a group of design and beta partners.

By nine to twelve months, a shared-signal pilot is running with a set of platforms, as the first step toward a cross-platform fraud network.

By twelve months, the improved fraud products are generally available and are measurably helping us attract and close deals with our core customer segments.

What you'll bring

  • Fraud and risk expertise. You have shipped fraud or risk products, or you have been responsible for fighting fraud and managing risk at a scaled, digital-native company. You understand attack patterns, how fraud teams actually work day to day, and how the precision/recall trade-off plays out in the real world.
  • Network product experience. You have worked on network-effect or marketplace data products, where aligning incentives between participants and building feedback loops are central to the product.
  • Data and ML product craft. You can specify a signal, read a model evaluation, and ship and manage a rules engine. You know what to build yourself and what to leave to data science.
  • Customer discovery with fraud teams. You can get fraud and trust leaders at platforms talking openly, and you turn what you learn into a clear roadmap.

Nice to have

  • Experience building with operations teams. Our fraud operations experts are the source of truth on what fraud looks like in practice, and the right person turns their judgment into product. If you haven't worked closely with an operations team before, you'll need to show strong cross-functional collaboration skills.
  • Commercial packaging. You have shaped how a product is priced and sold, and worked deals alongside Sales.

Why Veriff?

We are the preferred identity verification platform partner for the world’s most innovative growth-driven organizations helping conveniently verify and safeguard users anywhere in the world. We support the broadest number of identity documents from nearly every country and territory in the world - and this is continually increasing! With a diverse team in the United States, United Kingdom, Spain, and Estonia, as well as robust backing and funding from investors including Accel, Alkeon, IVP, Tiger Capital, and Y Combinator, we’re dedicated to helping businesses and individuals build a safer and more secure world. We strive to be the benchmark for trust online, and we take pride in being a positive force.When you join Team Veriff, we offer you the opportunity to have a real impact and advance your career whilst looking after you along the way with a range of benefits designed with you in mind. Some of our favourites include...

  • Flexibility to work from home
  • Stock options that ensure your share in our success
  • Extra recharge days on top of your annual vacation
  • Extensive medical, dental, and vision insurance to ensure you’re feeling great physically and mentally
  • Learning and Development & Health and Sports budget that you are free to tailor to your own needs
  • Four weeks of fully paid sabbatical leave after reaching your 5th work anniversary

We are an Equal Opportunities employer committed to a diverse and representative team. Different opinions, perspectives, and personalities push us forward. We want to hear from people who are passionate about their work and align with our values. Regardless of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, sexual orientation, age, marital status, or disability. We also know the confidence gap and imposter syndrome can get in the way of meeting spectacular candidates - so rest assured, whoever you are, we want to hear from you!

Please take the time to read our Recruitment Privacy Notice, which explains how we collect and process your data for recruitment-related activities in accordance with applicable laws. Please read the information carefully. By submitting the application with the required information, you acknowledge that Veriff processes the information for recruitment purposes. Please be informed that in the final stage of the recruitment process, we may request that you undergo identity verification. For more information, please see Recruitment Privacy Notice. #US1#SPBTAL #LI-Remote

jobs.jobDescription:
Who We Are

Our mission is to make the world programmable. Sight is one of the key ways we understand the world, and soon this will be true for the software we use, too.

We’re building the tools, community, and resources needed to make the world programmable with artificial intelligence. Roboflow simplifies building and using computer vision models. Today, over 1M+ developers, including those from half the Fortune 100, use Roboflow’s machine learning open source and hosted tools. That includes counting cells to accelerate cancer research, improving construction site safety, digitizing floor plans, preserving coral reef populations, guiding drone flight, and much more.

Our team is small relative to our impact, and we believe our user success is our success (not the inverse). A team member summarized: “Roboflow is a company full of giant brains and tiny egos.” We find software has a multiplier effect on all roles (not only product and engineering), so Roboflow employs developers across the company in design, sales, customer support, marketing, and beyond.

We’re supported by great customers and investors, having raised over 63 million from Google Ventures, Y Combinator, Craft Ventures, Sam Altman, Lachy Groom, amongst other leading software investors.

What You'll Do

We’re hiring a Sales Operations Analyst to run the day-to-day operating rhythm of our revenue team and to stand up our deal desk, reporting into the Revenue Operations lead and working closely with sales leadership, finance, and our GTM Systems Engineer. Revenue Operations owns the operating system for go-to-market at Roboflow: how pipeline is measured, how the forecast is built, how territory and quota are set, and whether the numbers can be trusted. This role is the analytical and commercial half of that mandate. You’ll own the analysis leadership makes decisions from, and you’ll be the person reps come to when a deal needs to be structured, priced, and approved.

You’ll work alongside a GTM Systems Engineer who builds and maintains the systems themselves. Where they own how Salesforce works, you own what the numbers mean and how a deal gets done. Our motion is land-and-expand into enterprise manufacturing with packaged site licenses and a fast-growing first-land play, so deal structuring here is real work with real leverage, and the forecast has several distinct models underneath it.

  • Own day-to-day deal desk duties: guide reps on deal structure and packaging, run pricing and discount approvals, handle non-standard terms, and drive the path from quote to signed order form, including cloud marketplace transactions

  • Maintain pricing and packaging guardrails with Finance and sales leadership, including approval thresholds, discount bands, and the guidance reps use to size a site license or a proof of value

  • Contribute to the weekly and monthly forecast process: assemble the forecast, track submitted forecast against actuals, and surface slip, drift, and coverage gaps by segment

  • Own the recurring analysis leadership decides from, including pipeline generation, conversion by stage and segment, win/loss, sales cycle, and team performance

  • Support territory, coverage, and quota planning with account distribution, whitespace, capacity math, and attainment tracking

  • Steward KPI definitions so a number means the same thing in every meeting, dashboard, and report, and be the person who can explain any of them on the spot

  • Run the data quality cadence with reps: publish the cleanup views, work each list down with its owner, and escalate recurring problems for a systems fix

  • Support the variable compensation program through attainment reporting, plan mechanics, and the data quality behind both

Who You Are

You are a commercially minded analyst, equally comfortable in a spreadsheet and in the middle of a live deal, who wants to be an important part of an exceptional team that focuses on using Roboflow's computer vision tools to impact and improve every industry. You have high agency and a bias toward action.

Required Skills:

  • 3+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, deal desk, or a sales-facing analytics role at a B2B software company

  • Strong analytical skills: you can build and defend a model in a spreadsheet, and you write SQL or will pick it up quickly

  • Hands-on Salesforce experience as a power user, including reports, dashboards, pipeline inspection, and opportunity and forecast data

  • Practical understanding of GTM mechanics: pipeline stages, forecast categories, coverage, win rates, territory and quota concepts

  • Experience supporting deal structuring, pricing approvals, or quote-to-order workflows

  • A clear communicator who can explain a number to a skeptical audience and hold a definition under pressure

  • High attention to detail, because this role is the last check before a number reaches leadership or a customer

Preferred Skills:

  • Experience running or standing up a deal desk, particularly with packaged or tiered pricing

  • Experience with CPQ, quoting tools, CLMs, or e-signature platforms

  • SQL plus experience with a BI tool or data warehouse (BigQuery, Snowflake, or similar)

  • Experience with enterprise land-and-expand motions, PLG, or developer-first companies

  • Experience supporting variable compensation or quota administration

  • Experience using AI tools to speed up analysis, documentation, and reporting

Where You'll Work

Roboflow is a fully distributed company. We currently have Hubs in New York City, San Francisco and Brazil (and plan to open more as we grow density in new cities). We provide opportunities (like team onsites in different cities) and resources (like a $4000/yr travel stipend) to work in person with other team members as much as you'd like, while also supporting remote team members. You can work from one of our Hubs (we offer a relocation bonus), work from home, work at co-working spaces, etc. We want you to work where you work best!

What You'll Receive

To determine your salary, we use a number of market and data-driven salary sources. We review all salaries every six months to ensure we stay in line with the market.

In addition to our cash compensation, we offer generous perks and benefits. Below are some of the highlights:

  • $4000/yr Travel Stipend to travel anywhere anytime to work alongside other Roboflowers

  • Cover up to 100% of your health insurance costs for you and your partner or family

  • $350/mo Productivity stipend to spend on things that make your work environment more productive, like high-speed internet at home or a co-working space

  • $350/mo AI Stipend

  • $500 one time home office stipend

  • $150/mo Team lunch stipend

  • Unlimited PTO - with an annual 2 week minimum, we encourage you to take time off for yourself

  • 12 weeks parental leave

  • Equity in the company so we are all invested in the future of computer vision

Interview Process

Below is the interview process you can expect for this role. We’re committed to building an exceptional team and aim to be thoughtful while also moving quickly. We respect your time and strive to make decisions efficiently, depending on scheduling and availability.

You’ll have several conversations with the hiring manager, a member of the Roboflow leadership team, and complete a role-relevant project or challenge.

Throughout the process, you’ll speak directly with team members about what it’s like to work and succeed at Roboflow. Below is the interview process you can expect for this role.

Before the Interview:

  • We’ll review your application, LinkedIn, Github, etc.

  • The best way to stand out is to write about something you’ve built with Roboflow or contribute to one of our open source projects.

Introduction Phase:

  • [30m] Meet with recruiter and/or hiring manager to assess for overall mindset and skillset

  • [45m] Technical Assessment, if applicable

Team Interview Phase:

  • [30m] Meet with another member of the team

  • [60m] Meet with hiring manager again

  • Use this time to review specifics about the job description

  • Begin working through your 30/60/90 projects

  • Ask questions!

Build with Roboflow Phase

  • You will build a small project with Roboflow to showcase your technical and product skills.

  • [45m] Meet with your hiring manager and our CTO, Brad Dwyer to demo your project

Final Interview Stage

  • [30m] Leadership conversation focused on culture and company vision, as applicable.

  • [30m] Additional leadership discussion to discuss culture, as applicable.

References

  • References are required as part of our process. We will reach out to coordinate timing.

Note: you are welcome to request additional conversations with anyone you would like to meet and we will accommodate as best we can.

Not sure if this is you?

We want a diverse, global team with a broad range of experience and perspectives. We carefully consider every application and will either move forward with you, find another team that might be a better fit, keep in touch for future opportunities, or thank you for your time.

Learn More About Us

At Roboflow, we believe great ideas come from everywhere, and everyone. We’re proud to be an Equal Opportunity Employer committed to building a diverse and inclusive team. We consider all qualified applicants regardless of race, color, religion, sex, sexual orientation, gender identity, national origin, disability, age, veteran status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

jobs.jobDescription:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About The Role

As Headway works to build a new mental healthcare system that everyone can access, we’re facing unique operational challenges and opportunities that come with growing and scaling at an unparalleled rate. We’re pushing the boundaries of the existing healthcare system so that we can fulfill our promise to providers, patients, and payers to create access to high quality providers across the nation. In order to do that, we’re building a world class operations team that enables efficiency, growth, and quality, and as a member of this team, you will have the opportunity to have a material impact on the trajectory of Headway and help define a function core to the livelihood of our business and the impact we deliver for our partners and clients.

As a Business Operations Manager, you will lead high-impact, cross-functional initiatives that span teams and pods. You’ll operate as a thought partner to Product, Data, and Operations leaders – helping shape objectives, influence priorities, and translate complex insights into actionable plans. In addition to owning critical operational workflows, you’ll design scalable systems, mentor team members, and drive initiatives that create durable, measurable impact across the organization. This role requires strong judgment, comfort with ambiguity, and the ability to drive alignment and execution across the organization.

What you’ll do at Headway

  • Design and build foundations for a variety of 0-1 initiatives within the Business Operations function.

  • Collaborate cross-functionally to build, execute, monitor, and implement scalable products and processes that enable us to deliver on core business challenges.

  • Assess and analyze data to develop and determine strategies for accelerating progress, proactively identify areas for improvement, and deliver on roadmap priorities and team OKRs.

  • Build and manage a growing team to achieve these objectives.

You’ll be great for this role if you:

  • 7+ years of experience in operational roles at high-growth companies, with some background in consulting, finance, business operations preferred but not required.

  • Data is your first-language; you enjoy and are skilled at digging through complex data to solve ambiguous problems.

  • You thrive in the unknown, and seek out opportunities to dive into unfamiliar challenges, drive towards outcomes, and shape strategy.

  • You are operationally excellent, able to manage a large volume of moving pieces without breaking a sweat.

  • You are a collaborator that proactively partners across teams while holding teams accountable for business results.

  • You seek an environment that fosters individual growth through open-feedback and high-autonomy.

  • You are motivated by the opportunity to make an impact on one of our generation’s defining problems: affordable mental healthcare

Compensation:

The expected base pay range for this position is $121,600 - $190,000 based on a variety of factors including qualifications, experience, and geographic location. In addition to base salary, this role may be eligible for an equity grant, depending on the position and level.

Comprehensive benefits:

Medical, dental, vision, HSA/FSA, 401(k) including match for 2027!, Carrot Fertility reimbursement, and paid parental, medical and caregiver leave.

We believe a team's strength is in its people, and we cannot achieve this mission without a team that reflects the diversity of this problem – across race, ethnicity, gender, sexuality, age, national origin, religion, family status, disability, military status, and experience. Headway is committed to the full inclusion of all qualified individuals. As part of this commitment, Headway will ensure that persons with disabilities are provided with reasonable accommodations. If reasonable accommodation is needed to participate in the job application or interview process, to perform essential job functions, and/or receive other benefits and privileges of employment, please inform the recruiter when they contact you to schedule your interview.

Headway participates in E-Verify. To learn more, click here.

A notice to Headway applicants: To protect yourself against phishing and recruitment fraud, please note that Headway only accepts applications through our official careers page at https://headway.co/careers. Headway will never refer you to external websites, ask for payment or personal information, or conduct interviews via messaging apps. All official communication will come from a @findheadway.com email address. If you are contacted by someone claiming to be from Headway via an unofficial channel, please do not share any information and report it as spam.

About the role:

You will be the first dedicated PM for pricing at Headway. Your mission: build pricing into a durable, experimentation-driven lever for growth and revenue. Success looks like creating $100M+ of revenue impact.

Headway's pricing decisions affect every participant in our marketplace — what providers earn, what patients pay, and what payers reimburse. Today, these decisions are made through a mix of analysis, intuition, and competitive benchmarks. You'll replace that with a systematic, experiment-driven approach that generates data, builds conviction, and creates new revenue streams through bundling/un-bundling.

This is not a strategy-deck role. You will design experiments, partner with data scientists, navigate cross-functional complexity, and ship pricing changes that move the business. You'll work at the intersection of product, economics, and marketplace dynamics in one of the fastest-growing healthcare companies in the country.

You Will

  • Own pricing experimentation end-to-end: Design, run, and analyze pricing experiments (payout levels, take rates, fee structures, incentive models) with proper controls and measurement.

  • Price and package existing features: Identify opportunities to unbundle, tier, or price Headway's existing feature set as new revenue lines, while balancing the provider experience.

  • Define Headway's pricing philosophy: Build a principled, defensible approach to how we set prices — transparent to providers, competitive in the market, and sustainable for the business.

  • Inform tiering with pricing data: Partner with other product teams to ensure pricing and tier design are grounded in experimental evidence, willingness-to-pay research, and elasticity data.

  • Build the experimentation infrastructure: Work with Engineering and Data to create systems that enable rapid, controlled pricing experiments across geographies and segments.

  • Navigate cross-functional complexity: Align Finance, Provider Growth, Payer, Ops, and Legal around pricing decisions that affect every part of the business.

Who You Are

  • 8+ years of PM experience, with at least 2-3 years owning pricing, monetization, or marketplace economics.

  • You've personally owned pricing or packaging strategy and shipped changes that moved revenue.

  • You've designed and run pricing experiments at scale — you know the difference between a feature A/B test and a pricing experiment.

  • Strong quantitative fluency — you can partner with data scientists on experiment design and causal inference as a peer.

  • You thrive in ambiguity and can build structure where none exists — this is a new team.

  • Bonus: SaaS pricing & packaging experience (PLG, tiering, bundling).

  • Bonus: You've worked in a two-sided marketplace or platform where pricing affects both supply and demand.

  • Bonus: Healthcare or regulated industry experience.

jobs.jobDescription:
For over 30 years, Angi has powered the future of the home services industry, creating an environment where homeowners and pros benefit from more jobs done well.

For homeowners, our platform is a reliable way to find skilled pros. For pros, we're a reliable business partner who helps them find the winnable work they want, when they want. For employees, we're an amazing place to call home. We can't wait to welcome you.

Angi at a glance:

  • Founded in 1995 as Angie’s List and rebranded in 2021

  • Global company with 9 brands in 8 countries and employees worldwide

  • Homeowners have turned to us for 300 million home projects and counting

About the Role

This is a unique opportunity to shape the future of a new, fast-growing, and highly visible team at Angi.

The Senior Manager of Large Pro Strategy will work directly with the Senior Director of Partner Strategy and the Large Pro team to drive growth and success for our largest pro partners by diving into the data to find opportunities for improvement, putting together business cases, and driving change via large cross-functional projects. You will devise strategy, build frameworks, structure solutions, manage projects, and drive & measure results in the most critical areas of the business.

In this role, you will own and/or support impactful strategic priorities; work with research, analytics, operations and product teams to identify test ideas and execute. You will be expected to know our Large Pro service providers and the operational teams that support them inside and out, serving as a critical thought partner to the Sr Director of Partner Strategy, SVP of Large Pro, pro product, and beyond.

What You’ll Be Doing

  • Independently own key strategic initiatives (or critical work streams within it) from initial concept through execution and success measurement.

  • Alongside an all-star team of peers and stakeholders, steer quantitative and qualitative research efforts into financial and operational drivers of Pro success and inform decision-making.

  • Build clear and concise presentations that summarize your findings and lead to clear recommendations.

  • Provide thought partnership to the Partner Strategy team and cross-functional partners.

  • Program manage large strategic changes that involve many teams and span multiple months, building cross-functional buy-in and collaboration, and providing updates and impact to senior leadership.

  • Proactively leverage GenAI tools (e.g., Gemini, Claude) to rapidly synthesize complex partner performance data and cross-functional insights, streamlining the creation of strategic proposals and materials, thereby maximizing time for high-value consultative engagement and driving partner growth.

  • Work directly with stakeholders at the highest-value customers to help solve problems that unlock business growth for Angi; develop strategies based on those learnings to apply across the Large Pro network

About you

  • Self-starter; owner; someone who can manage and execute projects to completion

  • First class communication skills

  • Maintain a careful balance between attention to detail and swift execution

  • Data-driven

  • Has a strong bias for action

  • Thrive with ambiguity

  • Team player; collaborates and influences effectively with cross-functional team members across the organization

What we're looking for

  • Bachelor’s degree or higher

  • 3-5 years of professional experience in consulting, finance, strategy, business development or operations experience

  • Strong analytical and execution background - demonstrated experience gathering data from various sources and driving strategic insight and decision-making

  • Management consulting experience at a top firm strongly preferred

  • Startup experience is a plus

  • A strong interest in Angi, home services, marketplaces and product-driven organizations

Compensation & Benefits

  • The salary band for this position ranges from $110,000 - $160,000 commensurate with experience and performance. Compensation may vary based on factors such as cost of living.

  • This position will be eligible for a competitive year end performance bonus & equity package.

  • Full medical, dental, vision package to fit your needs

  • Flexible vacation policy; work hard and take time when you need it

  • Pet discount plans & retirement plan with company match (401K)

  • The rare opportunity to work with sharp, motivated teammates solving some of the most unique, complex challenges

We value diversity

We know that the best ideas come from teams where diverse points of view uncover new solutions to hard problems. We welcome and value individuals who bring diverse life experiences, educational backgrounds, cultures, and work experiences.

Our hiring process may utilize artificial intelligence (AI) tools to assist in candidate screening and assessment. Our AI tools are designed to complement, not replace, human decision-making.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Us

With electric vehicles expected to be nearly 30% of new vehicle sales by 2025 and more than 50% by 2040, electric mobility is becoming a reality. ChargePoint (NYSE: CHPT) is at the center of this revolution, powering one of the world’s leading EV charging networks and a comprehensive set of hardware, software and mobile solutions for every charging need across North America and Europe. We bring together drivers, businesses, automakers, policymakers, utilities and other stakeholders to make e-mobility a global reality.

Since our founding in 2007, ChargePoint has focused solely on making the transition to electric easy for businesses, fleets and drivers. ChargePoint offers a once-in-a-lifetime opportunity to create an all-electric future and a trillion-dollar market.

At ChargePoint, we foster a positive and productive work environment by committing to live our values of Be Courageous, Charge Together, Love our Customers, Operate with Openness, and Relentlessly Pursue Awesome. These values guide how we show up every day, align, and work together to build a brighter future for all of us.

Join the team that is building the EV charging industry and make your mark on how people and goods will get everywhere they need to go, in any context, for generations to come.

Reports To

Senior Director, Data and Product Management

What You Will Be Doing

  • Own the product strategy, roadmap, and outcomes for ChargePoint's fleet software platforms — including ViriCiti (telematics and fleet management) and new platforms being developed for truck fleets and autonomous vehicle operators.
  • Drive the evolution of existing platforms: identify gaps in the current customer experience, prioritize improvements, and ensure the platform continues to meet the needs of today's fleet operators while scaling for future growth.
  • Define and build net-new software products for emerging fleet segments, including purpose-built solutions for commercial truck charging management and autonomous vehicle fleet operations.
  • Translate customer needs, market trends, and business priorities into clear product requirements, user stories, and success metrics — working closely with engineering and design to ship high-quality software.
  • Partner with cross-functional teams including sales, marketing, customer success, and data science to align on market opportunities, support go-to-market execution, and drive adoption of fleet software solutions.
  • Engage directly with fleet customers and prospects to deeply understand their workflows, pain points, and evolving software needs — bringing the voice of the customer into every product decision.
  • Communicate product vision, progress, and trade-offs clearly to a wide array of stakeholders, from engineering teams to executive leadership.

What You Will Bring to ChargePoint

ChargePoint is seeking a Staff Product Manager, Fleet Software to own the software product strategy and roadmap for our fleet vertical. Reporting to the Senior Director, Product, you will be responsible for the full lifecycle of ChargePoint's fleet software platforms in North America and Europe — from maintaining and evolving our existing solutions such as ViriCiti to defining and building new platforms for emerging segments including truck and autonomous vehicle fleets. This is an individual contributor role in which you will operate as a hands-on product leader, partnering closely with engineering, design, data, and go-to-market teams to ship software that fleet operators love.

Requirements

  • 12 years of product management experience, with a strong focus on software products — ideally in fleet management, telematics, mobility, energy management, or adjacent SaaS platforms.
  • Demonstrated ability to manage and evolve existing software platforms while simultaneously defining new products from the ground up.
  • Experience working with fleet operators, commercial vehicle customers, or logistics companies preferred
  • Strong technical fluency — able to engage meaningfully with engineering teams on software architecture, APIs, and data pipelines without needing to write code.
  • Customer-obsessed and data-driven, with experience translating qualitative customer insight and quantitative data into prioritized product decisions.
  • Intellectually curious, analytical, creative, collaborative, and a strategic thinker who can work effectively as an individual contributor in a matrixed organization.
  • Strong communication skills — able to translate complex technical and commercial concepts into clear, structured narratives for diverse stakeholders.
  • Based in North America

Location

North America - Remote

The base salary range for this role is $178,500 – $241,500 per year. In addition, this position is eligible for a new hire RSU grant and annual merit-based RSU grants. The company offers a comprehensive benefits package including health, dental, and vision insurance; 401(k); paid time off; parental leave; life and disability insurance; and wellness resources.
