jobs.jobDescription:
GiveDirectly has delivered more than $1B in cash directly to 2+ million people living in poverty across 15 countries since 2011. We believe cash transfers are one of the most scalable, cost-effective, and dignified forms of aid, with the research to back it up. Our work has been covered by The Economist, NPR, TED, and The Washington Post. We are one of Time100’s Most Influential Companies of 2026.

Our culture is candid, analytical, and non-hierarchical. We support high ownership and real professional growth. Curious about what it's really like to work here? Read our values and hear from the people who do. If they resonate, this could be a great fit!

Reports to: Vice President, Partnerships

Level: Director (we are open to hiring at Senior Director level for more experienced candidates)

Role overview

GiveDirectly intends to transfer $10B by 2035 while building a resilient, durable cash-first movement in the aid sector.

To reach this milestone, we have brought all fundraising efforts under one leadership, to enable better coordination and optimisation of fundraising streams and operations over time. This unified approach is building a high-performance fundraising team that identifies and secures high-quality leads, while standardizing revenue operations and knowledge-sharing across all verticals, enabling a better donor experience and securing long-term funding to achieve our goals of eliminating extreme poverty and responding better in crisis.

The Director/Senior Director, Revenue Operations will own the operating backbone of the Fundraising function: the data, systems, and processes that let Partnerships, Philanthropy, Individual Giving, and Special Projects run at scale. As we grow our Emergency Cash and US work alongside our work on ending extreme poverty, the candidate will also help ensure fundraising strategies are complementary rather than competing. This is a BizOps-first role. You will build the pipeline infrastructure, KPI architecture, and operating rhythms that make Fundraising's growth predictable and measurable, and you will represent Fundraising to Finance, Compliance, Grants Management, and the People team.

Alongside this, the role carries a chief-of-staff dimension: partnering with the Vice President of Partnership on strategic priorities, high-stakes internal and external communications, and organizational change management, so the VP's time is focused on the highest-impact work.

Depending on the skills and interests of the person we hire, this role may grow to manage a team of 3-5, covering some combination of: fundraising tech and data (e.g. Salesforce), donor experience, and knowledge management. Reflecting our "Team Next" value and commitment to organizational excellence, this person will drive cross-functional collaboration to ensure fundraising operations scale seamlessly alongside our global growth.

Key responsibilities

Own Fundraising's revenue operations: data, systems, and process (primary focus)

  • Build and own the strategic data and systems architecture for Fundraising: pipeline tracking, annual and in-year forecasting, and reporting infrastructure (e.g. Salesforce) that gives every vertical a single, trustworthy source of truth.
  • Define, standardize, and own tracking of fit-for-purpose Fundraising KPIs, aligned to Board reporting needs and the team's long-term strategic direction.
  • Partner with counterparts on Fundraising Data and Tech to prioritize, execute, and approve projects that serve both functions.
  • Design and institutionalize the operating rhythms of the Fundraising function: pipeline reviews, QBRs, reporting cadences, and the processes that turn strategy into consistent execution.
  • Develop revenue systems and processes alongside the Finance, Fundraising and Donor Experience teams that support scalable growth, protect donor journeys, and ensure capital moves securely and efficiently through the organization.
  • Own revenue reconciliation and recognition, pledge and receivable tracking, restricted-fund coding, monthly/annual close handoff, or audit support.
  • Own workforce and capacity planning for Fundraising in partnership with the VP: role scoping, hiring prioritization, and structural improvements as the team scales.

Build and lead a team as the function matures

  • As the role grows, manage a team of 3-5 covering fundraising tech and data (e.g. Salesforce), donor experience, and knowledge management, setting priorities, coaching, and ensuring quality across each area.
  • Set clear ownership and operating cadences across the team so each workstream (tech and data, donor experience, knowledge management) has a defined remit and reduces duplicated effort across Fundraising verticals.

Act as the go-to liaison between Fundraising and other functions

  • Maintain a comprehensive view of Fundraising needs across all verticals and sub-teams, and act as the single point of contact for Grants Management, Finance, and Compliance on run-rate donor management processes.
  • Represent Fundraising's operational needs to the People team, Legal, and other functions as cross-functional systems and initiatives are designed and launched.

Partner with the VP on strategy and organizational effectiveness (chief-of-staff functions)

  • Collaborate with the Vice President to refine the unit's strategy, manage organizational change, and lead internal communications.
  • Streamline decision-making, manage priorities, and provide strategic counsel to maximize the VP's focus and effectiveness on high-impact work.
  • Prepare briefing materials and executive-level communications for senior leadership and Board audiences as needed.

Lead on cross-fundraising initiatives and priorities

  • Address broader organizational priorities as needed, including high-level donor stewardship coordination, cross-functional system launches, flexible workforce planning, or market expansion initiatives.

This role would suit somebody who is comfortable working in a fast-paced environment, who is energized by building systems and structure out of ambiguity, and who enjoys pulling together disparate workstreams into a cohesive, impactful strategy. It's a strong fit for someone with a business operations, revenue operations, or chief-of-staff background who wants a role weighted toward building and owning systems (and, over time, building a team) rather than one focused primarily on executive support.

What we're looking for

  • 8+ years of experience in revenue operations, business operations, or a chief-of-staff role, ideally within a fundraising, sales, or partnerships organization.
  • Demonstrated experience building or owning CRM/pipeline systems (e.g. Salesforce), KPI frameworks, and reporting infrastructure that multiple teams rely on.
  • Strong analytical operator: comfortable structuring ambiguity, setting priorities, and using data to drive decisions. An advanced degree (e.g. MBA) is a plus, not a requirement.
  • Proven track record managing cross-functional relationships and influencing senior stakeholders outside a direct reporting line.
  • Experience managing people or workstreams, with the ability to scope roles and structure as a function grows; direct people management experience is a plus given this role may build and lead a team of 3-5.
  • Excellent written and verbal communication skills, particularly for high-stakes internal and Board-facing materials.
  • Deep alignment with GiveDirectly's values, especially recipient choice, transparency, and evidence.

Bonus

  • Experience working with institutional donors or fundraising teams in Africa.
  • Experience standing up a BizOps or RevOps function from scratch, including building out a team across tech and data, donor experience, and knowledge management.

Compensation

At GiveDirectly, we strive to pay our employees generously and equitably. We use an accredited third party salary aggregator to calculate what we believe to be competitive pay based on role, location, and cost of living. We also have a no negotiation policy to ensure we are paying staff equitably across roles. Read more about our compensation philosophy here.

Unless otherwise noted, the benefits stipend may be used to cover benefits or taken as additional taxable income.

GiveDirectly is an Equal Opportunity Employer. Commitment to Safeguarding

As a global organization working with communities to eliminate extreme poverty, GiveDirectly takes the safeguarding of its recipients, staff, and partners seriously. To that end, GiveDirectly is a member of the Misconduct Disclosure Scheme, and will systematically check with previous employers about any abuse or misconduct related matters involving potential new hires. jobs.jobDescription:
Thumbtack helps millions of people confidently care for their homes.

Thumbtack is the one app you need to take care of and improve your home — from personalized guidance to AI tools and a best-in-class hiring experience. Every day in every county of the U.S., people turn to Thumbtack to complete urgent repairs, seasonal maintenance and bigger improvements. We help homeowners know which projects to do, when to do them and who to hire from our growing community of 300,000 local service businesses. If making an impact inspires you, join us. Imagine what we’ll build together.

About the Pro Activation & Success Team

Thumbtack's Pro Activation & Success pillar helps local service businesses discover Thumbtack, get started, find success, and grow with us over time. We build products and experiences that help more pros thrive, partnering closely with marketing, partnerships, and sales across the full pro journey. We're a highly collaborative, data-driven team united by a simple goal: helping pros build stronger businesses.

About the role

Thumbtack was originally built to serve individual professionals and small businesses. Now, larger and more sophisticated businesses represent one of our biggest opportunities for growth — and serving them well requires us to rethink what Thumbtack can offer. In this role, you'll shape how we win with this segment, from connecting Thumbtack with the tools pros use to run their businesses to creating the foundational experiences they need to succeed at scale. You'll work closely with our partnerships and business development teams to turn integrations into meaningful growth, identify and scale new growth levers tailored to this segment, and bring differentiated products to market.

What you’ll do

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for unlocking growth among larger, more sophisticated pros, with accountability for customer and business outcomes.

  • Develop a deep understanding of how these pros operate, using research and data to identify unmet needs, product gaps, and new opportunities for growth.

  • Set the strategy for our APIs, data integrations, and partner offerings, working directly with partnerships, business development, and external partners to create value for pros and open new growth channels.

  • Lead new products and capabilities from early discovery through launch and adoption, helping complex businesses succeed on a product originally designed for smaller businesses.

  • Partner with engineering to make thoughtful tradeoffs between near-term opportunities and durable technical foundations that can support future products and partnerships.

  • Bring engineering, design, data science, marketing, sales, and partnerships together around clear priorities and lead execution across organizational boundaries.

  • Define success, test the highest-potential ideas, and use what you learn to scale the experiences and growth levers that deliver meaningful results.

In order to be successful, you must bring

  • 5+ years of product management experience, with a track record of owning complex product areas and delivering meaningful customer and business outcomes.

  • Experience turning ambiguous, early stage opportunities into clear product strategies and taking new products from discovery through launch and adoption.

  • Strong technical fluency and experience owning technically complex products, with the ability to partner with engineering on APIs, data, integrations, and system tradeoffs while keeping customer value at the center.

  • Excellent product judgment and customer empathy, with the ability to understand complex business workflows and turn them into simple, intuitive experiences.

  • Strong analytical thinking and business acumen, including the ability to uncover growth opportunities, define success, and balance near-term impact with long-term investments.

  • An AI-first mindset: curiosity, adaptability, and enthusiasm for using agentic AI workflows throughout product development, paired with sound judgment about where AI adds value.

  • Proven ability to influence and lead across engineering, design, data science, commercial teams, and external stakeholders, using clear communication to navigate different incentives and build alignment.

Expected salary ranges

  • For candidates living in San Francisco / Bay Area, San Jose, New York City, or Seattle metros, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for the role is currently $200,600.00 - $259,600.00.

  • For candidates living in Austin, TX or Washington DC metros or in California, Massachusetts, New Jersey, or Washington states, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for the role is currently $180,200.00 - $233,200.00.

  • For candidates living in all other US locations, the expected total cash compensation (base salary + variable pay, if applicable) range for this role is currently $170,900.00 - $221,100.00.

Actual offered salaries will vary and will be based on various factors, such as calibrated job level, qualifications, skills, competencies, and proficiency for the role.

jobs.jobDescription:
About the Job:

LaunchDarkly is looking for a strategic, execution-oriented Director of Internal AI Operations to run and continuously improve how our company adopts and scales AI, establish the operational objectives, processes, and work plans that turn AI from a collection of tools into a measurable business capability and work with leaders across several functions to put the company’s AI direction into practice.

Responsibilities:

  • Reporting: Build and maintain visibility into AI spend and usage. Develop adoption, efficiency, and cost metrics and report on tool overlap, cost drivers, and open risks. Support Finance with forecasting, budget tracking, anomaly detection, and vendor and model-cost optimization. Functional and technical leaders own efficiency, waste, cost, usage, and ROI within their portfolios; AI Operations prepares regular reporting and flags performance gaps for follow-up.
  • Portfolio management: Maintain the inventory of AI tools, initiatives, agents, vendors, integrations, owners, status, spend, risks, and dependencies. Establish the processes and standards that keep it accurate across teams.
  • Reviews: Participate in reviewing new AI Vendor requests and own and manage the Internal AI Feature Review process from intake through decision, conditions, approval, exception, or rejection, coordinating inputs from Security, Legal, IT, and business owners.
  • Policy operations: Develop and maintain the company’s Internal AI Policy supporting resources with Legal and Security, and the Executive team, along with supporting resources. Recommend policy changes and put approved changes into operation.
  • Transformation and migration: Track the AI roadmap, migrations, platform dependencies, adoption milestones, resourcing, risks, and executive decisions.
  • Partnership with our technology teams: Collaborate on new AI product initiatives, empowering our product teams with how they identify and deliver value around AI.
  • Administration and audit: Define and audit standards for access, ownership, configuration, data controls, logging, retention, vendor settings, and offboarding.
  • Communications and enablement: Own the Internal AI communications calendar, stakeholder updates, FAQs, launch materials, training coordination, and policy-change communications.
  • CoE coordination: Establish a common cadence and minimum artifacts across distributed AI CoEs without centralizing their technical or domain ownership.

Qualifications:

  • 15+ years of progressively responsible experience in AI or technology operations, enterprise systems, data and analytics, FinOps, governance, transformation, or a related field, including 5+ years leading teams or complex cross-functional programs.
  • Demonstrated success designing, implementing, or scaling an operating model across multiple functions, including clear ownership, policies, processes, metrics, governance, and measurable outcomes.
  • Experience managing an enterprise portfolio of AI or technology tools, vendors, integrations, or platforms, including lifecycle management, access and administration, risk and controls, contracts, usage, and spend.
  • Strong financial, analytical, and data-driven mindset, with experience using tools such as Snowflake, Excel, Python, or equivalent; able to define adoption, efficiency, unit economics, ROI, and business-value metrics and turn complex data into executive-ready recommendations.
  • Strong financial and operational acumen, with experience building spend visibility, forecasts, budget controls, vendor or model-cost optimization, cost avoidance, waste reduction, and value-improvement plans.
  • Strong written and verbal communication skills, including the ability to explain complex topics clearly, present recommendations to senior and executive leaders, and persuade diverse stakeholders.
  • Experience influencing functional and technical leaders without relying on direct authority, clarifying distributed accountability, benchmarking performance, challenging tradeoffs, and driving follow-through across global, remote, and cross-functional teams.
  • Curiosity and a willingness to lean into AI: able to learn emerging capabilities quickly, experiment pragmatically, identify high-value use cases, and apply sound judgment about where AI should and should not be used.
  • Practical understanding of responsible AI, data governance, privacy, security, vendor risk, and change management, with the judgment to balance innovation, control, scalability, and business value.
  • Strong systems thinking, program management, prioritization, and change leadership skills; comfortable bringing structure to ambiguous, company-wide problems.
  • Experience hiring, coaching, or developing effective teams and building trusted partnerships across Finance, IT, Security, Legal, Procurement, and business functions.

What Success Looks Like:

  • Accelerate teams’ work through measurable improvements in cycle time, throughput, or capacity unlocked by AI.
  • Partner with functional leaders to demonstrate business value from priority AI use cases—not just increased usage.
  • Reduce friction from idea to responsible launch, measured by faster reviews, clearer decisions, and fewer stalled initiatives.
  • Improve AI portfolio efficiency through stronger utilization, reduced duplication, and better cost per user or workflow.
  • Establish trusted, scalable governance, with clear ownership, timely reviews, and consistent execution of required controls.

Pay:

Target pay ranges based on Geographic Zones* for Level M4:

  • Zone 1: San Francisco/Bay Area or NYC Metropolitan Area, Boston, Seattle - $269,400 - 370,480*
  • Zone 2: Irvine, LA, Monterey, Santa Barbara, Santa Rosa, Austin, Portland, Philadelphia, Chicago - $242,500 - 333,410**
  • Zone 3: All other US locations - $229,000 - 314,930*
  • All Zones inclusive of 15% Bonus Target

LaunchDarkly operates from a place of high trust and transparency; we are happy to state the pay range for our open roles to best align with your needs. Exact compensation may vary based on skills, experience, and location.

*Within the United States, our geographic pay zones are defined by counties surrounding major metropolitan areas.
**Restricted Stock Units (RSUs), health, vision, and dental insurance, and mental health benefits in addition to salary.

About LaunchDarkly:

Modern software delivery was supposed to be the foundation for a thriving digital business but reality has proven otherwise. Slow, inefficient development cycles, costly outages, and fragmented customer experiences are preventing developers from building their best software. The LaunchDarkly platform helps developers innovate on new features faster while protecting them with a safety valve to instantly rewind when things go wrong. Developers can target product experiences to any customer segment and maximize the business impact of every feature. And by gradually rolling out new application components, they escape nightmare "big-bang" technology migrations.

The LaunchDarkly platform was built to guide engineers to the next frontier of DevOps by:

  • Improving the velocity and stability of software releases, without the fear of end customer outages
  • Delivering targeted experiences by easily personalizing features to customer cohorts
  • Maximizing the business impact of every feature through the ability to experiment and optimize
  • Coordinating the release and optimization of software to provide consistent experiences across mobile platforms and device types
  • Improving the effectiveness and productivity of engineering teams, by providing insights into engineering cadence and stability

jobs.jobDescription:
1 in 4 people in the US have a treatable mental health condition, but most providers don't accept insurance, making therapy too expensive for most people. Headway’s mission is to fix this by building a new mental healthcare system everyone can access. We started by solving the biggest barrier to care: insurance. The admin work - credentialing, claims, payment reconciliation - is a nightmare. We've automated that.

But we're going further. Over 90,000 providers across all 50 states run their practice on our software, serving over 2.6 million patients. We are building the best tools for therapists to run their entire practice, reimagining the experience of finding a therapist, and investing in the platform foundations to enable this at scale, and building much of it with AI. We aren't just a billing layer; we are becoming the platform where care actually happens.

We're a Series D company with $325M+ in funding (a16z, Accel, Spark Capital, etc.), looking for exceptional people to help us achieve this mission. We want your time here to be the most meaningful experience of your career. Join us, and help change mental healthcare for the better.

About The Role

We're looking for Product Managers across Senior, Staff, Principal, and Senior Principal levels who are curious builders, eager to drive company level impact and to build in an environment where AI is a core part of the toolkit.

We are hiring across Patient, Provider, Payer, and Platform. The right candidates will bring strong product fundamentals and a willingness to build with AI in a regulated, high-stakes industry. Product Managers at Headway own product areas end-to-end: setting strategy, partnering deeply with engineering, data science, and design, and driving outcomes that move the company.

The way we are building is continuously evolving, and the size of opportunity for Headway to leverage AI is massive. We sit at the intersection of healthcare delivery, complex insurance systems, and a multi-sided marketplace serving tens of thousands of providers and millions of patients.

The Problems We're Solving

For Patients

  • Finding the right therapist, understanding your insurance benefits, and staying in care shouldn't be hard. Today it is. We're building AI-powered matching and personalized care navigation that help patients get into — and stay in — mental health care at scale. One million patients a month ask for a referral to a mental health provider. We're building the systems that ensure they actually get there.

For Providers

  • Therapists spend a staggering amount of time on administrative tasks — credentialing, documentation, scheduling, billing — instead of with their patients. We're using AI to automate clinical workflows, simplify complex insurance requirements, and give providers more time to do what they came here to do. The goal: a thriving practice on Headway that practically runs itself.

For Payers

  • Health insurers are asking harder questions: Is care on Headway actually working? Is it worth what we're paying? We're using AI to answer them at scale — measuring clinical outcomes, building dashboards that demonstrate responsible care, and moving toward a model where patients are matched to the right care pathways and providers are aligned around better outcomes. This work protects Headway's standing with insurers and opens doors to deeper, more strategic partnerships.

For Platform

  • The infrastructure underneath Headway — billing, claims, payments, and trust and safety — needs to scale reliably at the speed of our growth. We’re using AI to automate complex, high-volume workflows, detect fraud and errors faster, and build systems that get smarter over time. This is foundational infrastructure with direct impact on Headway's economics and compliance posture.

What You'll Do at Headway

  • Define and own the product strategy for your area in partnership with engineering, design, data, clinical, and operations teams

  • Apply AI where it matters: identify where intelligence creates step-change improvements in your product area and drive those bets from insight through production

  • Set and own clear success metrics; communicate results and course-correct with urgency

  • Represent the voice of your customer — patient, provider, or health plan — with conviction in every decision, grounded in data and direct research

You'd Be a Great Fit If…

  • You have 8+ years of product management experience with a track record of owning complex, high-impact product areas

  • You have experience with LLM systems — prompting, retrieval, evaluation, fine-tuning — and a track record of shipping AI-powered products that hold up at scale, not demos.

  • You've built at scale in a marketplace, platform, or data-intensive environment — and can show the outcomes you drove

jobs.jobDescription:
CrossFit is seeking a Senior Product Manager, Education. You will own product strategy and execution for CrossFit's Education line of business, including the learner experience, course registration, content authoring and delivery, learning platforms, and credentialing. This is a hands-on, individual contributor role: you are the dedicated product specialist for Education, translating the needs of Education leaders, program owners, instructors, and learners into a clear product vision, roadmap, and priorities.

You will partner closely with Engineering, Design, Marketing, Operations, and Education leadership, and coordinate with product owners for adjacent products (for example, the mobile app) to align strategy and sequencing across the broader product surface. Education is central to CrossFit's identity and has significant room to grow. The foundation is an older, layered stack of in-house software and vendor tools.

This role requires someone resilient and responsive, strong at strategy, and disciplined about tight feedback loops: a person who can bring structure and clarity to ambiguity, make disciplined trade-offs, and deliver measurable results.

Responsibilities

  • Product Strategy & Roadmap:
    • Define and own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for Education, in alignment with company priorities and business objectives.
    • Establish clear product goals, success metrics, and KPIs, and regularly evaluate performance against expected outcomes.
    • Use customer insights, product analytics, market trends, and business data to identify opportunities and guide product decisions.
    • Balance learner experience, business impact, technical investment, and available resources, and make and communicate clear trade-off decisions when priorities compete.
    • Bring an informed point of view on where online learning is heading, then commit fully to the direction the business chooses.
  • Product Execution:
    • Lead the product lifecycle from discovery and validation through development, launch, adoption, measurement, and iteration.
    • Guide product decisions for Education's learner experience, course registration, content authoring and delivery, learning platforms, and credentialing, including integrations across existing systems.
    • Evaluate build, buy, modernize, or replace options for legacy platforms and vendor tools, considering user needs, technical dependencies, migration costs, and long-term value.
    • Ensure requirements clearly define the customer problem, business need, expected outcome, and measures of success.
    • Partner with Engineering and Design to scope initiatives and sequence work across quick wins, foundational fixes, and new capabilities.
    • Support launches with go-to-market, communication, training, and adoption plans in partnership with business stakeholders.
    • Contribute to foundational platform capabilities that cut across products, such as data privacy and consent, localization, and marketing enablement.
  • Customer & Business Impact:
    • Partner with Education leaders and program owners to identify learner and instructor pain points, distinguish underlying problems from proposed solutions, and prioritize improvements across the learner journey.
    • Establish and improve instrumentation for enrollment, course completion, conversion, learner retention, and revenue per learner, including where existing data is incomplete.
    • Run experiments across acquisition, activation, upgrades, and re-engagement, using results to refine product and growth priorities.
    • Build tight feedback loops through research, analytics, and direct engagement with learners, instructors, and staff, and turn what you learn into decisions quickly.
    • Tie product investments to measurable customer and business outcomes rather than feature delivery alone.
  • Collaboration & Influence:
    • Serve as the key Product partner to Education leadership, and communicate strategy, roadmap decisions, progress, risks, and results to executives and other stakeholders.
    • Establish operating rhythms that create visibility into roadmap progress, dependencies, risks, and decisions.
    • Identify and resolve barriers to execution across teams and functions.
    • Model strong product practices, including discovery, prioritization, and measurement, and share them with peers.
    • Coordinate with product owners for adjacent products to align strategy and sequencing.

Knowledge and Skills

  • Strong product judgment, with the ability to connect customer needs, business strategy, technology, and financial outcomes.
  • Knowledge of education technology, including learning management systems, content authoring, course delivery, credentialing, and learner-facing experiences, and/or deep experience in growth: funnel analysis, experimentation, activation, conversion, and retention. Depth in both is ideal.
  • Ability to define meaningful funnel and learning metrics, improve measurement capabilities, and use experimentation to inform product decisions.
  • Experience navigating legacy systems, vendor integrations, and fragmented data environments, with sound judgment on technical and migration trade-offs.
  • Strong strategic thinking, paired with resilience and responsiveness. You turn feedback into decisions quickly and stay steady when plans change.
  • Ability to prioritize investments and make difficult trade-offs in a resource-constrained environment.
  • Skill at finding the real problem behind a stated request, and at saying no in a way that keeps the relationship intact.
  • Strong understanding of modern software development and experience partnering closely with Engineering and Design.
  • Uses modern AI tools (e.g., Claude) fluently to accelerate discovery, requirements, analysis, and delivery.
  • Experience with lifecycle marketing and personalization tooling preferred.
  • Excellent communication and executive presentation skills, with demonstrated ability to influence senior stakeholders and create alignment across functions.
  • Comfortable operating in an evolving environment, bringing structure and clarity to ambiguity.
  • Strong ownership, accountability, and bias toward execution.
  • Understanding of the CrossFit ecosystem, Affiliate model, or fitness industry preferred.

Education and Experience

  • Bachelor's degree or equivalent combination of education and relevant experience.
  • 7+ years of product management experience for Senior, or 10+ years for Principal, including significant ownership of digital products or platforms.
  • Experience with education technology, certification or credentialing, online learning, or learner growth products, and/or growth product experience across acquisition, activation, conversion, and retention.
  • Familiarity with learning standards (such as SCORM or xAPI), international localization, registration and payment flows, or membership-based education models preferred.
  • Demonstrated success launching and improving products that delivered measurable customer and business outcomes, ideally in an older or complex technology environment.
  • Experience partnering closely with Engineering, Design, and senior business leaders.
  • Experience with consumer, B2B, marketplace, membership, subscription, fitness, or community-based digital products preferred.

Compensation

Additional Information

jobs.jobDescription:
CrossFit is seeking a Director of Affiliates—a proven business leader and experienced affiliate owner to lead our affiliate business and ensure HQ effectively serves and empowers the global CrossFit affiliate community.

Reporting directly to the CEO, you will lead the teams responsible for supporting, expanding, and strengthening the global affiliate network. You will define the strategic vision, drive key performance metrics, and collaborate across all HQ departments to deliver practical, high-impact solutions for affiliate owners.

As someone who has operated an affiliate, managed operations, coached athletes, and driven business growth, you will leverage your firsthand operational experience to support thousands of affiliate owners in scaling sustainable, successful businesses.

Key Outcomes

  • Network Growth & Retention: Drive affiliate network expansion while enhancing retention strategies and tracking core performance metrics.
  • Affiliate Advocacy & Support: Provide robust operational support, foster direct feedback channels, and serve as the primary advocate for affiliate owners within HQ.
  • Operational Excellence: Streamline business operations, establish clear performance benchmarks, oversee budget allocation, and leverage data-driven insights.
  • Team Leadership: Recruit, mentor, and develop a high-performing team focused on execution, accountability, and continuous improvement.
  • Business Model Optimization: Enhance unit economics for affiliates and ensure all HQ initiatives deliver tangible value to local gym owners.

Key Responsibilities

  • Strategic Execution: Lead overall strategy and execution for the affiliate business unit, maintaining accountability for quarterly performance targets.
  • Community Engagement: Engage directly with affiliate owners through site visits, community events, and roundtables to gather field intelligence and align HQ priorities.
  • Unit Economics: Analyze affiliate unit economics to identify drivers of sustainability, growth, and operational risk across the network.
  • Cross-Functional Collaboration: Partner cross-functionally with Education, Sport, Marketing, Product & Technology, Finance, and Legal to ensure cross-departmental alignment.
  • Budget Management: Manage the departmental operating budget in collaboration with Finance, optimizing resource allocation to yield high impact for owners.
  • Operational Improvement: Monitor key performance indicators, streamline workflows, and remove operational friction for local gym operations.
  • Team Mentorship: Coach, mentor, and cultivate leadership development within the affiliate operations team.

Qualifications & Core Competencies

  • Affiliate Ownership: Current ownership and operational experience with a CrossFit affiliate.
  • Certifications & Open Participation: Active CrossFit Level 4 (CF-L4) certification and ongoing active participation in the CrossFit Open.
  • Strategic Analysis: Strong analytical and strategic planning skills with a focus on measurable outcomes.
  • Affiliate-First Leadership: Agile, affiliate-first leadership style with a dedication to eliminating low-value processes.
  • Team Building: Proven capability to build trust, inspire teams, and develop talent effectively.

Education & Experience

  • Executive Leadership: 10+ years of progressive executive leadership in business operations, account management, franchise/network operations, or professional services.
  • Remote Team Management: Demonstrated expertise managing senior leaders and leading geographically dispersed or remote organizations.
  • Growth & Scaling: Proven track record of driving operational scale, financial growth, and customer retention metrics.
  • Operational Frameworks: Experience designing and implementing scalable operational frameworks and organizational structures.
  • CrossFit Ecosystem Domain Expertise: Deep domain expertise and understanding of the CrossFit affiliate model and ecosystem strongly preferred.

Compensation

Additional Information

Who we are

At Twilio, we’re shaping the future of communications, all from the comfort of our homes. We deliver innovative solutions to hundreds of thousands of businesses and empower millions of developers worldwide to craft personalized customer experiences.

Our dedication to remote-first work, and strong culture of connection and global inclusion means that no matter your location, you’re part of a vibrant team with diverse experiences making a global impact each day. As we continue to revolutionize how the world interacts, we’re acquiring new skills and experiences that make work feel truly rewarding. Your career at Twilio is in your hands.
.

Hiring and how we work

We use Artificial Intelligence (AI) to help make our hiring process efficient. That said, every hiring decision is made by real Twilions!

Also, while we are a remote-first company, you may be asked to report in person on an ad-hoc basis for team gatherings, functional off-sites or customer meetings.
.

See yourself at Twilio

Join the team as Twilio’s next Americas Sales Business Partner Manager.

About the job

We are seeking an Americas Sales Business Partner Manager (SBP) to serve as the right hand Sales Ops leader to leaders across the Americas Sales organization. In this role, you will be instrumental in ensuring alignment between sales strategy and execution, fostering collaboration across teams, and driving operational excellence that accelerates growth and delivers measurable results for your verticals. The ideal candidate is a hands-on Sales Operations leader with deep go-to-market (GTM) and enterprise-scale software/tech experience in sales strategy. Success requires tight alignment and collaboration with your peer Sales Operations functional leaders ( Strategic Operations, Sales Compensation, GTM Initiatives and GTM Analytics, GTM Enablement) and company-wide cross-functional teams such as HR, finance, marketing, product and more.

Responsibilities

In this role, you’ll:

  • Be the Business partner to GTM leaders; challenge the status quo.
  • Shape & execute business strategy to address risks / obstacles / opportunities.
  • Translate strategy into actionable operational plans & execute.
  • Be the Voice of sales in cross-functional initiatives.
  • Execute operational cadences at the Vertical/Segment level supporting a Regional VP of Sales
  • Manage forecast and pipeline health; drive predictability for month/quarter/year.
  • Provide business performance insights; facilitate decision-making.
  • Produce recurring & ad hoc exec business updates.
  • Engage & deliver on localized planning & sales ops activities (e.g. headcount, Annual Planning, New Year Readiness, Account Movements, Territory & Quota operationalization) in alignment with Strategic Operations peer function.

Qualifications

Twilio values diverse experiences from all kinds of industries, and we encourage everyone who meets the required qualifications to apply. If your career is just starting or hasn't followed a traditional path, don't let that stop you from considering Twilio. We are always looking for people who will bring something new to the table!

*Required:

  • 6+ years of experience in sales operations, sales, strategy consulting; minimum 2+ years directly partnering with senior software/tech sales leaders ($1B+ sales orgs).
  • Proficiency in sales planning and operations including sales coverage, segmentation, territory planning, sales compensation strategy and executing a rhythm of business (MBRs, QBRs, etc).
  • Problem-solving, communication and interpersonal skills with ability to influence and align senior leadership and teams.
  • Bachelor’s Degree or equivalent years' of experience; graduate degree a plus.

Location

This role will be remote, but is not eligible to be hired in CA, CT, NJ, NY, PA, WA.

Travel

We prioritize connection and opportunities to build relationships with our customers and each other. For this role, you may be required to travel occasionally to participate in project or team in-person meetings.

What We Offer

Working at Twilio offers many benefits, including competitive pay, generous time off, ample parental and wellness leave, healthcare, a retirement savings program, and much more. Offerings vary by location.

Compensation

The estimated pay ranges for this role are as follows:

  • Based in Colorado, Hawaii, Illinois, Maryland, Massachusetts, Minnesota, Vermont or Washington D.C. : $116,960 - $146,200.
  • Based in New York, New Jersey, Washington State, or California (outside of the San Francisco Bay area): $123,760 - $154,700.
  • Based in the San Francisco Bay area, California: $137,520 - $171,900.
  • This role may be eligible to participate in Twilio’s equity plan and corporate bonus plan. All roles are generally eligible for the following benefits: health care insurance, 401(k) retirement account, paid sick time, paid personal time off, paid parental leave.

The successful candidate’s starting salary will be determined based on permissible, non-discriminatory factors such as skills, experience, and geographic location.

Application deadline information

Applications for this role are intended to be accepted until November 20, 2026, but may change based on business needs.

Twilio thinks big. Do you?

We like to solve problems, take initiative, pitch in when needed, and are always up for trying new things. That's why we seek out colleagues who embody our values — something we call Twilio Magic. Additionally, we empower employees to build positive change in their communities by supporting their volunteering and donation efforts.

So, if you're ready to unleash your full potential, do your best work, and be the best version of yourself, apply now! If this role isn't what you're looking for, please consider other open positions.

.

Stay alert to recruitment fraud

We care about your safety. Scammers sometimes impersonate Twilio recruiters through fake job postings, emails, websites, or messages. Please ensure you are engaging with an official @twilio.com email address. We will never ask for payment, gift cards, cryptocurrency, or banking information during the recruiting process. We do not make job offers without a formal interview process or conduct interviews exclusively through text-based messaging apps.

.

Twilio is proud to be an equal opportunity employer. We do not discriminate based upon race, religion, color, national origin, sex (including pregnancy, childbirth, reproductive health decisions, or related medical conditions), sexual orientation, gender identity, gender expression, age, status as a protected veteran, status as an individual with a disability, genetic information, political views or activity, or other applicable legally protected characteristics. We also consider qualified applicants with criminal histories, consistent with applicable federal, state and local law. Qualified applicants with arrest or conviction records will be considered for employment in accordance with the Los Angeles County Fair Chance Ordinance for Employers and the California Fair Chance Act. Additionally, Twilio participates in the E-Verify program in certain locations, as required by law.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Vercel:

Vercel is the agentic infrastructure company, freeing people and agents to ship what's next. For more than a decade we've helped builders move from idea to production with speed, security, and exceptional developer experience.

Now we're scaling our products for both agents and people to ship and run software, built in the open and trusted by OpenAI, PayPal, Ramp, Supreme, and millions of developers worldwide.

About the Role:

We are looking for a Product Manager to own the Vercel Dashboard, the control plane for every Vercel user, defining how developers and teams interact with Vercel from first login through daily use, across both individual accounts and enterprise organizations. You will lead the shift from what is a project listing page today to a personalized, agent-powered surface that proactively helps users ship and discover value. You will report to the Product Lead and will be located in San Francisco, CA (hybrid).

If you're based within a pre-determined commuting distance of one of our offices (SF, NY, London, or Berlin), the role includes in-office anchor days on Monday, Tuesday, and Friday, even if the role is listed as remote. For location-specific details, please connect with our recruiting team.

What You Will Do:

  • Own the product vision, strategy, and roadmap for the Vercel Dashboard, the primary surface through which all Vercel customers interact with the platform
  • Define how agents operate within the Dashboard, from surfacing errors and suggesting fixes to updating code and config on behalf of users
  • Shift the Dashboard from a passive "pull" experience to a proactive "push" experience, surfacing insights, notifications, and recommended actions
  • Define the information architecture and design patterns that product area teams build within, and partner with those teams (Billing, CI/CD, Observability) to keep their experiences consistent and high-quality within the Dashboard shell
  • Collaborate with Engineering to hold an uncompromising performance bar. The Dashboard must be the fastest, most delightful surface at Vercel
  • Run experiments and measure onboarding funnel performance, feature adoption, and engagement across user segments

About You:

  • You've built and shipped developer-facing products
  • You have experience with control planes, dashboards, or console products at infrastructure, cloud, or developer tools companies
  • You have strong opinions on information architecture and how to organize complex products so they feel simple
  • You think about the product from both a human and an agent perspective. You use AI tools in your own workflow and have a point of view on how agents should interact with product surfaces
  • You have experience running experiments and working with product analytics to drive roadmap decisions

Bonus If You:

  • Have worked on platform or horizontal product teams where you set patterns that other teams adopt
  • Have an engineering background or have built software yourself
  • Have worked on onboarding, activation, or growth loops in a product-led growth context
  • Have experience with personalization frameworks or systems that adapt to user segments and lifecycle stages

Benefits:

  • Competitive compensation package, including equity.
  • Inclusive Healthcare Package.
  • Learn and Grow - we provide mentorship and send you to events that help you build your network and skills.
  • Flexible Time Off.
  • We will provide you the gear you need to do your role, and a WFH budget for you to outfit your space as needed.

The San Francisco, CA base pay range for this role is $172,000 - $258,000. Actual salary will be based on job-related skills, experience, and location. Compensation outside of San Francisco may be adjusted based on employee location. The total compensation package may include benefits, equity-based compensation, and eligibility for a company bonus or variable pay program depending on the role. Your recruiter can share more details during the hiring process.

jobs.jobDescription:
Liftoff is a leading AI-powered performance marketing platform for the mobile app economy. Our end-to-end technology stack helps app marketers acquire and retain high-value users, while enabling publishers to maximize revenue across programmatic and direct demand.

Liftoff’s solutions, including Accelerate, Direct, Monetize, Intelligence, and Vungle Exchange, support over 6,600 mobile businesses across 74 countries in sectors such as gaming, social, finance, ecommerce, and entertainment. Founded in 2012 and headquartered in Redwood City, CA, Liftoff has a diverse, global presence.

Liftoff is building a new e-commerce advertising platform, and we're looking for a Product Manager to own it from zero to one. Today the product drives app users to purchase directly on merchants' e-commerce sites. You'll take the product from its current early state through beta and on the path to general availability, partnering with a dedicated engineering team, our ML organization, and go-to-market teams to set strategy, prioritize the roadmap, and decide what's in and out of scope. This is a senior, largely individual-contributor role with real autonomy: you'll own the business case, the experimentation roadmap, and the platform's identity and attribution architecture, and you'll represent Liftoff directly with customers and partners.

Responsibilities

Own the strategy and the business case

  • Set the product strategy, quarterly goals, and success metrics, and present progress against milestones to executive leadership and finance
  • Own the unit economics that define launch readiness (success metrics, traffic quality, funnel efficiency), and make the call on when the data supports scaling, pivoting, or stopping
  • Decide what stays out of scope. The possible surface area will always exceed team capacity, and disciplined scope-cutting is as important as anything you ship
  • Partner with GTM, sales, and account teams to define ideal customer profiles and go-to-market strategy, select and onboard customers, and turn customer intel into roadmap decisions. Represent Liftoff in customer conversations and strategic industry partnerships

Drive performance through ML partnership

  • Partner with Eng leads to own the experiment roadmap, interpret A/B results, and make Go/No-Go decisions
  • Diagnose full-funnel performance from ad impression through site session, add-to-cart, and purchase, and call out investigation opportunities
  • Set and enforce traffic quality and creative UX standards that protect advertiser outcomes, including suppression logic and inventory quality controls

Own identity, attribution, and platform integrations

  • Work with Legal to define product policy around consent handling, regional privacy requirements, customer data protection, and compliance (GDPR, CCPA, etc.)
  • Develop strategic partnership and integration opportunities to ensure robust measurement and attribution
  • Defend our attribution methodology and incrementality story with sophisticated performance marketers and agencies
  • Lead e-commerce platform integration work end to end: pixels, server-side event delivery, order attribution, catalog ingestion, and merchant-facing installation flows

Requirements

  • 8+ years of product management experience, with meaningful time in performance advertising: DSP, retargeting platform, measurement/MMP, or ad network e-commerce products
  • Hands-on depth in web and mobile identity and attribution: probabilistic matching (IP and device signals), pixels, server-to-server postbacks, and the practical constraints of browser privacy changes (ITP, fingerprinting protection) and ATT
  • A track record of carrying a product from beta to GA, including at least one experience where you recommended killing or materially pivoting something based on the data
  • Comfort operating in a 0-to-1 incubation environment: small, funded pilots, hands-on customer management, and shipping against explicit go/no-go criteria
  • Demonstrated ML experimentation experience: you can read a confidence interval, challenge an experiment design, and make a ship/no-ship call under uncertainty
  • Cross-functional leadership across engineering, ML, go-to-market, sales engineering, creative, and finance without direct authority over any of them

Preferred / What Sets You Apart

  • Experience with the Shopify/e-commerce ecosystem: app approval, Customer Privacy API, webhooks, catalog/product feeds, or merchant-facing tooling. Familiarity with CAPI-style server-side integrations (Meta CAPI, Google Enhanced Conversions) also counts
  • Familiarity with incrementality testing, MTA, or MMM, and the attribution debates (first-click vs. last-click, demand creation vs. demand capture) that agencies and DTC marketers actually have
  • Executive-level financial fluency: you can build and defend a unit economics case to a senior audience and hold your ground under scrutiny

Location:

The preferred location for this role is within the Pacific Time Zone; however, this role is eligible for full-time remote work in one of our entities: CA, CO, ID, IL, FL, GA, MA, MI, MN, MO, NJ, NV, NY, OR, PA, TX, UT, and WA

We are a remote-first company with US hubs in Redwood City, Los Angeles, and New York City.

Travel Expectations:

We offer several opportunities for in-person team gatherings, including but not limited to project meetings, regional meetups, and company-wide events. We expect our employees to attend these gatherings at least once per quarter. These gatherings provide essential opportunities for collaboration, communication, and team building.

Compensation:

Liftoff offers all employees a full compensation package that includes equity and health/vision/dental benefits associated with your country of residence. Base compensation will vary based on the candidate's location and experience.

The following are our base salary ranges for this role:

  • SF Bay Area, Los Angeles/Orange County, Seattle, NYC: $230,000 - $280,000
  • Olympia, Austin, San Diego, Santa Barbara, Boston: $211,000- $257,000
  • All other cities and towns in our approved states: $198,000- $240,000

#LI-VM1

#LI-Remote

Liftoff offers a fast-paced, collaborative, and innovative work environment where employees are empowered to grow and make an impact. We’re shaping the future of the mobile app ecosystem—join us and help accelerate what’s next.

Liftoff’s compensation strategy includes competitive salaries, equity, and benefits designed to support employee well-being and performance. We benchmark compensation based on role, level, and location to ensure fairness and market alignment. Benefits may include medical coverage, wellness stipends, and additional perks based on your country of residence.

Liftoff is an equal opportunity employer. We are committed to creating an inclusive environment for all employees and applicants regardless of race, ethnicity, national origin, age, marital status, disability, sexual orientation, gender identity, religion, veteran status, or any other characteristic protected by applicable law.

Liftoff does not accept unsolicited resumes from individual recruiters or third-party recruiting agencies in response to job postings. No fee will be paid to third parties who submit unsolicited candidates directly to our hiring managers or Recruiting Team. All candidates must be submitted via our Applicant Tracking System by approved Liftoff vendors who have been expressly requested to make a submission by our Recruiting Team for a specific job opening. Amplitude is the leading AI analytics platform, helping over 5,200 customers—including Atlassian, Burger King, NBCUniversal, and Square—build better products and digital experiences. With powerful AI Agents embedded across our platform, teams can analyze, test, and optimize user experiences faster than ever. Ranked #1 across multiple categories in G2’s Winter 2026 Report, Amplitude is the best-in-class solution for product, data, and marketing teams. Learn more at amplitude.com.

As an organization, we deliver for our customers by living our values. We operate from a place of humility, take ownership of problems and successes, approach challenges with a growth mindset, and put our customers at the center of everything we do.

About The Role & Team

Amplitude is helping companies build better digital products through the power of data and AI. Our Deal Desk team plays a critical role in supporting that mission, partnering closely with Sales, Finance, Legal, Revenue Accounting, and Order Management to structure smart, scalable deals that drive growth while managing risk.

As a Deal Desk Manager, you'll serve as a strategic advisor on complex enterprise opportunities, helping shape deal structures, pricing strategies, and commercial terms that balance customer needs with business objectives. You'll work across teams to navigate ambiguity, remove roadblocks, and keep deals moving efficiently. This is a highly collaborative, hands-on opportunity for someone who thrives on solving complex problems, influencing decisions, and improving how business gets done.

This position is open to candidates based remotely anywhere in the United States, with opportunities to collaborate with global stakeholders as business needs arise.

As a Deal Desk Manager, you will:

  • Drive strategic deal structuring: Partner with Sales to develop creative, commercially sound solutions for complex enterprise opportunities, including non-standard pricing, packaging, contract terms, and negotiation strategies.

  • Own deal review and execution: Evaluate and approve non-standard transactions within established SLAs, ensuring appropriate approvals, documentation, and alignment with revenue recognition, legal, and operational policies.

  • Influence cross-functional decisions: Serve as a trusted advisor to Sales, Finance, Legal, Revenue Accounting, and Order Management, balancing commercial objectives with financial and operational considerations to move deals forward.

  • Support complex commercial models: Navigate channel and partner transactions, cloud marketplace deals, and non-standard agreements while identifying potential risks and ensuring smooth downstream execution.

  • Improve and scale deal operations: Identify opportunities to streamline the quote-to-order process, leverage AI and automation, establish best practices, and enable Sales to operate more efficiently as the business grows.

You'll be a great addition to the team if:

  • You thrive in a fast-paced, dynamic environment and are energized by complex, high-stakes deals that require creative thinking and sound judgment

  • You build trust with Sales by being a valued partner—creative, collaborative, and solution-oriented—while still holding the line when it matters

  • You’re energized by cross-functional collaboration and know how to drive alignment across strong personalities and competing priorities

  • You have a sharp eye for risk and detail, but don’t lose sight of the bigger picture

  • You're a clear, thoughtful communicator with strong critical thinking skills and a constant drive to improve systems, processes, and how teams work together

At a minimum, you need to have:

  • 5+ years of experience in Deal Desk, Sales Operations, or a similar deal strategy role in a SaaS or subscription-based business

  • Strong understanding of deal structuring, pricing strategies, and contract negotiations

  • Experience partnering with Legal and Finance on non-standard terms and approvals

  • Proficiency with Salesforce (CPQ experience strongly preferred) and comfort working with data and complex deal scenarios

  • Familiarity with channel selling model and transacting through cloud marketplaces

Our values:

At Amplitude, our values guide how we show up for one another and for our customers:

  • Humility: We operate from a place of empathy and openness, seeking to understand many points of view.

  • Ownership: We take the initiative to solve problems that drive our shared company success.

  • Growth Mindset: We’re tenacious in the face of challenges and seek feedback in order to grow ourselves and others.

  • Customer Centricity: We put the customer at the center of everything we do and are deeply committed to their success.

We care about the well-being of our team: We offer competitive pay and benefits packages that reflect our commitment to the health and well-being of our Ampliteers.

Some of our benefit programs include:

  • Excellent ​M​edical, ​D​ental and ​V​ision insurance coverages, with 100% employer-paid premiums for employee Medical, ​Dental,​ ​​​​​​​​Vision on select plans

  • 401(k) retirement plan with an employer match of up to 1% of your eligible pay each pay period up to $2,000 annually

  • Flexible time off, ​p​aid holidays, and more

  • Generous stipends to spend on what matters most to you, whether that’s wellness (monthly), commuter transit/parking (monthly), learning and development (quarterly), new hire home office equipment, and much more

  • Excellent Parental benefits including​:​ 12 weeks of Paid Parental Leave, Carrot Fertility Benefits/Adoption/Surrogacy support, Back-up Child Care support

  • Mental health and wellness benefits including no cost employee access to Modern Health coaching & therapy sessions

  • Employee Stock Purchase Program​ (ESPP)

Other fun facts about Amplitude:

  • Our customers love us! They've said we're the #1 product analytics solution for 23 quarters in a row on G2.

  • We care a lot about product innovation. We've made significant investments in talent and infrastructure to build the most powerful AI analytics platform on the market.

  • We invest in our people. We offer mentorship programs, management training, and wellness initiatives.

  • We give back to our communities. We give every Ampliteer a charitable giving grant and paid volunteer time off.

  • We were founded in 2012, went public via a direct listing in September 2021, and are now trading under the ticker $AMPL.

  • We’re a global and fast-growing team! We have employees around the world and offices in San Francisco (HQ), New York, Vancouver, Amsterdam, London, Paris, Singapore, and Tokyo.

  • Our mascot is Data Monster, who loves to chow down on numbers, charts, and graphs. Nom nom.

By applying for this job, you acknowledge that Amplitude processes your personal data in accordance with the Amplitude Applicant Privacy Notice.

NVE is a brand experience and production agency dedicated to building ideas rooted in culture and guided by the principle that ‘The Right Moment Will Transform Someone Forever.’ NVE’s team of creatives, strategists and producers develop insight-driven ideas rooted in culture to convert consumer attention into commitment, action, and brand loyalty.

Summary of Position:

We are seeking an experienced and motivated Growth Operations Manager to support the Growth Group (Marketing, Business Development & Account Services) on a day-to-day basis. In this role, the Growth Operations Manager must be extremely detail-oriented, with superior written and verbal communication skills while being able to balance/prioritize multiple projects at once. This person will be responsible for project managing tasks as assigned and providing general operational and process support across both teams.

This is a fixed-term maternity leave coverage position expected to begin immediately and continue into 2027.

Job Responsibilities:

  • Daily management, maintenance and data input for NVE’s CRM, New Business Tracker and Case Study Library
  • Support RFP intakes by joining briefing calls, documenting requirements, translating briefs into internal notification emails, and preparing kick-off materials
  • Provide project management support throughout the RFP process, including managing timelines, scheduling meetings, coordinating materials, tracking deliverables and communicating next steps.
  • Coordinate the development and organization of agency case studies, working with internal teams to gather project details, results and supporting assets
  • Lead the development of tailored capabilities decks, RFIs and sales materials
  • Research and analyze industry/market trends and new business opportunities using various research and forecast methodologies. This includes maintaining NVE’s tentpole calendar/report.
  • Own recurring Growth, Accounts and Business Development meeting invites and logistics. This includes drafting the agendas, scheduling planning meetings, capturing and distributing meeting notes and action items.
  • Support Growth Group leadership with the development of the NVE’s annual growth business plan
  • Support Accounts leadership with 2027 Holiday gifting

Qualifications:

  • 4+ years of experience in operations, project management, sales operations, business development, or a related role
  • Strong organizational skills and the ability to manage multiple priorities and deadlines simultaneously
  • Experience coordinating RFPs, presentations, case studies, or other business-development materials
  • Experience managing budgets, invoices, vendors, subscriptions, and departmental reporting
  • Proficiency with CRM and operational platforms; NetSuite, HubSpot, Airtable, and Box experience is preferred
  • Excellent written, verbal, research, and presentation skills
  • Proactive, detail-oriented, and comfortable working cross-functionally with senior leaders in a fast-paced agency environment

Requirements: Must be able to remain in a stationary position 50% or more of the time

Location: We are a hybrid company with hub locations in Los Angeles and New York. The ideal candidate is located in any of our hub locations, however, we will consider remote candidates for this role.

Diversity, Equity, Inclusion and Belonging:

At NVE, we are led by curiosity and fueled by humanity. Authentic connection is at the heart of our work and we embrace the opportunity and responsibility we have as an organization to provide the tools and resources needed to deliver the best and most equitable experiences possible for our employees and the clients we serve.

Perks & Benefits:

  • Health & Wellness Benefits
  • 401k Match
  • Communication Stipend
  • Paid Company holidays & PTO Package
  • Company get togethers & retreats
  • Paid Parental Leave
  • Flexible WFH policy

Salary Estimation: [$70,000.00 - $85,000.00 per year]

This is an exempt role. NVE intends to provide a competitive total compensation package which includes a variety of incentives, benefits, growth and developmental opportunities. There are many factors to the presented salary range, including but not limited to - location, departmental budgets, certifications, and overall job-related qualifications.

Employment eligibility verification is required for this role. In certain states, NVE participates in the E-Verify program in accordance with local regulations.
Applicable states: Utah, Arizona, Louisiana, Mississippi, Tennessee, Alabama, Georgia, North Carolina, South Carolina, and Florida.

jobs.jobDescription:
Dandy is transforming the massive and antiquated dental industry—an industry worth over $400B. Backed by some of the world’s leading venture capital firms, we’re on an ambitious mission to simplify and modernize every function of the dental practice through technology. As we expand our reach globally, Dandy is building the operating system for dental offices around the world—empowering clinicians and their teams with technology, innovation, and world-class support to achieve more for their practices, their people, and their patients.

Dandy is hiring a Principal Product Manager to lead the strategy and development of our Crown and Bridge customer experiences. Today, our internal design team uses sophisticated first-party CAD software to design every crown. Your job is to bring the right parts of that process to the dentist, so they can influence the outcome with confidence.

Reporting to the GM of Crown and Bridge, you will define and build experiences like interactive 3D design previews, live design reviews with our technicians, and real-time AI crown generation at the chairside, all in service of one goal: the perfect crown for fit, function, and aesthetics.

What You'll Do

Product development at Dandy is a collaborative, high-impact function. You’ll serve as the connective tissue between design, engineering, operations, and business leadership to drive both strategy and execution.

  • Drive the roadmap for your area. You'll ramp by working across Crown and Bridge, then own a defined scope, such as our bridge product, veneers, or a piece of the chairside ordering experience, and set its direction.

  • Bridge internal and external. Build a deep understanding of how our design team works so you can translate a complex internal process into an experience that feels intuitive to a dentist.

  • Lead cross-functionally. Align CAD Engineering, ML, UX Design, and Manufacturing so that what the doctor sees on screen is exactly what gets produced.

  • Ground decisions in evidence. Run customer discovery, market research, and competitive analysis to shape the roadmap and surface new opportunities.

  • Ship into a real operation. Manage the full lifecycle from idea through launch and iteration, knowing that every release lands in a live lab with real technicians, real production schedules, and real cases in flight. You'll plan rollouts, train teams, and adapt quickly when the physical world pushes back.

  • Measure and refine. Combine quantitative data with qualitative insight to assess impact, communicate results, and adjust course.

What We're Looking For

We’re looking for creative and curious product thinkers who can develop and grow a compelling vision for Dandy's products. We seek an experienced Senior or Principal Product Manager accustomed to working in a hyper-growth, customer obsessed organization.

  • 6+ years of experience in product management, managing software products through the full lifecycle from MVP to general release and subsequent iterations

  • Tech Driven Physical Product or Operational Experience: experience working with software experiences that influence real world movement or a physical product

  • High Bias-to-Action: You thrive in hyper-growth environments and are comfortable moving from high-level strategy to "nitty-gritty" specs in the same afternoon.

  • Clinical Empathy: You are obsessed with the end-user. You want to spend time in dental offices understanding how a doctor wants to interact with software experiences that ultimately get them the physical product they like.

Bonus Points For

  • Industry Context: Previous experience in Dental, MedTech, or other operationally complex, tech driven product.

Req ID: J-125

Our local benefits packages typically include healthcare, dental, mental health support, parental planning resources, retirement savings options, and generous paid time off—ensuring our team members are supported no matter where they live and work.

Dandy is proud to be an equal-opportunity employer. We are committed to building a diverse and inclusive culture that celebrates authenticity to win as one. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity, sexual orientation, age, marital status, disability, protected veteran status, citizenship or immigration status, or any other legally protected characteristics.

Dandy also fully complies with the Americans with Disabilities Act (ADA). We are dedicated to embracing challenges and creating an accessible, inclusive workplace for all individuals. In this role, you will own key software tools and workflows that empower dental practices to run their operations smoothly—including how they manage their account and interact with Dandy’s core services.

You will partner with engineering, design, finance, operations, sales, and customer service to build intuitive, scalable, and compliant software that delights practice owners and their teams. What You’ll Do

  • Own the Practice Software Vision & Roadmap – Define and execute a multi-year strategy for Dandy’s practice-facing tools, ensuring reliability, scalability, and seamless user experiences across daily operations.

  • Deliver Seamless Practice Experiences – Build intuitive, transparent, and user-friendly software that simplifies complex tasks, earns customer trust, and reduces friction for practice staff.

jobs.jobDescription:
About Juniper Square

Private markets are one of the largest, most complex, and most underserved corners of global finance. Our mission at Juniper Square is to unlock their full potential. We’re the Operations Partner trusted by 2,300+ GPs, unifying technology, data, and fund administration services into a single platform that helps GPs move faster, make better decisions, and scale with precision. With $300B+ under administration and 700,000+ LPs on platform, we’ve built the scale to match our ambition. And with JunieAI, our purpose-built AI platform, we’re reimagining how private markets operate, embedding intelligence across every workflow. Founder-led since 2014, backed by $350M+ in funding, and now 1,000+ employees strong, we’re building a company designed to shape the future of private markets for decades to come.

Our culture is built for people who want to do ambitious, meaningful work alongside exceptionally talented teammates. We think like owners, move with urgency, and take pride in solving hard problems that truly matter to our customers and the future of private markets. We believe the best ideas come from open debate, deep collaboration, and diverse perspectives, which is why we believe transparency is the default and feedback makes us stronger. If you’re energized by high standards, rapid growth, and the opportunity to help define a category at a pivotal moment, come join us!

Juniper Square offers employees a variety of ways to work, ranging from a fully remote experience to working full-time in one of our physical offices. We invest heavily in digital-first operations, allowing our teams to collaborate effectively across 27 U.S. states, 2 Canadian Provinces, India, Luxembourg, and England. We also have physical offices in San Francisco, New York City, Mumbai and Bangalore for employees who prefer to work in an office some or all of the time.

About your role

As Juniper Square's R&D organization grows globally, we're adding senior technical product leaders. We're looking for an experienced product manager who does well in technically complex problem spaces that cut across teams.

In this role, you will own capabilities that benefit teams across the company, where reaching our business goals depends on cross-functional collaboration and leadership. You'll shape the vision, turn it into a roadmap, and drive adoption across the organization, while holding a high bar for quality and security. You'll own a business or product domain end to end, with direct impact on Juniper Square's growth.

You'll bring a product mindset to everything you own and operate autonomously in a fast-growing, global R&D organization. In line with our values, you'll bring first-principles thinking to your domain and put clients first in every decision. You should be comfortable taking an active part in technical discussions and be curious about technical topics. Many people come to this role after working as engineers, but that isn't required.

We'll decide your specific area during the interview process, based on your experience and business priorities.

What you’ll do

  • Lead a large, technically complex product area: define success, prioritize problems and set strategy with the wider company in view

  • Identify the most significant near- and long-term opportunities in your area, and build consensus on how to sequence them against engineering capacity, risk and business priorities

  • Treat shared capabilities as first-class internal products, with clear documentation and a path teams can adopt instead of building their own

  • Set adoption and reliability expectations, and track how consistently teams build on shared capabilities

  • Bring tradeoffs such as build versus buy, technical debt and sequencing into architecture discussions with engineering leadership

  • Research and benchmark industry practices and new technology, including AI, and turn the findings into strategy

  • Build and maintain feedback channels with stakeholders inside and outside R&D, and use that input to prioritize

  • Define success metrics, track KPIs, and adjust strategy as you learn and as conditions change

  • Lead by influence: inspire other teams with your technical vision, earn their trust and drive adoption

Qualifications

  • 8+ years of experience as a product manager or in a similar role, with at least 5 years on technical platform, data or infrastructure products

  • Demonstrated experience owning horizontal shared capabilities used by multiple teams, with a focus on driving adoption

  • Demonstrated experience working on technically complex solutions, finding clean and enduring designs for these problems that scale

  • Exceptional oral and written communication skills, and comfort explaining complex technical concepts to a wide range of stakeholders within and outside the R&D organization

  • Track record of operating with high autonomy in ambiguous scope

Preferred Qualifications

  • Prior experience as an engineer

  • Concrete examples of using LLM-based agents to automate real-world workflows

Compensation

Compensation for this position includes a base salary, equity and a variety of benefits. The U.S. base salary range for this role is $200,000 - $230,000. Actual base salaries will be based on candidate-specific factors, including experience, skillset, and location, and local minimum pay requirements as applicable.

Benefits include:

  • Health, dental, and vision care for you and your family

  • Life insurance

  • Mental wellness coverage

  • Fertility and growing family support

  • Flex Time Off in addition to company-paid holidays

  • Paid family leave, medical leave, and bereavement leave policies

  • Retirement saving plans

  • Allowance to customize your work and technology setup at home

  • Annual professional development stipend

Your recruiter can provide additional details about compensation and benefits.
