jobs.jobDescription:
Veeam is the Data and AI Trust Company, specializing in helping organizations ensure their data and AI are fully understood, secured, and resilient to enable the acceleration of safe AI at scale. As the market leader in both data resilience and data security posture management, Veeam is built for the convergence of identity, data, security, and AI risk. Headquartered in Seattle with offices in more than 30 countries, Veeam protects over 550,000 customers worldwide, who trust Veeam to keep their businesses running. Join us as we go fearlessly forward together, growing, learning, and making a real impact for some of the world’s biggest brands.

#LI-JC2 #LI-REMOTE

About the Role

The AMER Sales Operations team is looking for a Sales Operations Director to partner with the AMER sales leader and lead the operational engine behind the region’s performance. This role defines how AMER forecasts and plans, including the weekly operating cadence, annual planning cycle, territory and quota design, and the analysis that informs leadership decisions. This is a senior individual contributor role that leads through influence in a matrixed organization, partnering closely with AMER sales leadership and cross-functional teams to ensure the region plans well, forecasts reliably, and operates efficiently.

The team is looking for someone based on the east coast or who is willing to work Eastern hours to align with the team.

What You’ll Do

  • Own the AMER operating calendar, including weekly forecast calls, pipeline inspection, performance reviews, QBRs, ad-hoc leadership meetings, and act as the first point of contact for AMER sales leadership on operational issues.
  • Shape the agenda and direct the analysis these forums depend on, and convert outcomes into tracked actions with owners and dates.
  • Lead the AMER forecast process end to end, including cadence, roll-up logic, and snapshot discipline, against the accuracy definition the region is measured on.
  • Set the standard for commit criteria, stage definitions, and pipeline hygiene, enforce those standards, diagnose forecast error to root cause, and close recurring gaps.
  • Partner with Finance on the link between the sales and financial forecast, including reconciliation, variance explanation, and authoring the forecast narrative for AMER and global leadership.
  • Lead the AMER Annual Operating Plan process for sales, including sequencing, inputs, dependencies, leadership decisions, segmentation, territory design, account distribution, quota setting, and coverage and capacity modeling.
  • Shape go-to-market structure and headcount scenarios, influence Sales Compensation on plan design, and direct in-year changes including territory moves, coverage gaps, and reorganizations.
  • Set priorities and sequence work across the Sales Operations professionals supporting AMER, while maintaining standards for analytical rigor, data integrity, and quality of recommendations.
  • Mentor experienced operations professionals, represent AMER in global Sales Operations forums, and bring global standards into the region.
  • Diagnose process, tooling, and data challenges, pioneer the use of AI and automation, retire ineffective processes, and drive adoption of approved changes with Corporate IT and global Sales Operations.

Technologies You’ll Work With

  • Salesforce
  • AI-enabled productivity and automation tools
  • Sales forecasting and pipeline management platforms
  • Revenue analytics and reporting tools
  • Territory planning and quota management tools
  • Data quality and business intelligence solutions

What You'll Bring

  • Bachelor’s degree or equivalent experience; advanced degree in Economics, Mathematics, or Business Administration preferred.
  • 10+ years in sales operations, revenue operations, or commercial strategy at a technology company (ideally SaaS), or in strategy or technology consulting.
  • Direct ownership of a regional or global sales forecast process, including forecast accuracy improvement.
  • Direct ownership of an annual sales planning cycle, including segmentation, territory design, quota setting, and capacity modeling.
  • Proven ability to drive complex, cross-functional programs through influence rather than direct authority.
  • Strong analytical rigor, including the ability to structure ambiguous problems, generate insight from quantitative analysis, identify data issues, and defend recommendations under challenge.
  • Credibility with senior sales leaders and highly effective written, verbal, and presentation skills.
  • Experience with Salesforce and the surrounding commercial technology stack.
  • Fluent in English.
  • Willingness to travel occasionally, both domestically and internationally, and work across time zones.

Bonus Skills

  • Experience with AI-enabled productivity and automation tooling.
  • Experience building or improving forecast governance, pipeline hygiene, and sales operating cadences.
  • Experience partnering across Finance, Sales Compensation, Marketing, Revenue Operations, and Technology organizations.
  • Experience leading organizational change, territory realignments, or sales force transformations.
  • Experience operating within complex global, matrixed organizations.

What you'll get

  • Unlimited paid time off, 12 paid holidays including 4 global VeeaMe Days for self-care and 24 paid volunteer hours annually through Veeam Cares
  • Paid parental leave: 8 weeks for all parents, 16 weeks for birthing parents
  • Medical, dental, and vision coverage starting on your first day
  • Mental health support, therapy sessions, and digital wellness tools via our Employee Assistance Program
  • 401(k) retirement plan with company matching contributions
  • Fertility, adoption, and surrogacy support through Maven, plus paid volunteer time
  • AirVet: 24/7 virtual veterinary care at no cost
  • Legal services, identity protection, and supplemental health insurance options
  • Tax-advantaged spending accounts for healthcare, dependent care, and commuting
  • Opportunities to learn and grow through on-demand libraries (LinkedIn Learning, O’Reilly), mentoring, workshops, and learning events like our annual Global Day of Learning

Compensation Transparency

Veeam is committed to pay transparency and equitable compensation. For this role, the compensation range below reflects the expected total target compensation (TTC), inclusive of base pay and a competitive performance-based bonus. For roles with a commission plan, the compensation range represents On Target Earnings (OTE), which includes base salary plus variable commission. When determining compensation, Veeam takes into consideration factors such as experience, education, skills, and geographic zone. Offers are typically made below the midpoint of the range.

In addition to compensation, Veeam provides a comprehensive benefits package, including health coverage, retirement plans, and unlimited time off.

$204,800—$380,300 USD

jobs.jobDescription:
Cordance is dedicated to accelerating the growth of vertically focused business-to-business (B2B) software-as-a-service (SaaS) companies through acquisition and long-term tactical and financial guidance. We’re experienced operators and subject-matter experts with a passion for software and building businesses. We partner with founders to help them scale their businesses and realize their companies’ full potential.

We look for businesses with strong leadership and high potential for profitable growth, and work together to increase year-over-year revenue, company efficiency, and impact. Cordance envisions that all companies we work with achieve their full potential. We embrace what makes each company great and build on those foundations. We believe in elevating a company as it scales, delivering dignity to the organization and its employees, and sharing a passion for building a legacy.

Position Overview

The Vice President, Product helps raise the quality, speed, and ambition of product development across the Cordance portfolio. This is not a traditional single-company VP of Product role. The VP partners with BU Presidents, Product leaders, and Engineering teams to strengthen product strategy, improve the quality of major product bets, and help our businesses build products that drive growth, retention, and long-term value. The mandate spans executive advisory work on major product decisions, raising product capability and craft across the portfolio, and helping teams use AI to rethink both what they build and how they build it.

Success in this role means our businesses make better product choices, validate ideas earlier, build faster, and put more of their product and engineering capacity behind the opportunities most likely to improve customer value and business performance. It also means our Presidents and Product leaders become stronger product thinkers, and our best product practices spread more quickly across the portfolio.

Key Responsibilities

  • Partner with BU Presidents and Product Leaders
    • Help Presidents and Product leaders turn customer needs, market opportunities, and business priorities into clear product strategies and roadmaps.
    • Challenge assumptions on product-market fit, differentiation, prioritization, and investment before major decisions are made.
    • Help teams move beyond feature roadmaps toward stronger customer-, market-, and outcome-based product decisions.
    • Get directly involved in important product decisions where additional product leadership can materially improve the outcome.
  • Improve the Quality of Product Bets
    • Assess major product bets on customer value, market opportunity, differentiation, expected business impact, required investment, and execution feasibility.
    • Help teams determine where to invest, test, accelerate, modernize, or stop.
    • Bring rigor to early product validation so teams learn quickly before committing significant engineering capacity.
    • Connect product decisions to measurable results, including adoption, retention, expansion, ARR growth, and customer value.
  • Build Products in the AI Age
    • Help teams identify AI-native opportunities rather than simply adding AI features to existing products.
    • Apply AI across discovery, prototyping, validation, development, testing, launch, and ongoing optimization.
    • Help Product and Engineering teams use AI-assisted development to improve speed and time to market.
    • Bring practical fluency in AI-enabled UX, automation, agentic workflows, data, model economics, security, and privacy.
    • Ensure AI investments are grounded in real customer and business outcomes, not novelty.
  • Raise Product Capability Across the Portfolio
    • Coach senior Product leaders and PMs to become better product and business leaders.
    • Strengthen discovery, prioritization, MVP definition, roadmap strategy, experimentation, and product measurement.
    • Establish a small number of practical product standards and operating rhythms that improve execution without slowing teams down.
    • Identify common capabilities, tools, and patterns that can be leveraged across businesses where it makes sense.
    • Introduce current SaaS and AI product thinking while respecting the unique markets and customer needs of each business.
  • Connect Product, Engineering, and Business Strategy
    • Work closely with Engineering leaders so product strategy and technical decisions reinforce one another.
    • Engage credibly on SaaS architecture, cloud, APIs, data, platforms, AI, and scalability.
    • Help teams think clearly about build, buy, partner, and platform choices.
    • Maintain a strong customer and business orientation while working across technical and commercial teams.

Competencies:

  • Product Judgment – Identifies important customer problems, validates opportunities, and makes clear prioritization decisions.
  • Builder Mindset – Creates and improves products rather than simply managing roadmaps or large Product organizations.
  • AI-Native Thinking – Sees where AI changes what gets built and how teams build it, and focuses on value over novelty.
  • Commercial Fluency – Connects product decisions to adoption, retention, expansion, monetization, and ARR growth.
  • Influence Without Authority – Earns credibility with CEOs, Presidents, and Product leaders and influences through expertise and judgment.
  • Leader Development – Coaches senior Product leaders and PMs to become stronger product and business leaders.
  • Technical Credibility – Engages effectively with Engineering while remaining fundamentally customer- and product-led.
  • Bias for Outcomes – Values judgment, speed, and measurable results over process for its own sake.

Required Qualifications

  • Significant B2B SaaS product leadership experience, including leading products from early concept through launch and scale.
  • Demonstrated success creating and improving products, not simply managing roadmaps or large Product organizations.
  • Hands-on experience applying AI to both product development and customer-facing products.
  • Strong understanding of SaaS economics, including adoption, retention, expansion, monetization, and growth.
  • Experience working directly with CEOs, Presidents, or senior business leaders.
  • Experience coaching and developing senior Product leaders and PMs.
  • Technical fluency in SaaS architecture, cloud, APIs, data, platforms, and scalability.

Preferred Qualifications

  • Experience working across multiple products, markets, or businesses.
  • Portfolio, multi-business, or PE-backed operating experience.
  • Vertical SaaS experience.

Please note that we do not accept unsolicited resumes, work on a Corp-to-Corp basis, or engage with non-vetted external agencies.

Why Join Us?

At Cordance, we believe in taking care of our team members. When you join us, you’ll enjoy a comprehensive benefits package designed to support your health, financial well-being, and work-life balance:

  • Health and Wellness:
    • Comprehensive Health Coverage: Coverage begins on your first day of employment.
  • Retirement Savings:
    • 401K Plan (US): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
    • RRSP (CAN): We match 1:1 for the first 3% of contributions and 0.5:1 for the next 2%. Contribute 5% of your salary and get a 4% match. Choose from pre-tax and Roth options. You’re eligible the first of the month after 90 days and immediately vested.
  • Paid Time Off:
    • Flexible PTO: Enjoy uncapped paid time off to balance your work and personal life.
  • Parental Leave:
    • 12 weeks paid leave for all employees.
  • Remote Work Support:
    • Monthly Stipend: Receive $75 USD / $140 CAD per month for phone and internet if you work remotely.
  • Holidays:
    • Generous Holiday Schedule: Benefit from an extensive list of holidays to recharge and spend time with loved ones.

Join us and be part of a company that values your contributions and well-being from day one!

jobs.jobDescription:
Infisical is the open source security infrastructure platform that engineers use for secrets management, certificates, and privileged access management. We help developers and organizations securely manage billions of secrets every month including application configuration, database credentials, certificates, and more.

We’ve raised $19M from Y Combinator, Google, and Elad Gil, and our customers include Hugging Face, OpenRouter, LG, and NVIDIA.

Join us on a mission to make security easier for all developers — starting with secrets management. We’re looking to hire exceptional talent to join us in building the open source security infrastructure stack for the AI era.

About the role

We’re looking for a Founding Product Manager to help shape the future of Infisical’s platform. As our first Product Manager, you’ll take ownership of our Secrets Management product line, working closely with engineering and the founders to define product strategy, accelerate innovation, and build a product that developers love.

This is a highly technical, hands-on role for someone who combines strong engineering judgment with exceptional product taste. You’ll have the opportunity to establish the foundations of our product function, drive meaningful improvements to a platform used by developers and enterprises, and expand your scope across product lines like Infisical PKI and Infisical PAM as we grow.

You’ll work closely with our founders, engineering, sales, and marketing to:

  • Own the product strategy and roadmap for Secrets Management, making informed trade-offs between customer needs, technical complexity, and business impact to help us build and ship the right things quickly.

  • Work directly with customers to understand pain points, identify opportunities, and translate insights into product improvements that drive adoption, retention, and expansion.

  • Define product metrics, establish analytics and tracking infrastructure, and use data to guide product decisions and measure the impact of what you ship.

  • Own product pricing and packaging, helping determine how we monetize the platform and how features are structured across different tiers.

  • Develop a deep understanding of the developer tools and infrastructure landscape, continuously evaluating the user experience and competitive environment to inform product direction.

  • Partner with engineering, sales, and marketing to bring products to market, shape technical messaging, and enable our go-to-market teams to effectively communicate product value.

Requirements

  • Strong technical background, ideally with previous software engineering experience and a deep understanding of developer tools, APIs, infrastructure, and software architecture.

  • Proven experience owning and scaling a product surface in a Product Management capacity, with a track record of delivering measurable product and business impact.

  • Strong product judgment and analytical skills, with the ability to prioritize effectively, make decisions with incomplete information, and translate customer insights and business goals into a clear roadmap.

  • Exceptional written, verbal, and presentation skills, with the ability to communicate complex technical concepts clearly to customers and internal teams.

  • A bias toward action and high ownership, with the ability to operate independently, move quickly, and make sound decisions in a fast-paced environment.

  • A tech-forward mindset, with a willingness to get hands-on with technical work, experiment with AI tools, and continuously explore new approaches to solving product and engineering problems.

Nice to have

  • Experience owning pricing and packaging for a software product.

  • Experience building or scaling developer tools, infrastructure, or security products.

  • Experience with open-source or open-core products and an understanding of the needs of both individual developers and enterprise customers.

  • Experience with product analytics, data instrumentation, and building dashboards to measure product performance.

Team, values & benefits

Our team brings experience from companies like Databricks, AWS, Red Hat, and more. We operate primarily as a remote team, but maintain a strong presence in San Francisco, where we have an office. We also get together in person throughout the year for off-sites, conferences, and team gatherings.

At Infisical, we offer competitive compensation, including both salary and equity options. Additional benefits, such as a lunch stipend and a work setup budget, are available with more details to be found on our careers page.

jobs.jobDescription:
Who we are

Help Scout started in 2011 with a simple premise: support software should treat customers like people, not tickets. 3+ billion conversations later, more than 10,000 companies use Help Scout to grow relationships with customers of all types, from clients to patients and beyond.

Now we’re in a new chapter: not only building AI that gives teams more space to focus on the customer experience, but also reimagining how we operate in an AI-native world. That means shipping and learning faster, without compromising on craft. Great work here carries a strong opinion and sweats the details, regardless of the tools we use to drive it.

We’ve been a fully remote team since day one, with 120+ teammates now all over the world. It’s a culture where you’ll be trusted to take ownership, stay curious, and raise the quality of work around you. It comes with clear expectations and a team that will push you to do some of the best work of your career.

If that kind of challenge gives you energy, we’d love to meet you.

Your impact

Help Scout has earned something most software companies never get: genuine trust. More than 10,000 businesses use us, and a remarkable share of them arrived because someone they respect recommended us. That trust is also why customers stay and grow with us once they're in the door.

Growth is how more of the people who show up turn into teams who can't imagine working without Help Scout — and how customers who already love one part of the product find their way into what's next. As Head of Product, Growth & Monetization, you'll be directly accountable for both sides of that story: the core funnel that turns a signup into a paying customer, and the in-app motion that turns a paying customer into an expanding one.

About the role

  • Own the growth roadmap. You'll partner with Design and Engineering, but you’ll own the vision, roadmap, and execution for the Growth team. That starts with sharpening the core funnel: signup, onboarding, trial-to-paid conversion, and the activation moments that turn a trial into a team that can't imagine working without Help Scout.

  • Run growth experimentation across the org. Build and run an experimentation practice spanning two swim lanes: new business (signup through trial-to-paid) and expansion (getting existing customers to experience and purchase Agent, Copilot, and Signal products). The expansion lane means designing and running experiments inside product lines you don't own, in partnership with the other product leaders who do.

  • Evolve Help Scout's monetization strategy. Own the overarching pricing and packaging framework across the portfolio. Each Head of Product still owns pricing and packaging execution for their own line — your job is the cross-product throughline and the judgment to know when to weigh in.

  • Build growth infrastructure other teams can use. Create the growth model, experiment standards, and playbooks that let teams across the company ship growth work with confidence, without routing every decision through you.

  • Lead as a player/coach. Do the strategic work yourself today, and hire and manage a team of PMs as the group grows. You're accountable for the group's revenue results, not just its roadmap execution.

  • Partner across the customer lifecycle. Work with go-to-market so the growth motion is coherent from first touch through expansion, and spend real time with customers and in the data to keep that motion grounded in what's actually true.

About you

  • You've spent 5+ years leading growth in B2B SaaS with a free-trial or freemium motion, and you have a concrete story of moving a product line's revenue or adoption.

  • You're hands-on with experimentation. You define your own metrics, design your own tests, and you're honest about when a result is signal versus noise.

  • You think in outcomes, not features, and you build systems and playbooks that make everyone around you faster, not just wins that end with you.

  • You can design an outcome-based pricing framework and explain its tradeoffs, and you understand the difference between owning strategy and owning someone else's execution.

  • You're technically fluent enough to hold an architecture conversation and push back credibly on an engineering estimate, and you understand how AI and agentic product features actually fail, not just how they work when they work.

  • You lead through influence as much as authority. Your impact here comes from getting peer product teams to want to run your experiments with you.

  • You've directly managed people before. You'll hire and coach a team of PMs as this group grows.

  • You're an excellent writer who makes your thinking visible in one-pagers and briefs that move decisions forward, and you're genuinely fluent with AI tools for research synthesis, strategy testing, and rapid prototyping.

Who you'll work with

  • Chief Product Officer. You report to the CPO and partner closely with them on strategy and monetization.

  • Head of Product, Conversations. You partner on expansion experiments and the monetization framework for Inbox and Copilot.

  • Head of Product, Intelligence. You partner on expansion experiments and the monetization framework for Agent and Signal.

  • Marketing leadership. You align the growth motion with campaigns, messaging, and pricing/packaging changes.

  • Sales & Customer Success leadership. You keep the growth motion coherent across the full customer lifecycle, from trial through expansion and renewal.

  • Growth PMs. As the group grows, a small team of PMs may report to you.

Note: This role is open to US-based applicants only.

Company values

Happy to Help

Help is in our first name! We show up for each other — not out of obligation, but because we’re invested in the team’s collective success. We share knowledge freely, lead with generosity, and practice empathy with our teammates, customers, and community.

Craft over Convention

Our success relies on the quality and craft of the work we put into the world. The status quo simply won’t work. So we insist on narrow focus, sweating every detail, and relentless pursuit of customer delight.

Progress not Perfection

Achieving our true potential — collectively and individually — requires constant progress and forward momentum. By creating a culture of curiosity and openness, we aim to create a safe space for mistakes, the ability to identify them quickly, and use them to get better.

Own the Outcome

Own the outcome means taking full responsibility for the results of your work, decisions, and contributions. It reflects a mindset of accountability, proactiveness, and follow-through. If you “own the outcome,” you don’t just complete tasks, you ensure your work leads to meaningful results, and take initiative to solve problems rather than passing them along.

Read more about how we define, share, and live these values here.

Benefits And Perks

  • Competitive salary and an internal, transparent salary formula based on market data

  • Flexible time off – you choose the holidays and vacations that make sense for you

  • 12 weeks of fully paid parental leave for all new parents, including adoption and foster care

  • A home office stipend to help you get set up and productive

  • A co-working stipend up to $300 a month if you choose to work out of your house

  • A yearly professional development stipend of $1,800 to help you grow in your craft

  • If you’re in the U.S. or Canada, we offer top tier health insurance for you and your dependents.

Hiring Guidelines:

All roles at Help Scout are fully remote. Some positions have specific location requirements. For roles outside the U.S. and Canada, we work with teammates as independent contractors under country-specific agreements.

We do not sponsor visas. Teammates must already be authorized to work from their home country.

We are an equal opportunity employer and are committed to building a company that embraces and celebrates diversity and inclusion. We do not discriminate on the basis of race, religion, color, national origin, gender, gender identity or expression, sexual orientation, age, marital status, veteran status, or disability status. We have read the studies and understand that diverse teams build better products, bring more perspective to the table, contribute to a company’s financial success, and help foster a more inclusive environment for all employees, but the bottom line is that it's the right thing to do.

To provide you with the best experience, we can support you with accommodations or adjustments at any stage of the recruitment process. Simply inform our recruitment team during your conversation with them.

A note on the use of AI in our interview process

While we understand that AI is an important tool in a modern skillset, we ask that you do not utilize AI assistants live on our interviews. Of course, use any tools you need to prepare! But we'd like for you to have a real human-to-human conversation with our team.

On our end, we utilize a platform called Brighthire as a notetaker and review tool to ensure a fair and transparent hiring process.

Beware of scammers! All legitimate communication from Help Scout regarding your application will come directly from an @helpscout.com email address and through our applicant tracking system, Ashby. We will never ask for personal financial information or conduct interviews outside of these official channels.
